English: Yahweh said to Moses, “This is what you shall tell the children of Israel: ‘You yourselves have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.

Kikuyu: Mũtikanathondeke ngai ingĩ cia kũhooyagwo hamwe na niĩ; mũtikanethondekere ngai cia betha kana ngai cia thahabu.
English: You shall most certainly not make gods of silver or gods of gold for yourselves to be alongside me.

Kikuyu: “ ‘Njakĩrai kĩgongona gĩa tĩĩri, na mũrutĩre ngʼondu na mbũri na ngʼombe cianyu ho irĩ magongona manyu ma njino na ma ũiguano. Kũrĩa guothe ngaatũma rĩĩtwa rĩakwa rĩtĩĩagwo, nĩndĩũkaga kũrĩ inyuĩ na ngamũrathima.
English: You shall make an altar of earth for me, and shall sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and your peace offerings, your sheep and your cattle. In every place where I record my name I will come to you and I will bless you.

Kikuyu: Mũngĩnjakĩra kĩgongona kĩa mahiga, mũtigagĩake na mahiga marĩa maacũhie, nĩgũkorwo mũngĩgaatũmĩra kĩndũ gĩa gwacũhia nĩmũgagĩthaahia.
English: If you make me an altar of stone, you shall not build it of cut stones; for if you lift up your tool on it, you have polluted it.

Kikuyu: Mũtikanahaice kĩgongona gĩakwa na ngathĩ, nĩguo njaga yanyu ndĩkanonekanĩre ho.’
English: You shall not go up by steps to my altar, that your nakedness may not be exposed to it.’

Kikuyu: “Maya nĩmo mawatho marĩa ũkũhe andũ a Isiraeli:
English: “Now these are the ordinances which you shall set before them:

Kikuyu: “Ũngĩgũra Mũhibirania arĩ ndungata, agaakũrutĩra wĩra mĩaka ĩtandatũ. No mwaka wa mũgwanja, nĩũkamũrekereria athiĩ, na ndagakũrĩha kĩndũ.
English: “If you buy a Hebrew servant, he shall serve six years, and in the seventh he shall go out free without paying anything.

Kikuyu: Angĩgooka arĩ wiki, akaarekererio athiĩ arĩ o wiki; no angĩgooka arĩ na mũtumia, makaarekererio mathiĩ marĩ hamwe.
English: If he comes in by himself, he shall go out by himself. If he is married, then his wife shall go out with him.

Kikuyu: Mwathi wa ndungata ĩyo angĩmĩhe mũtumia nake mũtumia ũcio amũciarĩre ciana cia aanake na airĩtu, mũtumia ũcio na ciana ciake magaatuĩka a mwathi ũcio wake, na no ndungata ĩyo ya mũndũ mũrũme ĩkaarekererio ĩthiĩ.
English: If his master gives him a wife and she bears him sons or daughters, the wife and her children shall be her master’s, and he shall go out by himself.

Kikuyu: “No ndungata ĩyo ĩngĩkaaria, ĩmwĩre atĩrĩ, ‘Nĩnyendete mwathi wakwa, na mũtumia wakwa na ciana na ndikwenda kũrekererio thiĩ,’
English: But if the servant shall plainly say, ‘I love my master, my wife, and my children. I will not go out free;’

Kikuyu: hĩndĩ ĩyo mwathi wa ndungata ĩyo nĩakamĩtwara mbere ya atuithania ciira. Akaamĩtwara mũrango-inĩ, kana hingĩro-inĩ ya mũrango, na amĩtũre gũtũ na mũkuha.* Nayo ndungata ĩyo ĩgaatuĩka ya mwathi ũcio matukũ ma muoyo wayo wothe.
English: then his master shall bring him to God, and shall bring him to the door or to the doorpost, and his master shall bore his ear through with an awl, and he shall serve him forever.

Kikuyu: “Mũndũ angĩendia mwarĩ agatuĩke ndungata, ndĩkarekererio ĩthiĩ ta ũrĩa ndungata cia arũme ciĩkagwo.
English: “If a man sells his daughter to be a female servant, she shall not go out as the male servants do.

Kikuyu: Ĩngĩaga gũkenia mwathi ũrĩa wamĩthuurĩte, no nginya etĩkĩre ndungata ĩyo ĩkũũrwo. Ndarĩ na kĩhooto gĩa kwendia ndungata ĩyo kũrĩ ageni, tondũ nĩagĩte kwĩhokeka harĩ yo.
English: If she doesn’t please her master, who has married her to himself, then he shall let her be redeemed. He shall have no right to sell her to a foreign people, since he has dealt deceitfully with her.

Kikuyu: Angĩmĩũrĩria mũriũ, no nginya amĩtue ta ĩrĩ mwarĩ wake mwene.
English: If he marries her to his son, he shall deal with her as a daughter.

Kikuyu: Mũriũ angĩhikia mũtumia ũngĩ, ndakaime ũrĩa wa mbere irio na nguo, na ndakamũime kĩhooto gĩake ta mũtumia wake.
English: If he takes another wife to himself, he shall not diminish her food, her clothing, and her marital rights.

Kikuyu: Angĩaga kũmũhingĩria maũndũ maya matatũ-rĩ, akĩrekererio athiĩ, gũtarĩ na mbeeca ikũrĩhwo.
English: If he doesn’t do these three things for her, she may go free without paying any money.

Kikuyu: “Mũndũ ũrĩa ũngĩgũtha mũndũ amũũrage, ti-itherũ o nake no akooragwo.
English: “One who strikes a man so that he dies shall surely be put to death,

Kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, angĩkorwo ekĩte ũguo atekwenda-rĩ, no gũtuĩke nĩ Ngai ũtũmĩte ũndũ ũcio wĩkĩke, nake mũndũ ũcio nĩakoorĩra kũndũ kũrĩa ngaathuura.
English: but not if it is unintentional, but God allows it to happen; then I will appoint you a place where he shall flee.

Kikuyu: No mũndũ angĩtũmĩra mawara na oorage mũndũ ũrĩa ũngĩ akĩendaga-rĩ, mweheriei kĩgongona-inĩ gĩakwa, na mũmũũrage.
English: If a man schemes and comes presumptuously on his neighbor to kill him, you shall take him from my altar, that he may die.

Kikuyu: “Mũndũ ũrĩa ũngĩtharĩkĩra ithe kana nyina no nginya ooragwo.
English: “Anyone who attacks his father or his mother shall be surely put to death.

Kikuyu: “Mũndũ ũngĩiya mũndũ ũngĩ na hinya akamwendie, kana o na anyiitwo arĩ nake atanamwendia- rĩ, no nginya ooragwo.
English: “Anyone who kidnaps someone and sells him, or if he is found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.

Kikuyu: “Mũndũ ũrĩa ũngĩruma ithe kana nyina no nginya ooragwo.
English: “Anyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death.

Kikuyu: “Andũ mangĩũgitana na ũmwe aringe ũrĩa ũngĩ na ihiga kana na ngundi na aage gũkua, no akome ũrĩrĩ kwa ihinda-rĩ,
English: “If men quarrel and one strikes the other with a stone, or with his fist, and he doesn’t die, but is confined to bed;

Kikuyu: ũcio mũringani ndagacookererwo nĩ mahĩtia angĩkorwo ũrĩa waringĩtwo nĩakehota na etware nja na mũtirima wake. No rĩrĩ, no nginya arĩhe mahinda ma mũndũ ũcio mũtihie marĩa morĩte na one atĩ nĩahona biũ.
English: if he rises again and walks around with his staff, then he who struck him shall be cleared; only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall provide for his healing until he is thoroughly healed.

Kikuyu: “Mũndũ angĩhũũra ngombo yake ya mũndũ mũrũme kana ya mũndũ-wa-nja na rũthanju, nayo ngombo ĩyo ĩkue nĩ ihũũra rĩu-rĩ, no nginya aherithio,
English: “If a man strikes his servant or his maid with a rod, and he dies under his hand, the man shall surely be punished.

Kikuyu: no ndangĩherithio ngombo ĩyo ĩngĩarahũka thuutha wa mũthenya ũmwe kana ĩĩrĩ, tondũ ngombo ĩyo nĩ kĩndũ gĩake.
English: Notwithstanding, if his servant gets up after a day or two, he shall not be punished, for the servant is his property.

Kikuyu: “Andũ mangĩkorwo makĩrũa, maringe mũtumia ũrĩ nda, ahune no ndagĩe na thĩĩna ũngĩ-rĩ, ũrĩa ũmũringĩte nĩakarĩha kĩrĩa gĩothe mũthuuri wa mũtumia ũcio ageetia, igooti rĩetĩkĩria.
English: “If men fight and hurt a pregnant woman so that she gives birth prematurely, and yet no harm follows, he shall be surely fined as much as the woman’s husband demands and the judges allow.

Kikuyu: No mũtumia ũcio angĩtihio ũũru, muoyo nĩũrĩhagio na muoyo, na
English: But if any harm follows, then you must take life for life,

Kikuyu: riitho rĩrĩhagio na riitho, na igego rĩrĩhagio na igego, na guoko kũrĩhagio na guoko, na kũgũrũ kũrĩhagio na kũgũrũ, na
English: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,

Kikuyu: ihĩa rĩrĩhagio na ihĩa, na itihia rĩrĩhagio na itihia, naruo rũhara rũrĩhagio na rũhara.
English: burning for burning, wound for wound, and bruise for bruise.

Kikuyu: “Mũndũ angĩgũtha ndungata ya mũndũ mũrũme kana ya mũndũ-wa-nja riitho narĩo rĩthũke-rĩ, no nginya akaarekereria ndungata ĩyo ĩĩthiĩre, ũndũ ũcio ũtuĩke nĩguo irĩhi rĩa riitho.
English: “If a man strikes his servant’s eye, or his maid’s eye, and destroys it, he shall let him go free for his eye’s sake.

Kikuyu: Na angĩkũũra igego rĩa ndungata ya mũndũ mũrũme kana ya mũndũ-wa-nja, no nginya arekererie ndungata ĩyo ĩĩthiĩre, ũndũ ũcio ũtuĩke nĩguo irĩhi rĩa igego.
English: If he strikes out his male servant’s tooth, or his female servant’s tooth, he shall let the servant go free for his tooth’s sake.

Kikuyu: “Ndegwa ĩngĩtheeca mũndũ mũrũme kana mũndũ-wa-nja na rũhĩa akue, ndegwa ĩyo no nginya ĩhũũrwo na mahiga nginya ĩkue, na nyama ciayo itikarĩĩo. No mwene ndegwa ndangĩũrio.
English: “If a bull gores a man or a woman to death, the bull shall surely be stoned, and its meat shall not be eaten; but the owner of the bull shall not be held responsible.

Kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, angĩkorwo ndegwa ĩyo nĩĩmenyerete gũtheeca andũ na rũhĩa, na mwene nĩamenyithĩtio ũhoro ũcio nake akaaga kũmĩhingĩra, nayo ĩcooke yũrage mũndũ mũrũme kana mũndũ-wa-nja-rĩ, ndegwa ĩyo no nginya ĩhũũrwo na mahiga ĩkue, na mwene o nake no nginya ooragwo.
English: But if the bull had a habit of goring in the past, and this has been testified to its owner, and he has not kept it in, but it has killed a man or a woman, the bull shall be stoned, and its owner shall also be put to death.

Kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, angĩtuĩka nĩ gwĩtio irĩhi-rĩ, no akũũre muoyo wake na kũrĩha kĩrĩa gĩothe angĩĩtio.
English: If a ransom is imposed on him, then he shall give for the redemption of his life whatever is imposed.

Kikuyu: Watho ũyũ noguo ũrũgamĩrĩire ndegwa ĩngĩtheeca mwanake kana mũirĩtu wa mũndũ na rũhĩa.
English: Whether it has gored a son or has gored a daughter, according to this judgment it shall be done to him.

Kikuyu: Ndegwa ĩngĩtheeca ngombo ya mũndũ mũrũme kana mũndũ-wa-nja, mwene no nginya arĩhe cekeri mĩrongo ĩtatũ cia betha kũrĩ mwathi wa ngombo ĩyo,† nayo ndegwa ĩyo no nginya ĩhũũrwo na mahiga.
English: If the bull gores a male servant or a female servant, thirty shekels† of silver shall be given to their master, and the ox shall be stoned.

Kikuyu: “Mũndũ angĩkunũra irima, kana enje rĩmwe na aage kũrĩkunĩka, nayo ndegwa kana ndigiri ĩgwe thĩinĩ warĩo,
English: “If a man opens a pit, or if a man digs a pit and doesn’t cover it, and a bull or a donkey falls into it,

Kikuyu: mwene irima rĩu no nginya arĩhe hathara ĩyo; no nginya arĩhe mwene nyamũ, nayo nyamũ ĩyo ĩkuĩte ĩtuĩke yake.
English: the owner of the pit shall make it good. He shall give money to its owner, and the dead animal shall be his.

Kikuyu: “Ndegwa ya mũndũ ĩngĩtihia ndegwa ya mũndũ ũngĩ ĩkue, andũ acio nĩmakendia ndegwa ĩrĩa ĩrĩ muoyo, magayane mbeeca na magayane nyamũ ĩyo ĩkuĩte.
English: “If one man’s bull injures another’s, so that it dies, then they shall sell the live bull, and divide its price; and they shall also divide the dead animal.

Kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, kũngĩkorwo nĩkũmenyekete atĩ ndegwa ĩyo nĩĩmenyerete gũtheecana na rũhĩa, nake mwene akaaga kũmĩhingĩra-rĩ, no nginya mwene arĩhe, nyamũ ĩrĩhio na nyamũ ĩngĩ, na ĩrĩa ĩkuĩte ĩtuĩke yake.
English: Or if it is known that the bull was in the habit of goring in the past, and its owner has not kept it in, he shall surely pay bull for bull, and the dead animal shall be his own.

Kikuyu: “Mũndũ angĩiya ndegwa kana ngʼondu, na amĩthĩnje kana amĩendie-rĩ, no nginya arĩhe ndegwa ithano nĩ ũndũ wa ndegwa ĩyo na ngʼondu inya nĩ ũndũ wa ngʼondu ĩyo.
English: “If a man steals an ox or a sheep, and kills it or sells it, he shall pay five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.

Kikuyu: “Mũici angĩnyiitwo agĩtua nyũmba nake agũthwo akue-rĩ, mũmũgũthi ndarĩ na ihĩtia rĩa gũita thakame;
English: If the thief is found breaking in, and is struck so that he dies, there shall be no guilt of bloodshed for him.

Kikuyu: no ũndũ ũcio ũngĩkĩka thuutha wa riũa kũratha, mũndũ ũcio wagũthana arĩ na ihĩtia rĩa gũita thakame. “Mũici no nginya arĩhe kĩrĩa aiyĩte, no angĩkorwo ndarĩ na kĩndũ, no nginya endio nĩguo kĩrĩa aiyĩte kĩrĩhwo.
English: If the sun has risen on him, he is guilty of bloodshed. He shall make restitution. If he has nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.

Kikuyu: “Nyamũ ĩrĩa ĩiyĩtwo ĩngĩonekana ĩrĩ muoyo moko-inĩ make, ĩrĩ ndegwa kana ndigiri kana ngʼondu no nginya arĩhe maita meerĩ.
English: If the stolen property is found in his hand alive, whether it is ox, donkey, or sheep, he shall pay double.

Kikuyu: “Mũndũ angĩrĩithia ũhiũ wake mũgũnda wene o na kana arĩithie mũgũnda wene wa mĩthabibũ, aũrekererie ũrĩe mũgũnda wa mũndũ ũngĩ-rĩ, no nginya arĩhe na indo iria njega cia mũgũnda wake o na arĩhe na thabibũ iria njega mũno cia mũgũnda wake.
English: “If a man causes a field or vineyard to be eaten by letting his animal loose, and it grazes in another man’s field, he shall make restitution from the best of his own field, and from the best of his own vineyard.

Kikuyu: “Mwaki ũngĩtuthũka na ũcine ihinga cia mĩigua nginya ũkinyĩre itĩĩa cia ngano kana ngano ĩrũngiĩ, kana ũcine mũgũnda wothe, mwakia wa mwaki ũcio no nginya arĩhe ngano ĩyo.
English: “If fire breaks out, and catches in thorns so that the shocks of grain, or the standing grain, or the field are consumed; he who kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.

Kikuyu: “Mũndũ angĩhithia mũndũ wa itũũra rĩake betha kana indo amũigĩre-rĩ, nacio indo icio ciywo kuuma nyũmba yake, mũici ũcio angĩnyiitwo no nginya arĩhe indo icio maita meerĩ.
English: “If a man delivers to his neighbor money or stuff to keep, and it is stolen out of the man’s house, if the thief is found, he shall pay double.

Kikuyu: No mũici ũcio angĩaga kũnyiitwo, mwene nyũmba no nginya athiĩ mbere ya aciirithania nĩguo kũmenyeke kana nĩwe ũiyĩte indo icio cia mũndũ ũcio ũngĩ.
English: If the thief isn’t found, then the master of the house shall come near to God, to find out whether or not he has put his hand on his neighbor’s goods.

Kikuyu: Ha ũhoro o wothe wa mũndũ gũkorwo na kĩndũ na njĩra ĩrĩa ĩtagĩrĩire, kĩrĩ ndegwa, kana ndigiri, kana ngʼondu, kana nguo, kana kĩndũ kĩngĩ gĩothe kĩũrĩte kĩrĩa mũndũ ũngĩ angiuga atĩrĩ, ‘Kĩndũ gĩkĩ nĩ gĩakwa,’ andũ acio eerĩ no nginya marehe ũhoro wao mbere ya aciirithania. Mũndũ ũrĩa aciirithania magatua atĩ nĩehĩtie-rĩ, no nginya arĩhe mũndũ ũcio ũngĩ maita meerĩ.
English: For every matter of trespass, whether it is for ox, for donkey, for sheep, for clothing, or for any kind of lost thing, about which one says, ‘This is mine,’ the cause of both parties shall come before God. He whom God condemns shall pay double to his neighbor.

Kikuyu: “Mũndũ angĩhithia mũndũ wa itũũra rĩake ndigiri, kana ndegwa, kana ngʼondu kana nyamũ o yothe amũigĩre, nayo ĩkue, kana ĩtihio, kana ĩiywo, hatarĩ mũndũ ũroona-rĩ,
English: “If a man delivers to his neighbor a donkey, an ox, a sheep, or any animal to keep, and it dies or is injured, or driven away, no man seeing it;

Kikuyu: ũhoro ũcio wao ũgaatuuo na njĩra ya kwĩhĩta mwĩhĩtwa mbere ya Jehova atĩ ũrĩa ũhithĩtio tiwe ũiyĩte indo icio. Mwene nake etĩkĩre mwĩhĩtwa ũcio, na hatikagĩa ũhoro wa kũrĩhania.
English: the oath of Yahweh shall be between them both, he has not put his hand on his neighbor’s goods; and its owner shall accept it, and he shall not make restitution.

Kikuyu: No angĩkorwo nyamũ nĩkũiywo yaiirwo kuuma kũrĩa yahithĩtio-rĩ, no nginya mũndũ ũcio arĩhe mwene.
English: But if it is stolen from him, the one who stole shall make restitution to its owner.

Kikuyu: Angĩkorwo yatambuurirwo nĩ nyamũ cia gĩthaka, nĩakonania matigari matuĩke ũira, na ndakaarĩhio nyamũ ĩyo ĩtambuurĩtwo nĩ nyamũ.
English: If it is torn in pieces, let him bring it for evidence. He shall not make good that which was torn.

Kikuyu: “Mũndũ angĩgwatio nyamũ ya mũndũ ũngĩ, nayo ĩtihio kana ĩkue mwene atarĩ hakuhĩ, no nginya amĩrĩhe.
English: “If a man borrows anything of his neighbor’s, and it is injured, or dies, its owner not being with it, he shall surely make restitution.

Kikuyu: No nyamũ ĩyo ĩngĩkorwo ĩrĩ na mwene-rĩ, ũrĩa ũgwatĩtio ndangĩmĩrĩha. Angĩkorwo nyamũ nĩgũkomborithio yakomborithĩtio, mbeeca iria ĩkomboretwo nĩirĩhĩte hathara ĩyo.
English: If its owner is with it, he shall not make it good. If it is a leased thing, it came for its lease.

Kikuyu: “Mũndũ angiuha mũirĩtu gathirange ũtoorĩtio kũhikio, nake akome nake, no nginya arĩhe rũracio, nake mũirĩtu ũcio atuĩke mũtumia wake.
English: “If a man entices a virgin who isn’t pledged to be married, and lies with her, he shall surely pay a dowry for her to be his wife.

Kikuyu: Ithe wa mũirĩtu angĩrega biũ kũmũheana kũrĩ mũndũ ũcio, no nginya mũndũ ũcio arĩhe rũracio rwa airĩtu gathirange.
English: If her father utterly refuses to give her to him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.

Kikuyu: “Mũtigetĩkĩrie mũndũ-wa-nja mũrogi atũũre muoyo.
English: “You shall not allow a sorceress to live.

Kikuyu: “Mũndũ ũngĩgwata nyamũ no nginya ooragwo.
English: “Whoever has sex with an animal shall surely be put to death.

Kikuyu: “Mũndũ ũkaarutĩra ngai ingĩ iruta tiga Jehova nĩakaniinwo.
English: “He who sacrifices to any god, except to Yahweh only, shall be utterly destroyed.

Kikuyu: “Mũtigeke mũgeni ũũru kana mũmũhinyĩrĩrie, nĩgũkorwo o na inyuĩ mwarĩ ageni bũrũri wa Misiri.
English: “You shall not wrong an alien or oppress him, for you were aliens in the land of Egypt.

Kikuyu: “Mũtikanahinyĩrĩrie mũtumia wa ndigwa kana mwana wa ngoriai.
English: “You shall not take advantage of any widow or fatherless child.

Kikuyu: Mũngĩĩka ũguo nao mangaĩre, hatirĩ nganja nĩngaigua kĩrĩro kĩao.
English: If you take advantage of them at all, and they cry at all to me, I will surely hear their cry;

Kikuyu: Nĩngacinwo nĩ marakara, na nĩngamũũraga na rũhiũ rwa njora, nao atumia anyu matuĩke a ndigwa na ciana cianyu ituĩke cia ngoriai.
English: and my wrath will grow hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.

Kikuyu: “Ũngĩkombera mũndũ ũmwe wakwa gatagatĩ-inĩ kanyu mbeeca abatairio nĩcio-rĩ, ndũgatuĩke ta mũkombanĩri wa mbeeca; ndũkamũrĩhie uumithio wacio.
English: “If you lend money to any of my people with you who is poor, you shall not be to him as a creditor. You shall not charge him interest.

Kikuyu: Mũndũ ũngĩ angĩkũnengera nguo yake ya igũrũ ĩrũgamĩrĩre thiirĩ, mũcookerie riũa rĩtanathũa,
English: If you take your neighbor’s garment as collateral, you shall restore it to him before the sun goes down,

Kikuyu: tondũ noyo arĩ nayo ya kwĩhumbĩra. Angĩkĩĩhumbĩra nakĩ agĩkoma? Angaĩra, nĩngamũigua, nĩgũkorwo ndĩ mũigua tha.
English: for that is his only covering, it is his garment for his skin. What would he sleep in? It will happen, when he cries to me, that I will hear, for I am gracious.

Kikuyu: “Ndũkanarume Ngai kana ũrume mũnene wa andũ anyu.
English: “You shall not blaspheme God, nor curse a ruler of your people.

Kikuyu: “Ndũgacerithĩrie maruta kuuma makũmbĩ-inĩ maku kana mahihĩro-inĩ maku ma ndibei. “No nginya ũũheage marigithathi ma ariũ aku.
English: “You shall not delay to offer from your harvest and from the outflow of your presses. “You shall give the firstborn of your sons to me.

Kikuyu: Wĩkage o ũguo mwena-inĩ wĩgiĩ ngʼombe na ngʼondu ciaku. Iria ciaciarwo ũrekage igaikara na manyina mĩthenya mũgwanja, mũthenya wa ĩnana ũgacineana kũrĩ niĩ.
English: You shall do likewise with your cattle and with your sheep. It shall be with its mother seven days, then on the eighth day you shall give it to me.

Kikuyu: “Inyuĩ mũgũtuĩka andũ akwa aamũre. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio mũtikanarĩe nyama cia nyamũ ndamburange nĩ nyamũ cia gĩthaka; ciikagĩriei ngui.
English: “You shall be holy men to me, therefore you shall not eat any meat that is torn by animals in the field. You shall cast it to the dogs.

Kikuyu: “Ndũkanamemerekie ndeto cia maheeni. Ndũgateithĩrĩrie mũndũ mwaganu na ũndũ wa kũrũgamĩrĩra ũira wa maheeni.
English: “You shall not spread a false report. Don’t join your hand with the wicked to be a malicious witness.

Kikuyu: “Ndũkarũmanĩrĩre na mũingĩ gwĩka ũũru. Ũngĩruta ũira igooti-inĩ, ndũkogomie kĩhooto ũkĩnyiitanĩra na mũingĩ,
English: “You shall not follow a crowd to do evil. You shall not testify in court to side with a multitude to pervert justice.

Kikuyu: na ndũkonanie kĩmenyano harĩ mũndũ mũthĩĩni ciira-inĩ wake.
English: You shall not favor a poor man in his cause.

Kikuyu: “Ũngĩona ndegwa kana ndigiri ya mũndũ mũrĩ ũthũ nake yũrĩte-rĩ, tigĩrĩra atĩ nĩwamĩcookia kũrĩ we.
English: “If you meet your enemy’s ox or his donkey going astray, you shall surely bring it back to him again.

Kikuyu: Ũngĩona ndigiri ya mũndũ ũgũthũire ĩgwĩte ĩkaremererwo nĩ mũrigo wayo-rĩ, ndũkamĩtige hau; no nginya ũmũteithie kũmĩũkĩria.
English: If you see the donkey of him who hates you fallen down under his burden, don’t leave him. You shall surely help him with it.

Kikuyu: “Ndũkanaime andũ anyu arĩa athĩĩni kĩhooto ciira-inĩ wao.
English: “You shall not deny justice to your poor people in their lawsuits.

Kikuyu: Ndũkahutanie na thitango ya ma- heeni, na ndũkoorage mũndũ ũtarĩ na mahĩtia kana mũndũ mwĩhokeku, nĩgũkorwo ndikarekereria mũndũ mwĩhia.
English: “Keep far from a false charge, and don’t kill the innocent and righteous; for I will not justify the wicked.

Kikuyu: “Ndũkoe ihaki, nĩgũkorwo ihaki nĩrĩtũmaga arĩa monaga matuĩke atumumu, na rĩkoogomia ciugo cia andũ arĩa athingu.
English: “You shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds those who have sight and perverts the words of the righteous.

Kikuyu: “Ndũkahatĩrĩrie mũgeni; inyuĩ nĩmũũĩ ũrĩa mũgeni aiguaga, tondũ mwarĩ ageni bũrũri wa Misiri.
English: “You shall not oppress an alien, for you know the heart of an alien, since you were aliens in the land of Egypt.

Kikuyu: “Haandaga irio mĩgũnda yaku mĩaka ĩtandatũ, na ũkagetha irio iria iciarĩte mĩaka ĩyo,
English: “For six years you shall sow your land, and shall gather in its increase,

Kikuyu: no mwaka wa mũgwanja ũkarekaga mũgũnda ũikare ũguo ũtarĩmĩtwo na ũtekũhũthĩrwo. Nao arĩa athĩĩni gatagatĩ ka andũ anyu makonaga irio kuuma mũgũnda ũcio, nacio nyamũ cia gĩthaka ikarĩĩaga kĩrĩa marĩtigagia. Ĩkaga o ũguo na mũgũnda waku wa mĩthabibũ na wa mĩtamaiyũ.
English: but the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie fallow, that the poor of your people may eat; and what they leave the animal of the field shall eat. In the same way, you shall deal with your vineyard and with your olive grove.

Kikuyu: “Rutaga wĩra waku mĩthenya ĩtandatũ, no mũthenya wa mũgwanja ndũkanarute wĩra, nĩgeetha ndegwa na ndigiri yaku ihurũke, nayo ngombo ĩrĩa ĩciarĩirwo gwaku, kana mũgeni, o nao magĩage na ihinda rĩa kũnogoka.
English: “Six days you shall do your work, and on the seventh day you shall rest, that your ox and your donkey may have rest, and the son of your servant, and the alien may be refreshed.

Kikuyu: “Menyagĩrĩra wĩkage maũndũ marĩa mothe ngwĩrĩte. Ndũkanagwete marĩĩtwa ma ngai ingĩ; ndũkareke maiguuo makĩgwetwo na kanua gaku.
English: “Be careful to do all things that I have said to you; and don’t invoke the name of other gods or even let them be heard out of your mouth.

Kikuyu: “Gĩagai na gĩathĩ gĩa gũkũngũĩra maita matatũ o mwaka.
English: “You shall observe a feast to me three times a year.

Kikuyu: “Kũngũyagĩra Gĩathĩ kĩa Mĩgate Ĩtarĩ na Ndawa ya Kũimbia; handũ ha mĩthenya mũgwanja ũrĩĩage mĩgate ĩtarĩ na ndawa ya kũimbia, o ta ũrĩa ndagwaathire. Ĩkaga ũndũ ũyũ hĩndĩ ĩrĩa ĩtuĩtwo mweri-inĩ wa Abibu, tondũ nĩ mweri-inĩ ũcio woimire bũrũri wa Misiri. “Gũtikanagĩe mũndũ ũrĩũkaga mbere yakwa moko matheri.
English: You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib (for in it you came out of Egypt), and no one shall appear before me empty.

Kikuyu: “Kũngũyagĩra Gĩathĩ kĩa Magetha* na maciaro ma mbere ma irio iria ũhaandĩte mĩgũnda yaku. “Kũngũyagĩra Gĩathĩ kĩa Igetha mũthia-inĩ wa mwaka, rĩrĩa ũgũcookanĩrĩria irio ciaku kuuma mũgũnda.
English: And the feast of harvest, the first fruits of your labors, which you sow in the field; and the feast of ingathering, at the end of the year, when you gather in your labors out of the field.

Kikuyu: “Arũme othe nĩmarĩthiiaga mbere ya Mwathani Jehova maita matatũ o mwaka.
English: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord Yahweh.

Kikuyu: “Ndũkanandutĩre thakame ya igongona hamwe na kĩndũ kĩrĩ na ndawa ya kũimbia. “Maguta ma maruta makwa ma gĩathĩ matikaigwo nginya rũciinĩ.
English: “You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. The fat of my feast shall not remain all night until the morning.

Kikuyu: “Rehaga indo iria njega cia maciaro ma mbere nyũmba-inĩ ya Jehova Ngai waku. “Ndũkanaruge koori na iria rĩa nyina.†
English: You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground into the house of Yahweh your God. “You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.

Kikuyu: “Na rĩrĩ, niĩ nĩndĩratũma mũraika athiĩ mbere yanyu, amũrangĩre njĩra-inĩ na amũkinyie handũ harĩa ndĩmũhaarĩirie.
English: “Behold, I send an angel before you, to keep you by the way, and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.

Kikuyu: Iguagai na mwathĩkagĩre ũrĩa ekũmwĩra. Mũtikanamũkararie tondũ ndakamũrekera ũremi wanyu, nĩgũkorwo Rĩĩtwa rĩakwa rĩrĩ thĩinĩ wake.
English: Pay attention to him, and listen to his voice. Don’t provoke him, for he will not pardon your disobedience, for my name is in him.

Kikuyu: Mũngĩmũigua kũna ũrĩa aroiga, na mwĩke ũrĩa wothe ngaamwĩra, nĩngatuĩka thũ kũrĩ thũ cianyu, na njũkĩrĩre arĩa makaamũũkĩrĩra.
English: But if you indeed listen to his voice, and do all that I speak, then I will be an enemy to your enemies, and an adversary to your adversaries.

Kikuyu: Mũraika wakwa nĩagathiĩ mbere yanyu, na amũkinyie bũrũri wa Aamori, na Ahiti, na Aperizi, na Akaanani, na Ahivi, na Ajebusi, na niĩ nĩngamaniina biũ.
English: For my angel shall go before you, and bring you in to the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I will cut them off.

Kikuyu: Mũtikanainamĩrĩre ngai ciao, kana mũcihooe, kana mũrũmĩrĩre mĩtugo yao. No nginya mũcianange, nayo mĩhianano ya ngai ciao cia mahiga mũmiunange tũcunjĩ.
English: You shall not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor follow their practices, but you shall utterly overthrow them and demolish their pillars.

Kikuyu: Hooyagai Jehova Ngai wanyu nake, nĩarĩrathimaga irio cianyu na maaĩ manyu. Nĩndĩĩmweheragĩria mĩrimũ gatagatĩ-inĩ kanyu,
English: You shall serve Yahweh your God, and he will bless your bread and your water, and I will take sickness away from among you.

Kikuyu: na gũtirĩ mũndũ ũkaahuna kana atuĩke thaata bũrũri-inĩ wanyu. Nĩndĩĩmũkinyagĩria matukũ marĩa mwathĩrĩirio ma gũtũũra muoyo.
English: No one will miscarry or be barren in your land. I will fulfill the number of your days.

Kikuyu: “Nĩngũtũma kĩmakania gĩakwa mbere yanyu, na ndũme ndũrĩrĩ iria mũrĩĩkoragĩrĩra inyiitwo nĩ kĩrigiicano. Nĩndĩtũmaga thũ cianyu imũũragĩre.
English: I will send my terror before you, and will confuse all the people to whom you come, and I will make all your enemies turn their backs to you.

Kikuyu: Nĩngatũma magi mbere yanyu, maingate Ahivi, na Akaanani na Ahiti mamweherere.
English: I will send the hornet before you, which will drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before you.

Kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, ndikamaingata o mwaka ũmwe, tondũ bũrũri wahota gũcooka gĩthaka, nacio nyamũ cia gĩthaka imũingĩhĩre mũno.
English: I will not drive them out from before you in one year, lest the land become desolate, and the animals of the field multiply against you.

Kikuyu: Ndĩmaingataga o kahora o kahora, nginya rĩrĩa mũkaingĩha mũhote kwĩnyiitĩra bũrũri ũcio.
English: Little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you have increased and inherit the land.

Kikuyu: “Nĩngekĩra mĩhaka yanyu kuuma Iria Itune, ndĩmĩikũrũkie nginya Iria rĩa Afilisti, na kuuma werũ-inĩ nginya Rũũĩ rwa Farati. Andũ arĩa maikaraga kũu nĩngamaneana moko-inĩ manyu, na inyuĩ mũmaingate mamweherere.
English: I will set your border from the Red Sea even to the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the River; for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand, and you shall drive them out before you.

Kikuyu: Mũtikagĩe na kĩrĩkanĩro nao kana na ngai ciao.
English: You shall make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.

Kikuyu: Mũtikareke matũũre bũrũri-inĩ wanyu; nĩ tondũ no matũme mũnjĩhĩrie, nĩ tondũ kũhooya ngai icio ciao ti-itherũ nĩgũkamũtoonyia mũtego-inĩ.”
English: They shall not dwell in your land, lest they make you sin against me, for if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to you.”

Kikuyu: Nake Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ, “Ambata, ũũke kũrĩ Jehova, wee na Harũni, na Nadabu, na Abihu, na athuuri mĩrongo mũgwanja a Isiraeli, mũinamĩrĩre mũhooe mũrĩ haraaya,
English: He said to Moses, “Come up to Yahweh, you, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship from a distance.

Kikuyu: no Musa wiki ũgaakuhĩrĩria Jehova; acio angĩ matigooke hakuhĩ. Nao andũ acio angĩ a Isiraeli matikambate nawe.”
English: Moses alone shall come near to Yahweh, but they shall not come near. The people shall not go up with him.”

Kikuyu: Nake Musa agĩthiĩ na akĩĩra andũ ciugo ciothe cia Jehova na mawatho make, nao andũ magĩĩtĩkanĩria na mũgambo ũmwe, makiuga atĩrĩ, “Ũrĩa wothe Jehova oigĩte, nĩtũgwĩka.”
English: Moses came and told the people all Yahweh’s words, and all the ordinances; and all the people answered with one voice, and said, “All the words which Yahweh has spoken will we do.”

Kikuyu: Nake Musa akĩandĩka ũhoro wothe ũrĩa Jehova aarĩtie. Mũthenya ũyũ ũngĩ agĩũkĩra rũciinĩ tene, agĩaka kĩgongona magũrũ-inĩ ma kĩrĩma, na akĩrũgamia itugĩ ikũmi na igĩrĩ cia mahiga irũgamĩrĩire mĩhĩrĩga ikũmi na ĩĩrĩ ya Isiraeli.
English: Moses wrote all Yahweh’s words, then rose up early in the morning and built an altar at the base of the mountain, with twelve pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ agĩtũma aanake amwe a Isiraeli, nao makĩruta magongona ma njino, na magĩthĩnja tũtegwa tũrĩ igongona rĩa ũiguano kũrĩ Jehova.
English: He sent young men of the children of Israel, who offered burnt offerings and sacrificed peace offerings of cattle to Yahweh.

Kikuyu: Musa akĩoya nuthu ya thakame yatuo akĩmĩĩkĩra mbakũri-inĩ, na nuthu ĩrĩa ĩngĩ akĩmĩminjaminjĩria kĩgongona kĩu.
English: Moses took half of the blood and put it in basins, and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ akĩoya Ibuku rĩa Kĩrĩkanĩro, na akĩrĩthomera andũ. Nao andũ magĩĩtĩkanĩria, makiuga atĩrĩ, “Nĩtũgwĩka ũrĩa wothe Jehova oigĩte; nĩtũgwathĩka.”
English: He took the book of the covenant and read it in the hearing of the people, and they said, “We will do all that Yahweh has said, and be obedient.”

Kikuyu: Musa agĩcooka akĩoya thakame ĩyo, akĩmĩminjaminjĩria andũ, na akiuga atĩrĩ, “Ĩno nĩ thakame ya kĩrĩkanĩro kĩrĩa Jehova aarĩkanĩire na inyuĩ kũringana na ciugo ici ciothe.”
English: Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, “Look, this is the blood of the covenant, which Yahweh has made with you concerning all these words.”

Kikuyu: Musa na Harũni, na Nadabu na Abihu hamwe na athuuri acio mĩrongo mũgwanja a Isiraeli makĩambata,
English: Then Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel went up.

Kikuyu: na makĩona Ngai wa Isiraeli. Rungu rwa makinya make haarĩ handũ haakĩtwo wega na mahiga ma yakuti ya bururu, matherete o ta igũrũ rĩo rĩene.
English: They saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was like a paved work of sapphire† stone, like the skies for clearness.

Kikuyu: No Jehova ndaigana kũhũũra atongoria acio a Isiraeli; nĩmoonire Ngai, na makĩrĩa na makĩnyua.
English: He didn’t lay his hand on the nobles of the children of Israel. They saw God, and ate and drank.

Kikuyu: Nake Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ, “Ambata, ũũke kũrĩ niĩ kĩrĩma igũrũ, na ũikare ho, na nĩngũcooka ngũnengere ihengere cia mahiga, irĩ na maandĩko ma watho na maathani marĩa nyandĩkĩte nĩguo ũmarutage andũ a Isiraeli.”
English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Come up to me on the mountain, and stay here, and I will give you the stone tablets with the law and the commands that I have written, that you may teach them.”

Kikuyu: Ningĩ Musa akiumagara marĩ na mũteithĩrĩria wake Joshua, nake Musa akĩambata kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩa Ngai.
English: Moses rose up with Joshua, his servant, and Moses went up onto God’s Mountain.

Kikuyu: Akĩĩra athuuri acio atĩrĩ, “Twetererei haha nginya rĩrĩa tũgaacooka. Harũni na Huri marĩ hamwe na inyuĩ, mũndũ o wothe ũrĩa ũngĩgĩa na ciira nĩathiiage kũrĩ o.”
English: He said to the elders, “Wait here for us, until we come again to you. Behold, Aaron and Hur are with you. Whoever is involved in a dispute can go to them.”

Kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Musa aambatire kĩrĩma-inĩ, itu rĩkĩhumbĩra kĩrĩma,
English: Moses went up on the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.

Kikuyu: naguo riiri wa Jehova ũgĩikara igũrũ rĩa Kĩrĩma gĩa Sinai. Kĩrĩma gĩkĩhumbĩrwo nĩ itu rĩu mĩthenya ĩtandatũ, na mũthenya wa mũgwanja Jehova agĩĩta Musa arĩ itu-inĩ rĩu.
English: Yahweh’s glory settled on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days. The seventh day he called to Moses out of the middle of the cloud.

Kikuyu: andũ a Isiraeli moonaga riiri wa Jehova ũtariĩ ta mwaki wa kũniinana ũrĩ kĩrĩma igũrũ.
English: The appearance of Yahweh’s glory was like devouring fire on the top of the mountain in the eyes of the children of Israel.

Kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo Musa agĩtoonya itu-inĩ o akĩambataga kĩrĩma. Agĩikara kũu kĩrĩma-inĩ matukũ mĩrongo ĩna, ũtukũ na mũthenya.
English: Moses entered into the middle of the cloud, and went up on the mountain; and Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights.

Kikuyu: Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ,
English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

Kikuyu: “Ĩra andũ a Isiraeli mandehere iruta. Nĩwe ũkwamũkĩra iruta rĩu handũ hakwa kuuma kũrĩ mũndũ o wothe ũrĩa ngoro yake ĩkwenda kũheana.
English: “Speak to the children of Israel, that they take an offering for me. From everyone whose heart makes him willing you shall take my offering.

Kikuyu: Maruta marĩa ũrĩamũkagĩra kuuma kũrĩ o nĩmo maya: thahabu, na betha na gĩcango;
English: This is the offering which you shall take from them: gold, silver, bronze,

Kikuyu: na ndigi cia rangi wa bururu, na cia rangi wa ndathi, na cia rangi mũtune ta gakarakũ, na gatani ĩrĩa njega, o na guoya wa mbũri;
English: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,

Kikuyu: na njũa cia ndũrũme itoboketio rangi-inĩ mũtune, na njũa cia pomboo, na mbaũ cia mũgaa;
English: rams’ skins dyed red, sea cow hides,† acacia wood,

Kikuyu: na maguta ma mũtamaiyũ ma gwakia tawa; na mahuti manungi wega ma gũthondeka maguta ma gũitanĩrĩrio, na ũbumba ũrĩa mũnungi wega;
English: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,

Kikuyu: na tũhiga twa onigithi, na tũhiga tũngĩ twa goro twa gwĩkĩrwo ebodi- inĩ na gakuo ga gĩthũri.*
English: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.

Kikuyu: “Ningĩ ũnjakithĩrie handũ haamũre, na niĩ nĩngatũũranagia nao.
English: Let them make me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them.

Kikuyu: Thondekai hema ĩno nyamũre, na mwĩkĩre indo cia thĩinĩ kũringana na mũhano ũrĩa ngũkuonia.
English: According to all that I show you, the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all of its furniture, even so you shall make it.

Kikuyu: “Nĩmathondekere ithandũkũ rĩa mbaũ cia mũgaa. Ũraihu warĩo ũkorwo ũrĩ mĩkono ĩĩrĩ na nuthu,† na kwarama kwarĩo gũkorwo kũrĩ mũkono ũmwe na nuthu,‡ na kũraiha na igũrũ kwarĩo gũkorwo nĩ mũkono ũmwe na nuthu.
English: “They shall make an ark of acacia wood. Its length shall be two and a half cubits,‡ its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.

Kikuyu: Ithandũkũ rĩu rĩgemio na thahabu therie mĩena yeerĩ nja na thĩinĩ, na mũrĩtirihe na mũcibi wa thahabu mĩena yothe.
English: You shall overlay it with pure gold. You shall overlay it inside and outside, and you shall make a gold molding around it.

Kikuyu: Rĩtwekerie icũhĩ inya cia thahabu, na ũcioherere magũrũ-inĩ marĩo mana, icũhĩ igĩrĩ mwena ũmwe na icũhĩ igĩrĩ mwena ũrĩa ũngĩ.
English: You shall cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in its four feet. Two rings shall be on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.

Kikuyu: Ũcooke ũthondeke mĩtĩ mĩraaya ya mũgaa ũmĩgemie na thahabu.
English: You shall make poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.

Kikuyu: Toonyia mĩtĩ ĩyo mĩraaya icũhĩ- inĩ iria irĩ mĩena ya ithandũkũ nĩgeetha rĩkuuĩkage.
English: You shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry the ark.

Kikuyu: Mĩtĩ ĩyo mĩraaya ĩrekwo ĩikarage icũhĩ-inĩ cia ithandũkũ rĩĩrĩ, na ndĩkeheragio.
English: The poles shall be in the rings of the ark. They shall not be taken from it.

Kikuyu: Ũcooke wĩkĩre thĩinĩ wa ithandũkũ rĩu Ũira, ũrĩa ngũkũhe.
English: You shall put the covenant which I shall give you into the ark.

Kikuyu: “Thondeka gĩtĩ gĩa tha gĩa thahabu therie, gĩkorwo kĩrĩ kĩa ũraihu wa mĩkono ĩĩrĩ na nuthu,§ na wariĩ wa mũkono ũmwe na nuthu.*
English: You shall make a mercy seat of pure gold. Two and a half cubits shall be its length, and a cubit and a half its width.

Kikuyu: Na ũture makerubi meerĩ ma thahabu, ũmekĩre mĩthia-inĩ ya gĩtĩ kĩu gĩa tha.
English: You shall make two cherubim of hammered gold. You shall make them at the two ends of the mercy seat.

Kikuyu: Thondeka ikerubi rĩmwe rĩikare mũthia-inĩ ũmwe, na ikerubi rĩu rĩngĩ rĩikare mũthia-inĩ ũrĩa ũngĩ wa gĩtĩ gĩa tha; thondeka makerubi macio maanyiitanĩte na gĩtĩ gĩa tha mĩthia- inĩ yeerĩ.
English: Make one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. You shall make the cherubim on its two ends of one piece with the mercy seat.

Kikuyu: Makerubi macio makorwo matambũrũkĩtie mathagu mamo na igũrũ, magathiĩka gĩtĩ kĩu gĩa tha namo. Makerubi macio makorwo maroranĩte, na marorete gĩtĩ kĩu gĩa tha.
English: The cherubim shall spread out their wings upward, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim shall be toward the mercy seat.

Kikuyu: Igĩrĩra gĩtĩ kĩu gĩa tha igũrũ rĩa ithandũkũ, na wĩkĩre thĩinĩ wa ithandũkũ rĩu Ũira ũrĩa ngũkũhe.
English: You shall put the mercy seat on top of the ark, and in the ark you shall put the covenant that I will give you.

Kikuyu: Na hau igũrũ wa gĩtĩ gĩa tha, gatagatĩ ka makerubi macio meerĩ marĩ igũrũ wa ithandũkũ rĩa Ũira nĩngacemania nawe ngũhe maathani makwa mothe nĩ ũndũ wa andũ a Isiraeli.
English: There I will meet with you, and I will tell you from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim which are on the ark of the covenant, all that I command you for the children of Israel.

Kikuyu: “Thondeka metha na mbaũ cia mũgaa, ũraihu wayo ũkorwo ũrĩ wa mĩkono ĩĩrĩ,† na wariĩ wayo ũkorwo ũrĩ wa mũkono ũmwe,‡ na kũraiha na igũrũ ĩkorwo ĩrĩ na mũkono ũmwe na nuthu.§
English: “You shall make a table of acacia wood. Its length shall be two cubits, and its width a cubit, and its height one and a half cubits.

Kikuyu: Ũmĩgemie na thahabu therie, na ũmĩtirihe na mũcibi wa thahabu.
English: You shall overlay it with pure gold, and make a gold molding around it.

Kikuyu: Mĩthondekere karũbaũ gaceke ka wariĩ wa rũhĩ* gathiũrũrũkĩrie metha ĩyo, na ũgatirihe na mũcibi wa thahabu.
English: You shall make a rim of a hand width around it. You shall make a golden molding on its rim around it.

Kikuyu: Thondekera metha ĩyo icũhĩ inya cia thahabu, ũcioherere koona-inĩ iria inya o harĩa magũrũ macio mana marĩ.
English: You shall make four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that are on its four feet.

Kikuyu: Icũhĩ icio ikorwo irĩ hakuhĩ na mũcibi wa karũbaũ karĩa gaceke, nĩgeetha inyiitagĩrĩre mĩtĩ ĩrĩa ya gũkuuaga metha ĩyo.
English: The rings shall be close to the rim, for places for the poles to carry the table.

Kikuyu: Thondeka mĩtĩ mĩraaya ya mbaũ cia mũgaa, ũmĩgemie na thahabu na ũkuuage metha nayo.
English: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be carried with them.

Kikuyu: Na ũthondeke thaani ciayo, na thaani nene cia thahabu therie na ndigithũ, na mbakũri cia gũitaga maruta.
English: You shall make its dishes, its spoons, its ladles, and its bowls with which to pour out offerings. You shall make them of pure gold.

Kikuyu: Iga mĩgate ĩrĩa ĩigagwo mbere yakwa igũrũ rĩa metha ĩyo, nayo ĩikarage hau mbere yakwa mahinda mothe.
English: You shall set bread of the presence on the table before me always.

Kikuyu: “Thondeka mũtĩ wa kũigĩrĩrwo matawa ma thahabu therie, kĩrũgamo o na gĩtina kĩaguo iturwo inyiitanĩte; ikombe ciaguo ihaana ta mahũa, na tũkonyo twaguo o na mahũa ikorwo irĩ kĩndũ kĩmwe inyiitanĩte naguo.
English: “You shall make a lamp stand of pure gold. The lamp stand shall be made of hammered work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers shall be of one piece with it.

Kikuyu: Honge ithathatũ ciumĩre mĩena-inĩ ya mũrũgamo wa mũtĩ ũcio wa kũigĩrĩrwo matawa, ithatũ mwena ũmwe na ithatũ mwena ũrĩa ũngĩ.
English: There shall be six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side;

Kikuyu: Ikombe ithatũ iturĩtwo na mũhiano wa mahũa ma mũrothi irĩ na tũkonyo na mahũa ikorwo irĩ rũhonge-inĩ rũmwe, nacio ithatũ ikorwo rũu rũngĩ; honge icio ciothe ithathatũ ikorwo ihaana o ũguo, ciumĩte mũtĩ-inĩ ũcio wa kũigĩrĩrwo matawa.
English: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower; and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower, so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand;

Kikuyu: Na mũtĩ-inĩ ũcio wa kũigĩrĩra matawa hagĩe ikombe inya cia mũhiano wa mahũa ma mũrothi irĩ na tũkonyo na mahũa.
English: and in the lamp stand four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;

Kikuyu: Gakonyo kamwe gakorwo karĩ rungu rwa honge cia mbere igĩrĩ ciumĩte mũrũgamo-inĩ wa mũtĩ ũcio wa kũigĩrĩrwo matawa, nako gakonyo ga keerĩ kagĩe rungu rwa honge cia keerĩ igĩrĩ, nako gakonyo ga gatatũ kagĩe thĩ wa honge cia gatatũ igĩrĩ, ciothe nĩ honge ithathatũ.
English: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.

Kikuyu: Tũkonyo tũu na honge icio ikorwo irĩ kĩndũ kĩmwe na mũtĩ ũcio wa kũigĩrĩrwo matawa, iturĩtwo na thahabu therie.
English: Their buds and their branches shall be of one piece with it, all of it one beaten work of pure gold.

Kikuyu: “Ningĩ ũthondeke matawa mũgwanja maguo na ũmaigĩrĩre igũrũ rĩaguo nĩgeetha mamũrĩke hau mbere ya guo.
English: You shall make its lamps seven, and they shall light its lamps to give light to the space in front of it.

Kikuyu: Magathĩ ma gũtinia ndaambĩ na thaani cia mũrarĩ wa ndaambĩ ikorwo irĩ cia thahabu therie.
English: Its snuffers and its snuff dishes shall be of pure gold.

Kikuyu: Taranda† ya thahabu therie ĩhũthĩrwo gũthondeka mũtĩ wa kũigĩrĩrwo matawa o na indo icio ciothe.
English: It shall be made of a talent§ of pure gold, with all these accessories.

Kikuyu: Ũtigĩrĩre atĩ nĩwacithondeka kũringana na mũhianĩre ũrĩa wonirio ũrĩ kĩrĩma-inĩ.
English: See that you make them after their pattern, which has been shown to you on the mountain.

Kikuyu: “Thondeka hema nyamũre ĩrĩ na itambaya ikũmi cia gũcuurio itumĩtwo na gatani yogothetwo wega ya ndigi cia rangi wa bururu, na cia rangi wa ndathi, na cia rangi mũtune ta gakarakũ, na igemio na makerubi nĩ mũtumi mũũgĩ na wĩra ũcio.
English: “Moreover you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, with cherubim. You shall make them with the work of a skillful workman.

Kikuyu: Itambaya icio cia gũcuurio ciothe ikorwo ciiganaine, mĩkono mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na ĩnana* kũraiha na mĩkono ĩna† kwarama.
English: The length of each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits,† and the width of each curtain four cubits: all the curtains shall have one measure.

Kikuyu: Itambaya ithano-rĩ, itumanio hamwe, na icio ingĩ ithano itumanio hamwe.
English: Five curtains shall be coupled together to one another, and the other five curtains shall be coupled to one another.

Kikuyu: Kundĩka ciana cia gĩtambaya kĩa rangi wa bururu mũthia-inĩ wa gĩtambaya gĩa gũcuurio kĩrĩa kĩrĩ mũico wa mwena ũmwe, na wĩke o ro ũguo harĩ gĩtambaya kĩa mũico kĩa mwena ũcio ũngĩ.
English: You shall make loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling, and you shall do likewise on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the second coupling.

Kikuyu: Kundĩka ciana mĩrongo ĩtano gĩtambaya-inĩ kĩmwe gĩa gũcuurio, na ingĩ mĩrongo ĩtano gĩtambaya-inĩ kĩa mũico kĩa mwena ũcio ũngĩ, na ũringithanie o kĩana na kĩrĩa kĩngĩ.
English: You shall make fifty loops in the one curtain, and you shall make fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that is in the second coupling. The loops shall be opposite one another.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ ũthondeke ngathĩka mĩrongo ĩtano cia thahabu, na ũcihũthĩre na kuohithania itambaya icio cia gũcuurio nĩguo hema ĩyo nyamũre ĩtuĩke kĩndũ kĩmwe.
English: You shall make fifty clasps of gold, and couple the curtains to one another with the clasps. The tabernacle shall be a unit.

Kikuyu: “Tuma itambaya ikũmi na kĩmwe cia guoya wa mbũri ituĩke hema ya kũhumbĩra hema ĩrĩa nyamũre.
English: “You shall make curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. You shall make eleven curtains.

Kikuyu: Itambaya icio ciothe ikũmi na kĩmwe ikorwo ciiganaine, ikorwo irĩ mĩkono mĩrongo ĩtatũ‡ kũraiha na mĩkono ĩna§ kwarama.
English: The length of each curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits: the eleven curtains shall have one measure.

Kikuyu: Tumania itambaya ithano cia icio cia gũcuurio ituĩke kĩndũ kĩmwe, nacio icio ingĩ ithathatũ itumanio hamwe. Kũnja gĩtambaya gĩa gatandatũ maita meerĩ mwena wa mbere wa hema.
English: You shall couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shall double over the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tent.

Kikuyu: Kundĩka ciana mĩrongo ĩtano mũthia-inĩ wa itambaya cia gũcuurio cia mwena ũmwe, ningĩ wĩke o ũguo mũthia-inĩ wa itambaya icio cia mwena ũrĩa ũngĩ.
English: You shall make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outermost in the coupling, and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which is outermost in the second coupling.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ ũthondeke ngathĩka mĩrongo ĩtano cia gĩcango, na ũcitoonyie ciana-inĩ nĩgeetha hema ĩyo ĩtuĩke kĩndũ kĩmwe.
English: You shall make fifty clasps of bronze, and put the clasps into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.

Kikuyu: Harĩ ũraihu wa gĩtambaya gĩa gũcuurio ũrĩa ũngĩtigara, nuthu ya gĩtambaya kĩrĩa gĩtigaire nĩ gĩcunjuure mwena wa thuutha wa hema ĩyo nyamũre.
English: The overhanging part that remains of the curtains of the tent—the half curtain that remains—shall hang over the back of the tabernacle.

Kikuyu: Itambaya cia gũcuurio cia hema ikorwo iraihĩte kũrĩ icio ingĩ na mũkono ũmwe* mĩena yeerĩ; kĩrĩa gĩgũtigara gĩcunjuure kĩhumbĩre mĩena ya hema ĩyo nyamũre.
English: The cubit on the one side and the cubit on the other side, of that which remains in the length of the curtains of the tent, shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.

Kikuyu: Thondekera hema ĩyo kĩandarũa kĩa njũa cia ndũrũme itoboketio rangi-inĩ mũtune igatunĩha, na igũrũ wakĩo ũkĩhumbĩre na njũa cia pomboo.
English: You shall make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.

Kikuyu: “Thondeka mbaũ cia kũrũgama cia mũtĩ wa mũgaa cia gwaka hema ĩyo nyamũre.
English: “You shall make the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing upright.

Kikuyu: O rũbaũ-inĩ rũkorwo rũrĩ rwa mĩkono ikũmi† kũraiha na mũkono ũmwe na nuthu‡ kwarama,
English: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and one and a half cubits the width of each board.

Kikuyu: mbaũ icio igĩe na tũhocio tũcomokete tũigananĩirie. Thondeka mbaũ icio ciothe cia Hema-ĩrĩa-Nyamũre na njĩra ĩyo.
English: There shall be two tenons in each board, joined to one another: thus you shall make for all the boards of the tabernacle.

Kikuyu: Thondeka mbaũ mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ cia mwena wa gũthini wa hema ĩyo nyamũre,
English: You shall make twenty boards for the tabernacle, for the south side southward.

Kikuyu: na ũthondeke itina cia betha mĩrongo ĩna cia gũikarĩrwo nĩ mbaũ icio mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ, o rũbaũ rũmwe rũgaikarĩra itina igĩrĩ, o rũmwe rũkorwo rũrĩ rungu rwa kahocio.
English: You shall make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ mwena ũcio ũngĩ, mwena wa gathigathini wa hema ĩyo nyamũre, thondeka mbaũ mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ
English: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, twenty boards,

Kikuyu: na itina mĩrongo ĩna cia betha o igĩrĩ igaikarĩrwo nĩ rũbaũ rũmwe.
English: and their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

Kikuyu: Thondeka mbaũ ithathatũ cia mwena wa na thuutha, nĩguo mwena wa mũthia wa ithũĩro wa hema ĩyo nyamũre,
English: For the far side of the tabernacle westward you shall make six boards.

Kikuyu: na ũthondeke mbaũ igĩrĩ cia koine cia mwena wa na thuutha.
English: You shall make two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far side.

Kikuyu: Koine-inĩ icio cierĩ no nginya ikorwo irĩ mbaũ igĩrĩ igĩrĩ kuuma thĩ nginya igũrũ, na ciohanio na mũrĩnga ũmwe; koine cierĩ igakorwo itariĩ ũguo.
English: They shall be double beneath, and in the same way they shall be whole to its top to one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio hegũkorwo na mbaũ inyanya, na itina ikũmi na ithathatũ cia betha, o igĩrĩ igaikarĩrwo nĩ rũbaũ rũmwe.
English: There shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

Kikuyu: “Ningĩ ũthondeke mĩgamba ya mbaũ cia mũgaa: ĩtano yayo nĩ ũndũ wa mbaũ cia mwena ũmwe wa hema ĩyo nyamũre,
English: “You shall make bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

Kikuyu: na ĩtano nĩ ũndũ wa mbaũ cia mwena ũcio ũngĩ, na ĩtano nĩ ũndũ wa mbaũ cia mwena wa ithũĩro mũthia-inĩ ũrĩa wa na thuutha wa hema ĩyo nyamũre.
English: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the far side westward.

Kikuyu: Mũgamba wa gatagatĩ uume mũthia ũmwe nginya ũrĩa ũngĩ, ũgereire gatagatĩ ka mbaũ icio.
English: The middle bar in the middle of the boards shall pass through from end to end.

Kikuyu: Gemia mbaũ icio na thahabu, na ũthondeke mĩrĩnga ya thahabu ya kũnyiitĩrĩra mĩgamba ĩyo. O nayo mĩgamba ĩyo nĩĩgemio na thahabu.
English: You shall overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars. You shall overlay the bars with gold.

Kikuyu: “Aka hema ĩyo nyamũre kũringana na mũhianĩre ũrĩa wonirio rĩrĩa warĩ kĩrĩma-inĩ.
English: You shall set up the tabernacle according to the way that it was shown to you on the mountain.

Kikuyu: “Tuma gĩtambaya gĩa gũcuurio kĩa ndigi cia rangi wa bururu, na cia rangi wa ndathi na cia rangi mũtune ta gakarakũ, na cia gatani ĩrĩa yogothetwo wega na ĩkagemio na makerubi nĩ mũbundi mũũgĩ.
English: “You shall make a veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. It shall be the work of a skillful workman.

Kikuyu: Cuuria gĩtambaya kĩu na tũcuurio twa thahabu ikĩngĩ-inĩ inya cia mũgaa iria igemetio na thahabu, na ikarũgama igũrũ rĩa njikarĩro inya cia betha.
English: You shall hang it on four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold; their hooks shall be of gold, on four sockets of silver.

Kikuyu: Cuuria gĩtambaya kĩu gĩa gũcuurio na ngathĩka, na ũcooke ũige ithandũkũ rĩa Ũira thuutha wa gĩtambaya kĩu gĩa gũcuurio. Gĩtambaya kĩu gĩa gũcuurio kĩhakanie Handũ-harĩa-Hatheru na Handũ-harĩa-Hatheru-Mũno.§
English: You shall hang up the veil under the clasps, and shall bring the ark of the covenant in there within the veil. The veil shall separate the holy place from the most holy for you.

Kikuyu: Igĩrĩra gĩtĩ gĩa tha igũrũ rĩa ithandũkũ rĩa Ũira thĩinĩ wa Handũ-harĩa-Hatheru-Mũno.
English: You shall put the mercy seat on the ark of the covenant in the most holy place.

Kikuyu: Iga metha nja ya gĩtambaya kĩu gĩa gũcuurio mwena wa gathigathini wa hema ĩyo nyamũre, naguo mũtĩ wa kũigĩrĩra matawa ũũige mwena wa gũthini ũngʼethanĩre na metha ĩyo.
English: You shall set the table outside the veil, and the lamp stand opposite the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south. You shall put the table on the north side.

Kikuyu: “Itoonyero-inĩ rĩa hema, thondeka gĩtambaya gĩa gũcuurio kĩa rangi wa bururu, na rangi wa ndathi, na rangi mũtune ta gakarakũ, na gatani ĩrĩa yogothetwo wega, kĩgemetio nĩ mũgemia mũũgĩ.
English: “You shall make a screen for the door of the Tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer.

Kikuyu: Thondekera gĩtambaya kĩu gĩa gũcuurio tũcuurio twa thahabu na itugĩ ithano cia mũgaa igemetio na thahabu. Na ũcitwekerie itina ithano cia gĩcango.
English: You shall make for the screen five pillars of acacia, and overlay them with gold. Their hooks shall be of gold. You shall cast five sockets of bronze for them.

Kikuyu: “Aka kĩgongona na mbaũ cia mũgaa, kĩa mĩkono ĩtatũ* kũraiha na igũrũ; gĩkorwo kĩiganaine mĩena yothe, mĩkono ĩtano† kũraiha na mĩkono ĩtano kwarama.
English: “You shall make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits† long, and five cubits wide. The altar shall be square. Its height shall be three cubits.‡

Kikuyu: Thondeka hĩa inya, o rũmwe koine- inĩ ĩmwe ya kĩgongona, nĩgeetha hĩa icio na kĩgongona ikorwo irĩ kĩndũ kĩmwe, nakĩo kĩgongona kĩu ũkĩgemie na gĩcango.
English: You shall make its horns on its four corners. Its horns shall be of one piece with it. You shall overlay it with bronze.

Kikuyu: Thondeka indo ciothe cia kĩgongona irĩ cia gĩcango, ũgĩthondekere nyũngũ cia kũrutaga mũhu, na icakũri na mbakũri cia gwĩkĩrwo thakame ya kũminjaminja, na njibe cia kũnyiita nyama, na ngĩo cia mwaki.
English: You shall make its pots to take away its ashes; and its shovels, its basins, its meat hooks, and its fire pans. You shall make all its vessels of bronze.

Kikuyu: Thondekera kĩgongona kĩu gĩtara, na ningĩ ũthondeke mũkwa wa gĩcango, na ũthondeke mĩrĩnga ya gĩcango, o ũmwe wĩkĩrwo koine-inĩ iria inya cia mũkwa ũcio.
English: You shall make a grating for it of network of bronze. On the net you shall make four bronze rings in its four corners.

Kikuyu: Ũige gĩtara kĩu rungu wa muoho wa kĩgongona nĩgeetha rũkinye nuthu ya ũraihu wa kĩgongona.
English: You shall put it under the ledge around the altar beneath, that the net may reach halfway up the altar.

Kikuyu: Thondeka itugĩ cia mũgaa nĩ ũndũ wa kĩgongona na ũcigemie na gĩcango.
English: You shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with bronze.

Kikuyu: Itugĩ icio itoonyio mĩrĩnga-inĩ ĩyo nĩgeetha ĩgakoragwo ĩikarĩire mĩena-inĩ yeerĩ ya kĩgongona hĩndĩ ya gũgĩkuua.
English: Its poles shall be put into the rings, and the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar when carrying it.

Kikuyu: Thondeka kĩgongona kĩu na mbaũ nĩguo kĩgĩe na irima gatagatĩ. Ũgĩthondeke o ta ũrĩa wonirio rĩrĩa warĩ kĩrĩma-inĩ.
English: You shall make it hollow with planks. They shall make it as it has been shown you on the mountain.

Kikuyu: “Thondeka nja ya hema ĩrĩa nyamũre; mwena wa gũthini ũkorwo ũrĩ wa mĩkono igana‡ kũraiha na ũgĩe na itambaya cia gũcuurio cia gatani ũrĩa mwogothe wega,
English: “You shall make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen one hundred cubits long for one side.

Kikuyu: ũkorwo na itugĩ mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na itina mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ cia gĩcango, irĩ na tũcuurio na tũmĩkwa twa betha itugĩ-inĩ.
English: Its pillars shall be twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.

Kikuyu: Mwena wa gathigathini o naguo ũkorwo ũrĩ na mĩkono igana kũraiha na ũgĩe na itambaya cia gũcuurio, ũgĩe na itugĩ mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na itina mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ cia gĩcango, irĩ na tũcuurio na tũmĩkwa twa betha itugĩ-inĩ.
English: Likewise for the length of the north side, there shall be hangings one hundred cubits long, and its pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

Kikuyu: “Mwena wa ithũĩro wa nja ĩyo ũkorwo ũrĩ wa mĩkono mĩrongo ĩtano§ kwarama na ũgĩe na itambaya cia gũcuurio na itugĩ ikũmi na itina ikũmi.
English: For the width of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.

Kikuyu: Mwena wa irathĩro, kwerekera kũrĩa riũa rĩrathagĩra, nja ĩyo ĩkorwo ĩrĩ ya wariĩ wa mĩkono mĩrongo ĩtano.
English: The width of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.

Kikuyu: Itambaya cia gũcuurio ikorwo irĩ cia ũraihu wa mĩkono ikũmi na ĩtano* na ikorwo irĩ mwena ũmwe wa itoonyero rĩa nja ĩyo, na ikorwo na itugĩ ithatũ na itina ithatũ,
English: The hangings for the one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

Kikuyu: na itambaya ingĩ cia gũcuurio cia ũraihu wa mĩkono ikũmi na ĩtano ikorwo mwena ũcio ũngĩ wa itoonyero, na ikorwo irĩ na itugĩ ithatũ na itina ithatũ.
English: For the other side shall be hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

Kikuyu: “Naguo ũhoro wa itoonyero rĩa nja ĩyo, wĩkĩre gĩtambaya gĩa gũcuurio gĩkorwo kĩrĩ kĩa ũraihu wa mĩkono mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ,† kĩa ndigi cia rangi wa bururu, na cia rangi wa ndathi, na cia rangi mũtune ta gakarakũ, na gatani ĩrĩa yogothetwo wega, wĩra wa mũgemia mũũgĩ, na gĩkorwo na itugĩ inya na itina inya.
English: For the gate of the court shall be a screen of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer; their pillars four, and their sockets four.

Kikuyu: Itugĩ ciothe gũthiũrũrũkĩria nja ĩyo, igĩe na tũmĩkwa na tũcuurio twa betha na itina cia gĩcango.
English: All the pillars of the court around shall be filleted with silver; their hooks of silver, and their sockets of bronze.

Kikuyu: Nja ĩyo ĩkorwo na ũraihu wa mĩkono igana,‡ na mĩkono mĩrongo ĩtano kwarama,§ na ĩkorwo na itambaya cia gũcuurio cia gatani yogothetwo wega ya mĩkono ĩtano kũraiha na igũrũ, na ĩrĩ na itina cia gĩcango.
English: The length of the court shall be one hundred cubits, and the width fifty throughout, and the height five cubits, of fine twined linen, and their sockets of bronze.

Kikuyu: Indo iria ingĩ ciothe cia gũtũmĩrwo wĩra-inĩ wa hema ĩrĩa nyamũre, irĩ cia wĩra o na ũrĩkũ, o hamwe na higĩ cia kwamba hema na cia nja ciothe, nĩikorwo irĩ cia gĩcango.
English: All the instruments of the tabernacle in all its service, and all its pins, and all the pins of the court, shall be of bronze.

Kikuyu: “Atha andũ a Isiraeli makũrehere maguta marĩa makeere wega ma ndamaiyũ hihe ma gũkũheaga ũtheri, nĩgeetha matawa maikarage maakanĩte.
English: “You shall command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.

Kikuyu: Thĩinĩ wa Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo, nja ya gĩtambaya gĩa gũcuurio kĩrĩa kĩrĩ mbere ya ithandũkũ rĩa Ũira, Harũni na ariũ ake nĩmaigage matawa maakanĩte mbere ya Jehova kuuma hwaĩ-inĩ o nginya rũciinĩ. Ũndũ ũyũ ũtuĩke watho wa kũrũmagĩrĩrwo tene na tene thĩinĩ wa Isiraeli njiarwa-inĩ ciothe iria igooka.
English: In the Tent of Meeting, outside the veil which is before the covenant, Aaron and his sons shall keep it in order from evening to morning before Yahweh: it shall be a statute forever throughout their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.

Kikuyu: “Tũmanĩra Harũni mũrũ wa nyũkwa oke harĩwe kuuma gatagatĩ ka andũ a Isiraeli, hamwe na ariũ ake Nadabu na Abihu, na Eleazaru na Ithamaru, nĩgeetha mandungatagĩre marĩ athĩnjĩri-Ngai.
English: “Bring Aaron your brother, and his sons with him, near to you from among the children of Israel, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office: Aaron, with Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar, Aaron’s sons.

Kikuyu: Tumĩra Harũni mũrũ wa nyũkwa nguo nyamũre, cia kũmũnenehagia na kũmũtĩĩithagia.
English: You shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, for glory and for beauty.

Kikuyu: Arĩria mabundi marĩa marĩ na ũũgĩ wa gũtuma, nguo arĩa niĩ heete ũũgĩ maũndũ-inĩ ta macio, nĩguo matumĩre Harũni nguo cia kwĩhumba akĩamũrwo, nĩguo andungatagĩre arĩ mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai.
English: You shall speak to all who are wise-hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they make Aaron’s garments to sanctify him, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.

Kikuyu: Nacio ici nĩcio nguo iria megũtuma: gakuo ga gĩthũri, na ebodi, na nguo ndaaya, na kanjũ ya taama ngʼemie wega, na kĩremba, na mũcibi. Nguo ici nyamũre megũcitumĩra Harũni mũrũ wa nyũkwa na ariũ ake nĩguo mandungatagĩre marĩ athĩnjĩri-Ngai.
English: These are the garments which they shall make: a breastplate, an ephod, a robe, a fitted tunic, a turban, and a sash. They shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother and his sons, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.

Kikuyu: Nĩ mahũthĩre thahabu, na ndigi cia rangi wa bururu, na cia rangi wa ndathi, na cia rangi mũtune ta gakarakũ, hamwe na gatani ĩrĩa njega.
English: They shall use the gold, and the blue, and the purple, and the scarlet, and the fine linen.

Kikuyu: “Tuma ebodi ya ndigi cia rangi wa thahabu na ndigi cia rangi wa bururu, na cia rangi wa ndathi na cia rangi mũtune ta gakarakũ na ya gatani ĩrĩa yogothetwo wega, wĩra wa mũbundi mũũgĩ.
English: “They shall make the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the skillful workman.

Kikuyu: Nĩ wega ebodi ĩyo ĩgĩe na tũmĩkwa twĩrĩ twa kũmĩnyiitithanĩria ciande-inĩ, tũtumĩrĩirwo mĩthia-inĩ yeerĩ yayo nĩgeetha ndaamĩ ciayo cierĩ inyiitane.
English: It shall have two shoulder straps joined to the two ends of it, that it may be joined together.

Kikuyu: Naguo mũcibi wayo wa njohero ũrĩa mũtume wega ũkorwo ũhaana tayo na ũrĩ wa gĩcunjĩ kĩmwe na ebodi ĩyo na ũthondeketwo na ndigi cia rangi wa thahabu, na ndigi cia rangi wa bururu, na cia rangi wa ndathi, na cia rangi mũtune ta gakarakũ, hamwe na gatani njogothe wega.
English: The skillfully woven band, which is on it, shall be like its work and of the same piece; of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.

Kikuyu: “Oya tũhiga twĩrĩ twa onigithi ũkurure marĩĩtwa ma ariũ a Isiraeli igũrũ rĩatuo
English: You shall take two onyx stones, and engrave on them the names of the children of Israel.

Kikuyu: marũmanĩrĩire ũrĩa maaciarirwo, ũkurure marĩĩtwa matandatũ kahiga-inĩ kamwe, na matandatũ kau kangĩ.
English: Six of their names on the one stone, and the names of the six that remain on the other stone, in the order of their birth.

Kikuyu: Kurura marĩĩtwa ma ariũ a Isiraeli tũhiga-inĩ tũu twĩrĩ ta ũrĩa mũrengi wa tũhiga twa goro akururaga kahengere ga gwĩkĩra mũhũũri. Ũcooke ũtũtumĩrĩre tũkonyo-inĩ twa thahabu,
English: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, you shall engrave the two stones, according to the names of the children of Israel. You shall make them to be enclosed in settings of gold.

Kikuyu: na ũtuoherere ndaamĩ-inĩ cia kĩande cia ebodi, tũrĩ tũhiga twa kĩririkania kĩa ariũ a Isiraeli. Harũni nĩarĩkuuaga marĩĩtwa macio ciande-inĩ ciake matuĩke kĩririkania mbere ya Jehova.
English: You shall put the two stones on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel. Aaron shall bear their names before Yahweh on his two shoulders for a memorial.

Kikuyu: Thondeka tũkonyo tũgemu twa thahabu
English: You shall make settings of gold,

Kikuyu: na irengeeri igĩrĩ cia thahabu therie, ihaana ta mũkanda, nacio ũcinyiitithanie na tũkonyo tũu.
English: and two chains of pure gold; you shall make them like cords of braided work. You shall put the braided chains on the settings.

Kikuyu: “Thondekithia gakuo ga gĩthũri ga gwĩkagĩrwo ituĩro-inĩ rĩa ciira, nako gatumwo nĩ mũtumi mũũgĩ. Gathondeke ta ebodi: karĩ ka ndigi cia rangi wa thahabu na ka ndigi cia rangi wa bururu, na cia rangi wa ndathi, na cia rangi mũtune ta gakarakũ na gatani ĩrĩa yogothetwo wega.
English: “You shall make a breastplate of judgment, the work of the skillful workman; like the work of the ephod you shall make it; of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, you shall make it.

Kikuyu: Gakuo kau gakorwo kaiganaine mĩena yothe ĩna inji kenda* kũraiha na inji kenda kwarama, na koinanĩrwo maita meerĩ.
English: It shall be square and folded double; a span† shall be its length, and a span its width.

Kikuyu: Ũcooke ũgatumĩrĩre mĩhari ĩna ya tũhiga twa goro. Mũhari wa mbere hakorwo kahiga ka wakiki ũrĩa mũtune, na ka yakuti ĩrĩa ĩhaana ngoikoni, na ka baregethu;
English: You shall set in it settings of stones, four rows of stones: a row of ruby, topaz, and beryl shall be the first row;

Kikuyu: mũhari wa keerĩ ũtumĩrĩre kahiga ga thumarati, na ka yakuti ĩrĩa ya rangi wa bururu, na ka arimathi;
English: and the second row a turquoise, a sapphire,‡ and an emerald;

Kikuyu: mũhari wa gatatũ ũtumĩrĩre kahiga ka wakiki ũrĩa wa bururu, na ka yacimu, na ka amethuthito;
English: and the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

Kikuyu: naguo mũhari wa kana ũtumĩrĩrwo kahiga ga thumarati ĩrĩa theru, na ka onigithi, na ka njathibi. Ũtũtumĩrĩre tũkonyo- inĩ tũgemu twa thahabu.
English: and the fourth row a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They shall be enclosed in gold in their settings.

Kikuyu: Hagĩkorwo harĩ na tũhiga ikũmi na twĩrĩ, o kamwe karũgamĩrĩre marĩĩtwa ma ariũ a Isiraeli, o kamwe gakururwo rĩĩtwa rĩa mũhĩrĩga ũmwe wa ĩrĩa ikũmi na ĩĩrĩ ya Isiraeli, o ta ũrĩa kahengere ka mũhũũri gakururagwo.
English: The stones shall be according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, they shall be for the twelve tribes.

Kikuyu: “Thondekera gakuo kau ga gĩthũri irengeeri njogothe cia thahabu therie ihaana ta mũkanda.
English: You shall make on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.

Kikuyu: Gathondekere mĩrĩnga ĩĩrĩ ya thahabu, ũmĩoherere mĩthia-inĩ ĩĩrĩ ya gakuo kau ga gĩthũri.
English: You shall make on the breastplate two rings of gold, and shall put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

Kikuyu: Ohania irengeeri igĩrĩ cia thahabu mĩrĩnga-inĩ hau mĩthia-inĩ ya gakuo ga gĩthũri,
English: You shall put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.

Kikuyu: nayo mĩthia ĩrĩa ĩngĩ ya irengeeri yohithanio na tũkonyo tũrĩa twĩrĩ, ũmĩnyiitithanie na ndaamĩ cia kĩande cia ebodi mwena wa na mbere.
English: The other two ends of the two braided chains you shall put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod in its forepart.

Kikuyu: Thondeka mĩrĩnga ĩĩrĩ ya thahabu ũmĩnyiitithanie na mĩthia ĩrĩa ĩngĩ ĩĩrĩ ya gakuo ga gĩthũri mwena wa na thĩinĩ kũrigania na ebodi.
English: You shall make two rings of gold, and you shall put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which is toward the side of the ephod inward.

Kikuyu: Thondeka mĩrĩnga ĩngĩ ĩĩrĩ ya thahabu na ũmĩnyiitithanie magũrũ-inĩ ma ndaamĩ cia kĩande mwena-inĩ wa mbere wa ebodi, hakuhĩ na rũtumo, igũrũ hanini wa mũcibi wa njohero ya ebodi.
English: You shall make two rings of gold, and shall put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its forepart, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

Kikuyu: Mĩrĩnga ya gakuo ga gĩthũri ĩrĩohithanagio na mĩrĩnga ya ebodi na rũrigi rwa bururu, na inyiitithanio na mũcibi wa njohero, nĩgeetha gakuo ga gĩthũri gatikarekanie na ebodi.
English: They shall bind the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate may not swing out from the ephod.

Kikuyu: “Rĩrĩa rĩothe Harũni arĩĩtoonyaga Handũ-harĩa-Hatheru, arĩkuuaga marĩĩtwa ma ariũ a Isiraeli marĩ gĩthũri-inĩ gĩake gakuo-inĩ ga gĩthũri ga ituĩro rĩa ciira, arĩ kĩririkania gĩa gũtũũra mbere ya Jehova.
English: Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment on his heart, when he goes in to the holy place, for a memorial before Yahweh continually.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ wĩkĩre Urimu na Thumimu† thĩinĩ wa gakuo kau ga gĩthũri, nĩgeetha ciikarage gĩthũri-inĩ kĩa Harũni rĩrĩa rĩothe arĩĩtoonyaga agathiĩ mbere ya Jehova. Ũguo nĩguo Harũni arĩkuuaga ũhoti wa gũtuagĩra andũ a Isiraeli ciira gĩthũri-inĩ gĩake arĩ mbere ya Jehova.
English: You shall put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be on Aaron’s heart, when he goes in before Yahweh. Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel on his heart before Yahweh continually.

Kikuyu: “Tuma nguo ndaaya ya ebodi ya taama wa bururu mũtheri,
English: “You shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue.

Kikuyu: na ĩkorwo na harũkĩrio ya mũtwe gatagatĩ kayo. Ĩkorwo ĩtirihĩtwo mĩthia-inĩ ta kara ya ngingo gũthiũrũrũkĩria iharũkĩrio rĩu rĩa mũtwe, nĩgeetha ndĩgatarũke.
English: It shall have a hole for the head in the middle of it. It shall have a binding of woven work around its hole, as it were the hole of a coat of mail, that it not be torn.

Kikuyu: Thondeka tũcunjuura tũtariĩ ta matunda ma makomamanga twa ndigi cia rangi wa bururu, na rangi wa ndathi, na rangi mũtune ta gakarakũ gũthiũrũrũka rũtumo rwa magũrũ-inĩ rwa nguo ĩyo, tũhakanĩtio na ngengere cia thahabu.
English: On its hem you shall make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, all around its hem; with bells of gold between and around them:

Kikuyu: Ngengere cia thahabu na makomamanga macio mathiĩ mahakanĩtio gũthiũrũrũka rũtumo rwa magũrũ-inĩ rwa nguo ĩyo ndaaya.
English: a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, around the hem of the robe.

Kikuyu: Harũni no nginya ehumbage nguo ĩyo hĩndĩ ciothe rĩrĩa egũtungata. Ngengere nĩirĩiguagwo ikĩgamba rĩrĩa egũtoonya Handũ-harĩa-Hatheru o hau mbere ya Jehova na rĩrĩa ekuuma ho, nĩgeetha ndagakue.
English: It shall be on Aaron to minister: and its sound shall be heard when he goes in to the holy place before Yahweh, and when he comes out, that he not die.

Kikuyu: “Thondeka gatanji ga thahabu therie, na ũgakurure ta ũrĩa mũhũũri ũkururagwo, ũkurure ciugo ici: MŨTHERU MWAMŨRĨRE JEHOVA.
English: “You shall make a plate of pure gold, and engrave on it, like the engravings of a signet, ‘HOLY TO YAHWEH.’

Kikuyu: Koherere rũrigi rwa rangi wa bururu nĩguo ũkanyiitithanie na kĩremba, gakorwo karĩ mwena wa mbere wa kĩremba.
English: You shall put it on a lace of blue, and it shall be on the sash. It shall be on the front of the sash.

Kikuyu: Karĩkoragwo karĩ thiithi-inĩ wa Harũni, nake agakuuaga mahĩtia makoniĩ iheo iria theru, iria andũ a Isiraeli mangĩkorwo mamũrĩire Jehova, o na irĩ cia mũthemba o na ũrĩkũ. Gatanji kau gakoragwo karĩ thiithi-inĩ wa Harũni hĩndĩ ciothe nĩgeetha magetĩkĩrĩkaga nĩ Jehova.
English: It shall be on Aaron’s forehead, and Aaron shall bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall make holy in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always on his forehead, that they may be accepted before Yahweh.

Kikuyu: “Kanjũ nĩĩtumwo ĩrĩ ya gatani ĩrĩa njega mũno, o na ũtume kĩremba na gatani ĩrĩa njega mũno. Mũcibi ũtumwo nĩ mũgemia ũrĩa mũũgĩ na wĩra ũcio.
English: You shall weave the tunic with fine linen. You shall make a turban of fine linen. You shall make a sash, the work of the embroiderer.

Kikuyu: Tumĩra ariũ a Harũni kanjũ, na mĩcibi, na tũmĩcibi twa kĩongo, cia gũtũma manenehagio na maheagwo gĩtĩĩo.
English: “You shall make tunics for Aaron’s sons. You shall make sashes for them. You shall make headbands for them, for glory and for beauty.

Kikuyu: Warĩkia kũhumba mũrũ wa nyũkwa na ariũ ake nguo icio-rĩ, ũmaitĩrĩrie maguta na ũmaamũre. Ũmaamũre nĩgeetha mandungatagĩre marĩ athĩnjĩri-Ngai.
English: You shall put them on Aaron your brother, and on his sons with him, and shall anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office.

Kikuyu: “Matumithĩrie thuruarĩ cia thĩinĩ cia gatani, cia kũhumbĩra njaga ya mĩĩrĩ yao kuuma njohero nginya ciero-inĩ.
English: You shall make them linen pants to cover their naked flesh. They shall reach from the waist even to the thighs.

Kikuyu: Harũni na ariũ ake no nginya maciĩhumbage rĩrĩa rĩothe marĩtoonyaga Hema- ya-Gũtũnganwo kana magĩthengerera kĩgongona marutĩre wĩra Handũ-harĩa-Hatheru nĩgeetha matikahĩtie, nao makue. “Ũyũ nĩũtuĩke watho wa kũrũmagĩrĩrwo tene na tene nĩ Harũni na njiaro ciake.
English: They shall be on Aaron and on his sons, when they go in to the Tent of Meeting, or when they come near to the altar to minister in the holy place, that they don’t bear iniquity, and die. This shall be a statute forever to him and to his offspring after him.

Kikuyu: “Na rĩrĩ, ũũ nĩguo ũgwĩka nĩgeetha wamũre Harũni na ariũ ake, nĩguo mandungatagĩre marĩ athĩnjĩri-Ngai: Oya gategwa kamwe na ndũrũme igĩrĩ itarĩ kaũũgũ.
English: “This is the thing that you shall do to them to make them holy, to minister to me in the priest’s office: take one young bull and two rams without defect,

Kikuyu: Na kuuma mũtu-inĩ mũhinyu mũno wa ngano ũtarĩ ndawa ya kũimbia, ũthondeke mĩgate na keki itukanĩtio na maguta na tũmĩgate tũhũthũ tũhakĩtwo maguta.
English: unleavened bread, unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil. You shall make them of fine wheat flour.

Kikuyu: Ĩkĩra indo icio gĩkabũ-inĩ na ũcinenganĩre ũguo hamwe na ndegwa ĩyo na ndũrũme icio cierĩ.
English: You shall put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bull and the two rams.

Kikuyu: Ũcooke ũrehe Harũni na ariũ ake itoonyero-inĩ rĩa Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo, ũmathambie na maaĩ.
English: You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water.

Kikuyu: Oya nguo icio, ũhumbe Harũni kanjũ, na nguo ndaaya ya ebodi, na ebodi yo nyene na gakuo ga gĩthũri. Muohe ebodi na mũcibi wayo wa njohero ũrĩa mũtume wega.
English: You shall take the garments, and put on Aaron the tunic, the robe of the ephod, the ephod, and the breastplate, and clothe him with the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

Kikuyu: Mwĩkĩre kĩremba mũtwe, nako gatanji karĩa kaamũre ũgekĩre kĩremba-inĩ kĩu.
English: You shall set the turban on his head, and put the holy crown on the turban.

Kikuyu: Oya maguta ma gũitanĩrĩrio ũmũitĩrĩrie mũtwe ũmwamũre.
English: Then you shall take the anointing oil, and pour it on his head, and anoint him.

Kikuyu: Rehe ariũ ake na ũmahumbe kanjũ,
English: You shall bring his sons, and put tunics on them.

Kikuyu: na ũmoohe tũmĩcibi twa mũtwe. Ningĩ wohe Harũni na ariũ ake mĩcibi. Ũthĩnjĩri-Ngai nĩ wao ũrĩ watho wa kũrũmagĩrĩrwo tene na tene. Ũguo nĩguo ũkaamũra Harũni na ariũ ake.
English: You shall clothe them with belts, Aaron and his sons, and bind headbands on them. They shall have the priesthood by a perpetual statute. You shall consecrate Aaron and his sons.

Kikuyu: “Rehe ndegwa ĩyo mwena wa mbere wa Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo, nake Harũni na ariũ ake mĩigĩrĩre moko mao mũtwe wayo.
English: “You shall bring the bull before the Tent of Meeting; and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the bull.

Kikuyu: Ũcooke ũmĩthĩnjĩre mbere ya Jehova o hau itoonyero-inĩ rĩa Hema-ya- Gũtũnganwo.
English: You shall kill the bull before Yahweh at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ woe thakame ĩmwe ya ndegwa ĩyo, ũmĩhake hĩa cia kĩgongona na kĩara gĩaku, ĩyo ĩngĩ ũmĩite gĩtina-inĩ gĩa kĩgongona.
English: You shall take of the blood of the bull, and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger; and you shall pour out all the blood at the base of the altar.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ woe maguta mothe marĩa mahumbĩire nyama cia nda, na marĩa mahumbĩire ini, na higo cierĩ na maguta ma cio ũmacinĩre hau kĩgongona-inĩ.
English: You shall take all the fat that covers the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, and burn them on the altar.

Kikuyu: No nyama cia ndegwa ĩyo hamwe na rũũa na mahu ũcicinĩre nja ya kambĩ. Rĩu nĩ iruta rĩa mehia.
English: But the meat of the bull, and its skin, and its dung, you shall burn with fire outside of the camp. It is a sin offering.

Kikuyu: “Oya ndũrũme ĩmwe nake Harũni na ariũ ake mamĩigĩrĩre moko mao mũtwe igũrũ wayo.
English: “You shall also take the one ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram.

Kikuyu: Mĩthĩnje na woe thakame, ũmĩminjaminjĩrie kĩgongona mĩena yothe.
English: You shall kill the ram, and you shall take its blood, and sprinkle it around on the altar.

Kikuyu: Tinangia ndũrũme tũcunjĩ, naũthambienyamacianda, namagũrũmayo, ũciigehamwenamũtwenatũcunjĩtũutũngĩ.
English: You shall cut the ram into its pieces, and wash its innards, and its legs, and put them with its pieces, and with its head.

Kikuyu: Ũcooke ũcinĩre ndũrũme ĩyo yothe igũrũ wa kĩgongona. Rĩu nĩ iruta rĩa njino rĩa kũrutĩra Jehova, rĩrĩ mũtararĩko mwega rĩrutĩirwo Jehova, rĩrĩ iruta rĩrutĩirwo Jehova rĩa gũcinwo na mwaki.
English: You shall burn the whole ram on the altar: it is a burnt offering to Yahweh; it is a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

Kikuyu: “Oya ndũrũme ĩyo ĩngĩ, nake Harũni na ariũ ake mamĩigĩrĩre moko mao mũtwe.
English: “You shall take the other ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram.

Kikuyu: Mĩthĩnje, woe thakame ĩmwe yayo ũmĩhake moni cia matũ ma ũrĩo ma Harũni na ariũ ake o na ciara iria nene cia moko mao ma ũrĩo, na ciara iria nene cia magũrũ mao ma ũrĩo. Ũcooke ũminjaminjĩrie kĩgongona thakame mĩena yothe.
English: Then you shall kill the ram, and take some of its blood, and put it on the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and on the tip of the right ear of his sons, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the big toe of their right foot; and sprinkle the blood around on the altar.

Kikuyu: Na woe thakame ĩmwe kuuma kĩgongona-inĩ na maguta ma gũitanĩrĩrio ũciminjaminjĩrie Harũni na nguo ciake, na ariũ ake na nguo ciao. Hĩndĩ ĩyo Harũni na ariũ ake hamwe na nguo ciao nĩmagatuĩka aamũre.
English: You shall take of the blood that is on the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it on Aaron, and on his garments, and on his sons, and on the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be made holy, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.

Kikuyu: “Oya maguta mamwe ma ndũrũme ĩyo, maguta ma mũtingʼoe ũrĩa mũnoru, na maguta marĩa mahumbĩire nyama cia nda, na maguta marĩa mahumbĩire ini, na higo cierĩ na maguta ma cio, na kĩero kĩa mwena wa ũrĩo. (Ĩyo nĩyo ndũrũme ya igongona rĩa kwamũrana.)
English: Also you shall take some of the ram’s fat, the fat tail, the fat that covers the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys, the fat that is on them, and the right thigh (for it is a ram of consecration),

Kikuyu: Kuuma gĩkabũ- inĩ kĩa mĩgate ĩtarĩ mĩĩkĩre ndawa ya kũimbia kĩrĩa kĩrĩ mbere ya Jehova, oya mũgate ũmwe na keki ĩthondeketwo na maguta, na woe kamũgate kahũthũ.
English: and one loaf of bread, one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of unleavened bread that is before Yahweh.

Kikuyu: Indo ici ciothe cineane moko-inĩ ma Harũni na ariũ ake, ũcooke ũcithũngũthie mbere ya Jehova ĩrĩ Igongona rĩa gũthũngũthio.
English: You shall put all of this in Aaron’s hands, and in his sons’ hands, and shall wave them for a wave offering before Yahweh.
