Kikuyu: Ningĩ ũcooke woe indo icio kuuma moko-inĩ mao, ũcicinĩre kĩgongona-inĩ igũrũ hamwe na iruta rĩa njino, ituĩke mũtararĩko mwega harĩ Jehova, rĩrĩ iruta rĩrutĩirwo Jehova rĩa gũcinwo na mwaki.
English: You shall take them from their hands, and burn them on the altar on the burnt offering, for a pleasant aroma before Yahweh: it is an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

Kikuyu: Warĩkia kũruta gĩthũri kĩa ndũrũme ĩyo ya kĩamũrano kĩa Harũni, gĩthũngũthie mbere ya Jehova rĩrĩ iruta rĩa gũthũngũthio, nakĩo gĩtuĩke rwĩga rwaku.
English: “You shall take the breast of Aaron’s ram of consecration, and wave it for a wave offering before Yahweh. It shall be your portion.

Kikuyu: “Amũra icunjĩ cia ndũrũme ĩyo ya kĩamũrano iria irĩ cia Harũni na ariũ ake nacio nĩ: gĩthũri kĩrĩa gĩathũngũthĩtio na kĩero kĩrĩa kĩaheanĩtwo.
English: You shall sanctify the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the wave offering, which is waved, and which is raised up, of the ram of consecration, even of that which is for Aaron, and of that which is for his sons.

Kikuyu: Indo icio ituĩke rwĩga rwa kũheagwo Harũni na ariũ ake nĩ andũ a Isiraeli hĩndĩ ciothe. Nĩrĩo iruta rĩrĩa andũ a Isiraeli marĩrutagĩra Jehova kuuma maruta-inĩ ma ũiguano.
English: It shall be for Aaron and his sons as their portion forever from the children of Israel; for it is a wave offering. It shall be a wave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifices of their peace offerings, even their wave offering to Yahweh.

Kikuyu: “Nguo iria nyamũre cia Harũni igũtuĩka cia njiaro ciake, nĩgeetha magaitagĩrĩrio maguta na makaamũragwo maciĩhumbĩte.
English: “The holy garments of Aaron shall be for his sons after him, to be anointed in them, and to be consecrated in them.

Kikuyu: Mũriũ ũrĩa ũkamũgaya atuĩke mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai na oke gũtungata thĩinĩ wa Handũ-Harĩa-Hatheru, Hema-inĩ-ya-Gũtũnganwo arĩĩhumbaga nguo icio mĩthenya mũg- wanja.
English: Seven days shall the son who is priest in his place put them on, when he comes into the Tent of Meeting to minister in the holy place.

Kikuyu: “Oya ndũrũme ĩyo ya kĩamũrano nacio nyama ciayo ũcirugĩre handũ harĩa hatheru.
English: “You shall take the ram of consecration and boil its meat in a holy place.

Kikuyu: Harũni na ariũ ake marĩrĩagĩra nyama cia ndũrũme ĩyo na mĩgate kuuma gĩkabũ-inĩ o hau itoonyero-inĩ rĩa Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo.
English: Aaron and his sons shall eat the meat of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

Kikuyu: Nĩmarĩrĩĩaga indo icio irutĩtwo cia horohio nĩ ũndũ wa kwamũrwo kwao na gũtherio. No itikanarĩĩo nĩ mũndũ ũngĩ, nĩ ũndũ nĩ theru.
English: They shall eat those things with which atonement was made, to consecrate and sanctify them; but a stranger shall not eat of it, because they are holy.

Kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, nyama cia ndũrũme ĩyo ya kĩamũrano kana mĩgate ingĩtigara nginya rũciinĩ-rĩ, nĩicinwo. Itikanarĩĩo tondũ nĩ theru.
English: If anything of the meat of the consecration, or of the bread, remains to the morning, then you shall burn the remainder with fire. It shall not be eaten, because it is holy.

Kikuyu: “Ĩka Harũni na ariũ ake maũndũ mothe marĩa ngwathĩte, na ũniine mĩthenya mũgwanja ũkĩmaamũra.
English: “You shall do so to Aaron and to his sons, according to all that I have commanded you. You shall consecrate them seven days.

Kikuyu: Rutagai ndegwa ĩmwe o mũthenya, ĩrĩ iruta rĩa mehia rĩa kũhorohanĩria. Theria kĩgongona na ũndũ wa gũkĩhoroheria na gũgĩitĩrĩria maguta, ũkĩamũre.
English: Every day you shall offer the bull of sin offering for atonement. You shall cleanse the altar when you make atonement for it. You shall anoint it, to sanctify it.

Kikuyu: Gĩa na horohio ya kĩgongona mĩthenya mũgwanja ya gũkĩamũra. Thuutha ũcio kĩgongona kĩu nĩgĩgũtuĩka gĩtheru mũno, nakĩo kĩrĩa gĩothe kĩrĩkĩhutagia kĩrĩtuĩkaga gĩtheru.
English: Seven days you shall make atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and the altar shall be most holy. Whatever touches the altar shall be holy.

Kikuyu: “Gĩkĩ nĩkĩo kĩndũ kĩrĩa ũrĩĩrutaga hĩndĩ ciothe kĩgongona-inĩ o mũthenya: tũtũrũme twĩrĩ, o kamwe ka ũkũrũ wa mwaka ũmwe.
English: “Now this is that which you shall offer on the altar: two lambs a year old day by day continually.

Kikuyu: Gatũrũme kamwe gakarutwo rũciinĩ na karĩa kangĩ hwaĩ-inĩ kũrĩ mairia.
English: The one lamb you shall offer in the morning; and the other lamb you shall offer at evening;

Kikuyu: Gatũrũme ka mbere gakarutanagĩrio na mũtu mũhinyu mũno gĩcunjĩ gĩa ikũmi kĩa eba* ũtukanĩtio na maguta ma mũtamaiyũ gacunjĩ ka inya ka hini ĩmwe† na ndibei gacunjĩ ka inya ka hini ĩmwe, irĩ kĩndũ gĩa kũnyuuo.
English: and with the one lamb a tenth part of an ephah† of fine flour mixed with the fourth part of a hin‡ of beaten oil, and the fourth part of a hin of wine for a drink offering.

Kikuyu: Ruta gatũrũme kau kangĩ igongona hwaĩ-inĩ kũrĩ mairia, hamwe na iruta rĩa mũtu na rĩa kĩndũ gĩa kũnyuuo o ta cia rũciinĩ, arĩ guo mũtararĩko mwega, rĩrĩ iruta rĩrutĩirwo Jehova rĩa gũcinwo na mwaki.
English: The other lamb you shall offer at evening, and shall do to it according to the meal offering of the morning and according to its drink offering, for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

Kikuyu: “Harĩ njiaro iria igooka, iruta rĩĩrĩ rĩa njino rĩkaarutagwo hĩndĩ ciothe itoonyero-inĩ rĩa Hema- ya-Gũtũnganwo mbere ya Jehova. Hau nĩho ndĩĩcemanagia nawe na njaragie nawe;
English: It shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the Tent of Meeting before Yahweh, where I will meet with you, to speak there to you.

Kikuyu: ningĩ hau no ho ndĩcemanagia na andũ a Isiraeli, naho nĩhakaamũrwo nĩ riiri wakwa.
English: There I will meet with the children of Israel; and the place shall be sanctified by my glory.

Kikuyu: “Nĩ ũndũ ũcio nĩngamũra Hema-ĩyo-ya-Gũtũnganwo na kĩgongona na nyamũre Harũni na ariũ ake mandungatagĩre marĩ athĩnjĩri-Ngai.
English: I will sanctify the Tent of Meeting and the altar. I will also sanctify Aaron and his sons to minister to me in the priest’s office.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ nĩngatũũrania na andũ a Isiraeli na nduĩke Ngai wao.
English: I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.

Kikuyu: Nĩmakamenya atĩ niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova Ngai wao, ũrĩa wamarutire bũrũri wa Misiri nĩgeetha ndũũranagie nao. Niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova Ngai wao.
English: They shall know that I am Yahweh their God, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, that I might dwell among them: I am Yahweh their God.

Kikuyu: “Thondeka kĩgongona kĩa mbaũ cia mũgaa gĩa gũcinagĩra ũbumba.
English: “You shall make an altar to burn incense on. You shall make it of acacia wood.

Kikuyu: Nĩgĩkorwo kĩiganaine mĩena yothe mũkono ũmwe* kũraiha na mũkono ũmwe kwarama na mĩkono ĩĩrĩ† kũraiha na igũrũ, hĩa ciakĩo ituĩke kĩndũ o ro kĩmwe na kĩgongona.
English: Its length shall be a cubit,† and its width a cubit. It shall be square, and its height shall be two cubits. Its horns shall be of one piece with it.

Kikuyu: Kĩgemie igũrũ, o na mĩena yothe, o na hĩa ciakĩo, na thahabu therie, na ũgĩtirihe na mũcibi wa thahabu ũgĩthiũrũrũkĩrie.
English: You shall overlay it with pure gold, its top, its sides around it, and its horns; and you shall make a gold molding around it.

Kikuyu: Thondekera kĩgongona kĩu mĩrĩnga ĩĩrĩ, ũmĩoherere thĩ wa mũcibi ũcio, ĩĩrĩ mwena ũmwe, na ĩĩrĩ mwena ũrĩa ũngĩ ĩnyiitagĩrĩre mĩtĩ ĩrĩa mĩraaya ĩtũmagĩrwo gũgĩkuua.
English: You shall make two golden rings for it under its molding; on its two ribs, on its two sides you shall make them; and they shall be for places for poles with which to bear it.

Kikuyu: Thondeka mĩtĩ mĩraaya ya mbaũ cia mũgaa, na ũmĩgemie na thahabu.
English: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.

Kikuyu: Iga kĩgongona kĩu mbere ya gĩtambaya gĩa gũcuurio kĩrĩa kĩrĩ mbere ya ithandũkũ rĩa Ũira, mbere ya gĩtĩ gĩa tha kĩrĩa kĩrĩ igũrũ rĩa ithandũkũ rĩa Ũira, harĩa ngaacemania nawe.
English: You shall put it before the veil that is by the ark of the covenant, before the mercy seat that is over the covenant, where I will meet with you.

Kikuyu: “Harũni no nginya acinĩre ũbumba mũnungi wega hau igũrũ rĩa kĩgongona o rũciinĩ rĩrĩa egũthondeka matawa.
English: Aaron shall burn incense of sweet spices on it every morning. When he tends the lamps, he shall burn it.

Kikuyu: No nginya acine ũbumba rĩngĩ agĩakia matawa hwaĩ-inĩ kũrĩ mairia, nĩgeetha ũbumba ũikarage ũgĩcinagwo mahinda mothe mbere ya Jehova, njiarwa na njiarwa iria igooka.
English: When Aaron lights the lamps at evening, he shall burn it, a perpetual incense before Yahweh throughout your generations.

Kikuyu: Ndũkanacinĩre ũbumba wa mũthemba ũngĩ kĩgongona-inĩ gĩkĩ kana ũrutĩre ho iruta rĩa njino, kana rĩa mũtu, na ndũkanaitĩrĩrie iruta rĩa kũnyuuo igũrũ rĩakĩo.
English: You shall offer no strange incense on it, nor burnt offering, nor meal offering; and you shall pour no drink offering on it.

Kikuyu: Harũni nĩarutage horohio hĩa-inĩ cia kĩgongona kĩu o mwaka riita rĩmwe. Horohio ĩno ya o mwaka no nginya ĩrutagwo na thakame ya iruta rĩa kũhoroheria mehia, nginya njiarwa iria igooka. Horohio ĩyo nĩ igongona itheru mũno harĩ Jehova.”
English: Aaron shall make atonement on its horns once in the year; with the blood of the sin offering of atonement once in the year he shall make atonement for it throughout your generations. It is most holy to Yahweh.”

Kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ,
English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

Kikuyu: “Rĩrĩa ũgũtara andũ a Isiraeli-rĩ, o mũndũ no nginya arutagĩre Jehova kĩndũ gĩa gũkũũra muoyo wake rĩrĩa egũtarwo. Na gũtirĩ mũthiro ũkaamakora ũkĩmatara.
English: “When you take a census of the children of Israel, according to those who are counted among them, then each man shall give a ransom for his soul to Yahweh when you count them, that there be no plague among them when you count them.

Kikuyu: Mũndũ o wothe ũrĩkĩraga agathiĩ mwena wa andũ arĩa marĩkĩtie gũtarwo, nĩarĩrutaga nuthu ya cekeri‡ kũringana na ũrĩa cekeri ya harĩa haamũre ĩtariĩ ĩrĩa ĩrĩ na ũritũ wa geera mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ. Nuthu ĩyo ya cekeri nĩ iruta kũrĩ Jehova.
English: They shall give this, everyone who passes over to those who are counted, half a shekel according to the shekel‡ of the sanctuary (the shekel is twenty gerahs§); half a shekel for an offering to Yahweh.

Kikuyu: Arĩa othe marĩkĩraga magathiĩ mwena wa arĩa marĩkĩtie gũtarwo, marĩ na ũkũrũ wa mĩaka mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na makĩria, no nginya maheage Jehova iruta rĩu.
English: Everyone who passes over to those who are counted, from twenty years old and upward, shall give the offering to Yahweh.

Kikuyu: Arĩa atongu matirĩheanaga makĩria ya nuthu ya cekeri, nao arĩa athĩĩni matirĩheanaga kĩndũ kĩnini gũkĩra nuthu ya cekeri hĩndĩ ya kũrutĩra Jehova horohio ya mĩoyo yao.
English: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less, than the half shekel,† when they give the offering of Yahweh, to make atonement for your souls.

Kikuyu: Amũkĩra mbeeca cia horohio kuuma kũrĩ andũ a Isiraeli nawe ũcihũthĩre ũtungata-inĩ wa Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo. Ũguo ũgaatuĩka kĩririkano kĩa andũ a Isiraeli mbere ya Jehova makĩrutĩra mĩoyo yao horohio.”
English: You shall take the atonement money from the children of Israel, and shall appoint it for the service of the Tent of Meeting; that it may be a memorial for the children of Israel before Yahweh, to make atonement for your souls.”

Kikuyu: Ningĩ Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ,
English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

Kikuyu: “Thondeka kĩraĩ gĩa gwĩthambagĩra gĩa gĩcango, kĩrĩ na kĩgũrũ gĩakĩo gĩa gĩcango. Ũkĩige gatagatĩ ka Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo na kĩgongona, na ũgĩĩkĩre maaĩ.
English: “You shall also make a basin of bronze, and its base of bronze, in which to wash. You shall put it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and you shall put water in it.

Kikuyu: Harũni na ariũ ake marĩĩthambaga moko mao na nyarĩrĩ na maaĩ macio.
English: Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet in it.

Kikuyu: Rĩrĩa rĩothe marĩtoonyaga Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo, marĩĩthambaga na maaĩ nĩgeetha matigakue. O na ningĩ rĩrĩa mathengerera kĩgongona nĩguo marutĩre Jehova iruta rĩa gũcinwo na mwaki,
English: When they go into the Tent of Meeting, they shall wash with water, that they don’t die; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

Kikuyu: marĩĩthambaga moko na nyarĩrĩ nĩgeetha matigakue. Ũndũ ũcio ũgaatuĩka watho wa kũrũmĩrĩrwo tene na tene nĩ Harũni na njiaro ciake, na njiarwa ciao ciothe iria igooka.”
English: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they not die. This shall be a statute forever to them, even to him and to his descendants throughout their generations.”

Kikuyu: Ningĩ Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ,
English: Moreover Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

Kikuyu: “Oya mahuti maya manungi wega: cekeri 500§ cia manemane ĩrĩa ndwekie, nuthu yamo (nacio icio nĩ cekeri 250) cia ndarathini nungi wega, na cekeri 250 cia karamathi nungi wega,
English: “Also take fine spices: of liquid myrrh, five hundred shekels;‡ and of fragrant cinnamon half as much, even two hundred and fifty; and of fragrant cane, two hundred and fifty;

Kikuyu: cekeri 500 cia mwĩnũ, ciothe kũringana na cekeri ya handũ-harĩa-haamũre, na hini* ya maguta ma mĩtamaiyũ.
English: and of cassia five hundred, according to the shekel of the sanctuary; and a hin§ of olive oil.

Kikuyu: Indo ici ũcithondeke ituĩke maguta matheru ma gũitanĩrĩrio matukanĩtio makanunga wega marutĩirwo wĩra nĩ mũthondeki mũũgĩ wa maguta. Macio matuĩke magutamatherumagũitanagĩrĩrio.
English: You shall make it into a holy anointing oil, a perfume compounded after the art of the perfumer: it shall be a holy anointing oil.

Kikuyu: NingĩũhũthĩremagutamaciogũitĩrĩriaHema-ya-Gũtũnganwo, na ithandũkũ rĩa Ũira,
English: You shall use it to anoint the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the covenant,

Kikuyu: na metha na indo ciayo ciothe, na mũtĩ wa kũigĩrĩrwo matawa na indo ciaguo, na kĩgongona gĩa gũcinĩra ũbumba, na
English: the table and all its articles, the lamp stand and its accessories, the altar of incense,

Kikuyu: kĩgongona kĩa iruta rĩa njino na indo ciakĩo ciothe, na kĩraĩ na kĩgũrũ gĩakĩo.
English: the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the basin with its base.

Kikuyu: Nĩũgaciamũra nĩgeetha ituĩke theru mũno makĩria, nakĩo kĩrĩa gĩothe gĩgacihutia nĩgĩgatuĩka gĩtheru.
English: You shall sanctify them, that they may be most holy. Whatever touches them shall be holy.

Kikuyu: “Itĩrĩria Harũni na ariũ ake maguta ũmaamũre nĩgeetha mandungatagĩre marĩ athĩnjĩri- Ngai.
English: You shall anoint Aaron and his sons, and sanctify them, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office.

Kikuyu: Ĩra andũ a Isiraeli atĩrĩ, ‘Maya nĩmo maguta makwa marĩa matheru ma gũitanagĩrĩrio ma njiarwa iria igooka.
English: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘This shall be a holy anointing oil to me throughout your generations.

Kikuyu: Ndũkanamaitĩrĩrie mĩĩrĩ ya arũme, na ndũkanathondeke maguta mangĩ na mũthondekereũcio. Nĩmatherunanĩwegaũmatuageatĩnĩmatheru.
English: It shall not be poured on man’s flesh, and do not make any like it, according to its composition. It is holy. It shall be holy to you.

Kikuyu: Mũndũwotheũrĩthondekaga maguta manungi wega mahaana ta maya, na mũndũ o wothe ũngĩmaitĩrĩria mũndũ ũtarĩ mũthĩnjĩri- Ngai, nĩakaingatwo kuuma kũrĩ andũ ao.’ ”
English: Whoever compounds any like it, or whoever puts any of it on a stranger, he shall be cut off from his people.’ ”

Kikuyu: Ningĩ Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ, “Oya mahuti manungi wega marĩa metagwo thitakiti, na onuka na garibane, hamwe na ũbani ũrĩa mwega mũno, mothe mathimĩtwo maiganaine,
English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Take to yourself sweet spices, gum resin, onycha, and galbanum: sweet spices with pure frankincense. There shall be an equal weight of each.

Kikuyu: na ũthondekithie magĩe na mũtararĩko mwega wa ũbumba; wĩra ũcio ũrutwo nĩ mũthondeki mũũgĩ wa maguta. Makorwo mekĩrĩtwo cumbĩ, na marĩ matheru na makaamũrwo.
English: You shall make incense of it, a perfume after the art of the perfumer, seasoned with salt, pure and holy.

Kikuyu: Thĩithia mahuti mamwe matuĩke mũtu, naguo ũũige mbere ya ithandũkũ rĩa Ũira thĩinĩ wa Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo, harĩa ndĩĩcemanagia nawe. Ũgaakorwo ũrĩ mũtheru mũno harĩwe.
English: You shall beat some of it very small, and put some of it before the covenant in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you. It shall be to you most holy.

Kikuyu: Mũtikanethondekere ũbumba wa mũthemba ũyũ nĩ ũndũ wa inyuĩ ene; ũtuagei mũtheru nĩ ũndũ wa Jehova.
English: You shall not make this incense, according to its composition, for yourselves: it shall be to you holy for Yahweh.

Kikuyu: Mũndũ o na ũrĩkũ ũrĩa ũgathondeka ũngĩ taguo nĩguo ekenagie na mũtararĩko waguo nĩakaingatwo kuuma kũrĩ andũ ao.”
English: Whoever shall make any like that, to smell of it, he shall be cut off from his people.”

Kikuyu: Nake Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ,
English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

Kikuyu: “Ta rora wone, nĩthuurĩte Bezaleli mũrũ wa Uri ũrĩa mũriũ wa Huri wa mũhĩrĩga wa Juda,
English: “Behold, I have called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

Kikuyu: na nĩndĩmũiyũrĩtie na Roho wa Ngai, na ũũgĩ na ũhoti na ũmenyo mawĩra-inĩ ma mĩthemba yothe ya moko;
English: I have filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship,

Kikuyu: ya gũcora mĩcoro ya ũũgĩ indo-inĩ cia thahabu, na betha na gĩcango, na
English: to devise skillful works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in bronze,

Kikuyu: gwacũhia tũhiga twa goro twa gũthecererwo indo-inĩ, na kũruta wĩra wa gũkaaya mbaũ, na kũruta mawĩra ma mĩthemba yothe ya ũbundi.
English: and in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of workmanship.

Kikuyu: O na rĩrĩ, nĩthuurĩte Oholiabu mũrũ wa Ahisamaku, wa mũhĩrĩga wa Dani, nĩguo ateithagie Bezaleli wĩra. Ningĩ nĩheete mabundi mothe ũũgĩ wa gũthondeka indo ciothe iria ngwathĩte:
English: Behold, I myself have appointed with him Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; and in the heart of all who are wise-hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded you:

Kikuyu: nacio nĩ Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo, na ithandũkũ rĩa Ũira, na gĩtĩ gĩa tha kĩrĩa kĩrĩ igũrũ rĩarĩo, na indo iria ingĩ ciothe cia hema,
English: the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the covenant, the mercy seat that is on it, all the furniture of the Tent,

Kikuyu: nacio nĩ metha na indo ciayo, na mũtĩ wa thahabu therie wa kũigĩrĩrwo matawa na indo ciaguo ciothe, na kĩgongona gĩa gũcinĩra ũbumba, na
English: the table and its vessels, the pure lamp stand with all its vessels, the altar of incense,

Kikuyu: kĩgongona kĩa iruta rĩa njino na indo ciakĩo, na kĩraĩ na kĩgũrũ gĩakĩo,
English: the altar of burnt offering with all its vessels, the basin and its base,

Kikuyu: o na nguo iria ndume, iria theru cia kwĩhumbwo nĩ Harũni ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai na nguo cia kwĩhumbwo nĩ ariũ ake rĩrĩa megũtungata marĩ athĩnjĩri-Ngai,
English: the finely worked garments—the holy garments for Aaron the priest, the garments of his sons to minister in the priest’s office—

Kikuyu: na maguta ma gũitanĩrĩrio, na ũbumba mũnungi wega wa Handũ- harĩa-Hatheru. Mathondeke indo icio o ta ũrĩa ngwathĩte.”
English: the anointing oil, and the incense of sweet spices for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded you they shall do.”

Kikuyu: Ningĩ Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ,
English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

Kikuyu: “Ĩra andũ a Isiraeli ũũ: ‘No nginya mũrũmagie Thabatũ ciakwa. Rũrũ nĩruo rũgatuĩka rũũri gatagatĩ gakwa na inyuĩ njiarwa iria igooka, nĩguo mũmenye atĩ niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova ũrĩa ũmũtheragia.
English: “Speak also to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Most certainly you shall keep my Sabbaths; for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations, that you may know that I am Yahweh who sanctifies you.

Kikuyu: “ ‘Menyagĩrĩrai Thabatũ tondũ nĩ mũthenya mũtheru harĩ inyuĩ. Mũndũ ũngĩũthaahia no nginya ooragwo; mũndũ ũngĩruta wĩra mũthenya ũcio nĩakaingatwo kuuma kũrĩ andũ ao.
English: You shall keep the Sabbath therefore, for it is holy to you. Everyone who profanes it shall surely be put to death; for whoever does any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

Kikuyu: Wĩra nĩũrutagwo mĩthenya ĩtandatũ, no mũthenya wa mũgwanja nĩ Thabatũ theru ya Jehova ya andũ kũhurũka. Ũrĩa wothe ũkaaruta wĩra mũthenya wa Thabatũ no nginya ooragwo.
English: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, holy to Yahweh. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day shall surely be put to death.

Kikuyu: andũ a Isiraeli nĩmathĩkagĩre Thabatũ, mamĩkũngũyagĩre ĩtuĩke kĩrĩkanĩro gĩa gũtũũra njiarwa iria igooka.
English: Therefore the children of Israel shall keep the Sabbath, to observe the Sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.

Kikuyu: Rũrũ nĩruo rũgaatuĩka rũũri gatagatĩ gakwa na andũ a Isiraeli nginya tene, nĩgũkorwo Jehova ombire igũrũ na thĩ na mĩthenya ĩtandatũ na mũthenya wa mũgwanja ndaigana kũruta wĩra, akĩhurũka.’ ”
English: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel forever; for in six days Yahweh made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.’ ”

Kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Jehova aarĩkirie kwaria na Musa kũu igũrũ rĩa Kĩrĩma gĩa Sinai, akĩmũnengera ihengere icio igĩrĩ cia Ũira, o ihengere icio cia mahiga, o icio ciandĩkĩtwo na kĩara kĩa Ngai.
English: When he finished speaking with him on Mount Sinai, he gave Moses the two tablets of the covenant, stone tablets, written with God’s finger.

Kikuyu: Rĩrĩa andũ moonire atĩ Musa nĩaikarire mũno ataikũrũkĩte kuuma kĩrĩma-inĩ, magĩcookanĩrĩra harĩ Harũni makĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Ũka, tũthondekere ngai iria irĩtũtongoragia. Ha ũhoro wa mũndũ ũyũ ũgwĩtwo Musa, ũrĩa watũrutire bũrũri wa Misiri, tũtiũĩ ũrĩa oonete.”
English: When the people saw that Moses delayed coming down from the mountain, the people gathered themselves together to Aaron, and said to him, “Come, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.”

Kikuyu: Harũni akĩmacookeria akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Rutai icũhĩ cia thahabu iria irĩ matũ ma atumia anyu, na aanake na airĩtu anyu mũndehere.”
English: Aaron said to them, “Take off the golden rings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them to me.”

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio andũ othe makĩruta icũhĩ cia thahabu icio ciarĩ matũ-inĩ mao magĩcirehere Harũni.
English: All the people took off the golden rings which were in their ears, and brought them to Aaron.

Kikuyu: Nake akĩoya indo iria maamũreheire, agĩcitwekia agĩtũmĩra indo cia ũbundi gũcithondeka mũhianano wa njaũ. Nao andũ makiuga atĩrĩ, “Ici nĩcio ngai ciaku, wee Isiraeli, iria ciakũrutire bũrũri wa Misiri.”
English: He received what they handed him, fashioned it with an engraving tool, and made it a molded calf. Then they said, “These are your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt.”

Kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Harũni onire ũguo, agĩaka kĩgongona mbere ya njaũ ĩyo, na akĩanĩrĩra, akiuga atĩrĩ, “Rũciũ nĩgũgakorwo na gĩathĩ kĩa Jehova.”
English: When Aaron saw this, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made a proclamation, and said, “Tomorrow shall be a feast to Yahweh.”

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio mũthenya ũyũ ũngĩ andũ magĩũkĩra rũciinĩ tene, makĩruta magongona ma njino na ma ũiguano. Thuutha ũcio magĩikara thĩ kũrĩa na kũnyua, magĩcooka magĩũkĩra kũina na gwĩkenia.
English: They rose up early on the next day, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.

Kikuyu: Nake Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ, “Ikũrũka, tondũ andũ aku arĩa warutire bũrũri wa Misiri nĩmethũkĩtie.
English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, “Go, get down; for your people, whom you brought up out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves!

Kikuyu: Nĩmagarũrũkĩte narua magatiga ũrĩa ndaamathĩte, na nĩmethondekeire mũhianano wa gũtwekio ũhaana njaũ. Nĩmaũinamĩrĩire na makaũrutĩra iruta makiugaga atĩrĩ, ‘Ici nĩcio ngai ciaku, wee Isiraeli, iria ciakũrutire bũrũri wa Misiri.’ ”
English: They have turned away quickly out of the way which I commanded them. They have made themselves a molded calf, and have worshiped it, and have sacrificed to it, and said, ‘These are your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt.’ ”

Kikuyu: Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ, “Nĩnyonete andũ aya, nĩ andũ momĩtie ngingo.
English: Yahweh said to Moses, “I have seen these people, and behold, they are a stiff-necked people.

Kikuyu: Rĩu tigana na niĩ nĩgeetha marakara makwa mamarĩrĩmbũkĩre, nĩgeetha ndĩmaniine. Nĩngacooka ngũtue rũrĩrĩ rũnene.”
English: Now therefore leave me alone, that my wrath may burn hot against them, and that I may consume them; and I will make of you a great nation.”

Kikuyu: No Musa agĩthaitha Jehova Ngai wake, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Wee Jehova, ũngĩcinwo nĩ marakara ũũkĩrĩre andũ aku nĩkĩ, o arĩa warutire kuuma bũrũri wa Misiri na guoko gwaku kũrĩ ũhoti na ũkĩmaruta kuo na hinya mũnene?
English: Moses begged Yahweh his God, and said, “Yahweh, why does your wrath burn hot against your people, that you have brought out of the land of Egypt with great power and with a mighty hand?

Kikuyu: Nĩ kĩĩ kĩngĩtũma andũ a Misiri moige atĩrĩ, ‘Aamarutire bũrũri wa Misiri arĩ na muoroto wa kũmeka ũũru amooragĩre irĩma-inĩ, na amaniine mathire gũkũ thĩ’? Tiga kũrakara mũno; wĩricũkwo ndũkarehere andũ aku mwanangĩko.
English: Why should the Egyptians talk, saying, ‘He brought them out for evil, to kill them in the mountains, and to consume them from the surface of the earth’? Turn from your fierce wrath, and turn away from this evil against your people.

Kikuyu: Ririkana ndungata ciaku Iburahĩmu, na Isaaka, na Isiraeli, arĩa wee wehĩtire kũrĩ o na mwĩhĩtwa ũkĩĩgwetaga, ũkiuga atĩrĩ: ‘Nĩngatũma njiaro ciaku cingĩhe ta njata cia matu-inĩ, na nĩngaahe njiaro ciaku bũrũri ũyũ wothe ũrĩa ndaamerĩire, naguo ũgaatuĩka igai rĩao nginya tene.’ ”
English: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, your servants, to whom you swore by your own self, and said to them, ‘I will multiply your offspring† as the stars of the sky, and all this land that I have spoken of I will give to your offspring, and they shall inherit it forever.’ ”

Kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo Jehova akĩĩricũkwo, na ndaigana kũrehere andũ ake mwanangĩko ũrĩa oigĩte atĩ nĩekũmarehera.
English: So Yahweh turned away from the evil which he said he would do to his people.

Kikuyu: Musa akĩhũndũka, agĩikũrũka kuuma kĩrĩma igũrũ akuuĩte ihengere icio igĩrĩ cia Ũira na moko make. Ciarĩ nyandĩke mĩena yeerĩ, mbere na thuutha.
English: Moses turned, and went down from the mountain, with the two tablets of the covenant in his hand; tablets that were written on both their sides. They were written on one side and on the other.

Kikuyu: Ihengere icio ciarĩ wĩra wa Ngai; maandĩko macio maarĩ maandĩko ma Ngai makururĩtwo ihengere-inĩ icio.
English: The tablets were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, engraved on the tablets.

Kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Joshua aiguire inegene rĩa andũ makiugĩrĩria akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ, “Kũrĩ mbugĩrĩrio ya mbaara kambĩ-inĩ.”
English: When Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said to Moses, “There is the noise of war in the camp.”

Kikuyu: Musa akĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Ti mĩgambo ya ũhootani, na ti mĩgambo ya kũhootwo; nĩ mĩgambo ya kũina ndĩraigua.”
English: He said, “It isn’t the voice of those who shout for victory. It is not the voice of those who cry for being overcome; but the noise of those who sing that I hear.”

Kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Musa akuhĩrĩirie kambĩ, na akĩona njaũ na ndũrũhĩ ĩrĩa yarĩ kũndũ kũu, agĩcinwo nĩ marakara, nake agĩikia ihengere icio thĩ, ikiunĩkanga icunjĩ o hau magũrũ-inĩ ma kĩrĩma.
English: As soon as he came near to the camp, he saw the calf and the dancing. Then Moses’ anger grew hot, and he threw the tablets out of his hands, and broke them beneath the mountain.

Kikuyu: Nake akĩnyiita njaũ ĩyo maathondekete, akĩmĩcina na mwaki, agĩcooka akĩmĩthĩa, ĩgĩtuĩka mũtu, akĩũikia maaĩ-inĩ na agĩatha andũ a Isiraeli manyue maaĩ macio.
English: He took the calf which they had made, and burned it with fire, ground it to powder, and scattered it on the water, and made the children of Israel drink it.

Kikuyu: Nake Musa akĩũria Harũni atĩrĩ, “Andũ aya maragwĩkire atĩa nĩgeetha ũmatoonyie mehia-inĩ manene ũũ?”
English: Moses said to Aaron, “What did these people do to you, that you have brought a great sin on them?”

Kikuyu: Nake Harũni akĩmũcookeria, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Tiga kũrakara, mwathi wakwa; wee nĩũũĩ ũrĩa andũ aya mendete gwĩka ũũru.
English: Aaron said, “Don’t let the anger of my lord grow hot. You know the people, that they are set on evil.

Kikuyu: Maanjĩĩrire atĩrĩ, ‘Tũthondekere ngai iria irĩtũtongoragia. Ha ũhoro wa mũndũ ũyũ ũgwĩtwo Musa, ũrĩa watũrutire bũrũri wa Misiri-rĩ, tũtiũĩ ũrĩa oonire.’
English: For they said to me, ‘Make us gods, which shall go before us. As for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio ngĩmeera atĩrĩ, ‘Ũrĩa wothe ũrĩ na mathaga ma thahabu, nĩarute.’ Nao makĩĩnengera indo icio cia thahabu, ngĩciikia riiko, nacio ikiuma njaũ ĩno!”
English: I said to them, ‘Whoever has any gold, let them take it off.’ So they gave it to me; and I threw it into the fire, and out came this calf.”

Kikuyu: Musa akĩona atĩ andũ nĩmakararĩtie, na atĩ Harũni nĩamarekereirie meke ũrĩa mekwenda, nginya magaatuĩka andũ a gũthekagĩrĩrwo nĩ thũ ciao.
English: When Moses saw that the people were out of control, (for Aaron had let them lose control, causing derision among their enemies),

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio akĩrũgama itoonyero-inĩ rĩa kambĩ, akiuga atĩrĩ, “Ũrĩa wothe ũrĩ mwena wa Jehova-rĩ, nĩoke haha.” Nao Alawii othe makĩrũgama mwena wake.
English: then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, “Whoever is on Yahweh’s side, come to me!” All the sons of Levi gathered themselves together to him.

Kikuyu: Nake akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Jehova Ngai wa Isiraeli ekuuga atĩrĩ, ‘O mũndũ nĩeyohe rũhiũ rwa njora njohero. Hungurai kambĩ ĩno kuuma mwena ũmwe nginya ũrĩa ũngĩ, o mũndũ nĩoorage mũrũ wa nyina na oorage mũratawe na mũndũ wa itũũra rĩake.’ ”
English: He said to them, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘Every man put his sword on his thigh, and go back and forth from gate to gate throughout the camp, and every man kill his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbor.’ ”

Kikuyu: Alawii magĩĩka ta ũrĩa maathirwo nĩ Musa, na mũthenya ũcio gũkĩũragwo andũ ta 3,000.
English: The sons of Levi did according to the word of Moses. About three thousand men fell of the people that day.

Kikuyu: Nake Musa akiuga atĩrĩ, “Nĩmwarĩkia kwamũrĩrwo Jehova ũmũthĩ, nĩgũkorwo nĩmwareganire na ariũ anyu na mũkĩregana na arĩa mũciaranĩirwo nao, na Jehova nĩamũrathima ũmũthĩ.”
English: Moses said, “Consecrate yourselves today to Yahweh, for every man was against his son and against his brother, that he may give you a blessing today.”

Kikuyu: Mũthenya ũyũ ũngĩ Musa akĩĩra andũ atĩrĩ, “Nĩmwĩhĩtie mũno. No rĩu, nĩngwambata kũrĩ Jehova; hihi no kũhoteke ndĩmũrutĩre horohio nĩ ũndũ wa rĩhia rĩanyu.”
English: On the next day, Moses said to the people, “You have sinned a great sin. Now I will go up to Yahweh. Perhaps I shall make atonement for your sin.”

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Musa agĩcooka kũrĩ Jehova, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Hĩ, kaĩ andũ aya nĩmekĩte rĩhia inene- ĩ! Nĩmethondekeire ngai cia thahabu.
English: Moses returned to Yahweh, and said, “Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made themselves gods of gold.

Kikuyu: No rĩu-rĩ, ndagũthaitha marekere mehia mao; angĩkorwo ndũkũmarekera, o na niĩ tharia ibuku-inĩ rĩrĩa wandĩkĩte andũ aku.”
English: Yet now, if you will, forgive their sin—and if not, please blot me out of your book which you have written.”

Kikuyu: Nake Jehova agĩcookeria Musa atĩrĩ, “Ũrĩa wothe ũnjĩhĩirie, nĩngamũtharia ibuku-inĩ rĩakwa.
English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Whoever has sinned against me, I will blot him out of my book.

Kikuyu: Rĩu gĩthiĩ, ũtongorie andũ acio mathiĩ bũrũri ũrĩa ndaaririe ũhoro waguo, nake mũraika wakwa nĩakamũtongoria. Na rĩrĩ, hĩndĩ ya kũmaherithia yakinya-rĩ, no ngaamaherithia nĩ ũndũ wa mehia mao.”
English: Now go, lead the people to the place of which I have spoken to you. Behold, my angel shall go before you. Nevertheless, in the day when I punish, I will punish them for their sin.”

Kikuyu: Nake Jehova akĩhũũra andũ acio na mũthiro nĩ tondũ wa ũrĩa meekire na njaũ ĩyo yathondeketwo nĩ Harũni.
English: Yahweh struck the people, because of what they did with the calf, which Aaron made.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ, “Umai handũ haha, wee na andũ arĩa warutire kuuma bũrũri wa Misiri, mwambate bũrũri ũrĩa nderĩire Iburahĩmu, na Isaaka na Jakubu na mwĩhĩtwa ngiuga atĩrĩ, ‘Nĩngaũhe njiaro ciaku.’
English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, “Depart, go up from here, you and the people that you have brought up out of the land of Egypt, to the land of which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your offspring.’

Kikuyu: Nĩngũtũma mũraika mbere yanyu na nĩngaingata Akaanani, na Aamori, na Ahiti, na Aperizi, na Ahivi, na Ajebusi.
English: I will send an angel before you; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

Kikuyu: Ambatai mũthiĩ bũrũri ũcio ũrĩ bũthi wa iria na ũũkĩ. No niĩ ndigathiĩ na inyuĩ, tondũ mũrĩ andũ momĩtie ngingo na ndahota kũmũniinĩra njĩra-inĩ.”
English: Go to a land flowing with milk and honey; but I will not go up among you, for you are a stiff-necked people, lest I consume you on the way.”

Kikuyu: Rĩrĩa andũ acio maiguire ciugo icio cia kũmathĩĩnia ngoro, makĩambĩrĩria gũcakaya na gũtirĩ mũndũ wacookire kwĩhumba mathaga.
English: When the people heard this evil news, they mourned; and no one put on his jewelry.

Kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo Jehova nĩeerĩte Musa atĩrĩ, “Ĩra andũ a Isiraeli atĩrĩ, ‘Inyuĩ mũrĩ andũ momĩtie ngingo. Ingĩtwarana na inyuĩ o na kahinda kanini, ndahota kũmũniina. Rĩu rutai mathaga manyu, na nĩngũmenya ũrĩa ngwĩka na inyuĩ.’ ”
English: Yahweh had said to Moses, “Tell the children of Israel, ‘You are a stiff-necked people. If I were to go up among you for one moment, I would consume you. Therefore now take off your jewelry from you, that I may know what to do to you.’ ”

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio andũ a Isiraeli makĩrutĩra mathaga mao hau kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩa Horebu.
English: The children of Israel stripped themselves of their jewelry from Mount Horeb onward.

Kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Musa nĩamenyerete kuoya hema akamĩamba nja ya kambĩ ĩyo handũ haraaya na kambĩ, akamĩĩta “Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo.” Mũndũ o wothe ũngĩendire gũtuĩria ũhoro kũrĩ Jehova, aathiiaga hema-inĩ ĩyo ya gũtũnganwo kũu nja ya kambĩ.
English: Now Moses used to take the tent and pitch it outside the camp, far away from the camp, and he called it “The Tent of Meeting.” Everyone who sought Yahweh went out to the Tent of Meeting, which was outside the camp.

Kikuyu: Na rĩrĩa rĩothe Musa aathiiaga hema-inĩ, andũ othe mookĩraga makarũgama nja ya hema ciao, magacũthĩrĩria Musa nginya rĩrĩa arĩtoonya hema ĩyo.
English: When Moses went out to the Tent, all the people rose up, and stood, everyone at their tent door, and watched Moses, until he had gone into the Tent.

Kikuyu: Musa agĩtoonya hema ĩyo, gĩtugĩ gĩa itu gĩaikũrũkaga gĩgaikara itoonyero-inĩ Jehova akĩaria na Musa.
English: When Moses entered into the Tent, the pillar of cloud descended, stood at the door of the Tent, and Yahweh spoke with Moses.

Kikuyu: Rĩrĩa andũ mona gĩtugĩ kĩu gĩa itu kĩrũgamĩte itoonyero-inĩ rĩa hema ĩyo, othe maarũgamaga makahooya o mũndũ arĩ itoonyero-inĩ rĩa hema yake.
English: All the people saw the pillar of cloud stand at the door of the Tent, and all the people rose up and worshiped, everyone at their tent door.

Kikuyu: Jehova agakĩaria na Musa makĩonanaga ũthiũ kwa ũthiũ o ta ũrĩa mũndũ maaragia na mũratawe. Thuutha ũcio Musa agacooka kambĩ, no Joshua mũrũ wa Nuni, mwanake ũrĩa wamũteithagia, ndoimaga hema-inĩ ĩyo.
English: Yahweh spoke to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his friend. He turned again into the camp, but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, didn’t depart from the Tent.

Kikuyu: Musa akĩĩra Jehova atĩrĩ, “Ũkoretwo ũkĩnjĩĩra atĩrĩ, ‘Tongoria andũ aya,’ no ndũũmenyithĩtie ũrĩa ũkũndũmĩra tũthiĩ nake. Nĩũnjĩrĩte atĩrĩ, ‘Nĩngũũĩ na rĩĩtwa, na wĩ mwĩtĩkĩrĩku harĩ niĩ.’
English: Moses said to Yahweh, “Behold, you tell me, ‘Bring up this people;’ and you haven’t let me know whom you will send with me. Yet you have said, ‘I know you by name, and you have also found favor in my sight.’

Kikuyu: Angĩkorwo nĩũkenetio nĩ niĩ, menyithia njĩra ciaku nĩgeetha ngũmenye na thiĩ na mbere gwĩtĩkĩrĩka nĩwe. Ririkana atĩ rũrĩrĩ rũrũ nĩ andũ aku.”
English: Now therefore, if I have found favor in your sight, please show me your way, now, that I may know you, so that I may find favor in your sight; and consider that this nation is your people.”

Kikuyu: Jehova akĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Niĩ Mwene nĩngũtwarana na inyuĩ na ndĩmũhe ũhurũko.”
English: He said, “My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”

Kikuyu: Nake Musa akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Angĩkorwo ndũgũtwarana hamwe na ithuĩ, ndũgatũme tuume haha.
English: Moses said to him, “If your presence doesn’t go with me, don’t carry us up from here.

Kikuyu: Mũndũ o na ũrĩkũ angĩkĩmenya atĩa atĩ nĩũkenetio nĩ niĩ, na ũgakenio nĩ andũ aku, tiga no ũtwaranire na ithuĩ? Nĩ kĩĩ kĩngĩ kĩngĩonania ngũũrani yakwa na ya andũ aku kuuma kũrĩ andũ arĩa angĩ othe marĩ thĩ ĩno?”
English: For how would people know that I have found favor in your sight, I and your people? Isn’t it that you go with us, so that we are separated, I and your people, from all the people who are on the surface of the earth?”

Kikuyu: Nake Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ, “Nĩngwĩka o ũrĩa ũnjũũrĩtie njĩke, tondũ nĩngenetio nĩwe, na nĩngũũĩ na rĩĩtwa rĩaku.”
English: Yahweh said to Moses, “I will do this thing also that you have spoken; for you have found favor in my sight, and I know you by name.”

Kikuyu: Ningĩ Musa akiuga atĩrĩ, “Nyonia riiri waku ũrĩa ũtariĩ.”
English: Moses said, “Please show me your glory.”

Kikuyu: Nake Jehova akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Nĩngũtũma wega wakwa wothe ũhĩtũkĩre mbere yaku, na nĩngwanĩrĩra rĩĩtwa rĩakwa, Jehova, mbere yaku: Nĩndĩiguagĩra tha ũrĩa ndenda kũiguĩra tha, na nĩndĩcaayagĩra ũrĩa ndenda gũcaĩra.”
English: He said, “I will make all my goodness pass before you, and will proclaim Yahweh’s name before you. I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will show mercy on whom I will show mercy.”

Kikuyu: No Jehova akiuga atĩrĩ, “Ndũngĩona ũthiũ wakwa, nĩgũkorwo gũtirĩ mũndũ ũngĩona ũthiũ wakwa na acooke atũũre muoyo.”
English: He said, “You cannot see my face, for man may not see me and live.”

Kikuyu: Ningĩ Jehova akiuga atĩrĩ, “Nĩ harĩ handũ hakuhĩ na niĩ, harĩa ũngĩrũgama igũrũ rĩa mwaro rwa ihiga.
English: Yahweh also said, “Behold, there is a place by me, and you shall stand on the rock.

Kikuyu: Rĩrĩa riiri wakwa ũrĩkorwo ũkĩhĩtũkĩra hau-rĩ, nĩndĩgũtoonyia mwanya-inĩ wa rwaro rũu rwa ihiga, ngũhumbĩre na guoko gwakwa nginya hĩtũke handũ hau.
English: It will happen, while my glory passes by, that I will put you in a cleft of the rock, and will cover you with my hand until I have passed by;

Kikuyu: Rĩrĩa ndĩrĩeheria guoko gwakwa, nawe nĩũrĩnyona na thuutha; no ũthiũ wakwa ndũngĩonwo.”
English: then I will take away my hand, and you will see my back; but my face shall not be seen.”

Kikuyu: Nake Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ, “Icũhia ihengere igĩrĩ cia mahiga o ta iria cia mbere, na nĩngũciandĩka ciugo iria ciaandĩkĩtwo ihengere-inĩ iria cia mbere, iria woragire.
English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Chisel two stone tablets like the first. I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke.

Kikuyu: Wĩhaarĩrie rũciinĩ, ũcooke wambate kĩrĩma gĩa Sinai. Ũrũgame mbere yakwa hau kĩrĩma igũrũ.
English: Be ready by the morning, and come up in the morning to Mount Sinai, and present yourself there to me on the top of the mountain.

Kikuyu: Gũtikagĩe mũndũ ũkwambatania hamwe nawe kana onekane handũ o hothe kũu kĩrĩma-inĩ; o na gũtikagĩe ndũũru cia mbũri kana cia ngʼombe ingĩrĩithio kũu mbere ya kĩrĩma.”
English: No one shall come up with you or be seen anywhere on the mountain. Do not let the flocks or herds graze in front of that mountain.”

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Musa agĩicũhia ihengere igĩrĩ cia mahiga o ta iria cia mbere na akĩroka kwambata kĩrĩma gĩa Sinai rũciinĩ tene, o ta ũrĩa Jehova aamwathĩte; agĩthiĩ akuuĩte ihengere icio igĩrĩ na moko.
English: He chiseled two tablets of stone like the first; then Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up to Mount Sinai, as Yahweh had commanded him, and took in his hand two stone tablets.

Kikuyu: Nake Jehova agĩikũrũka arĩ itu-inĩ, akĩrũgama hau harĩ we, na akĩanĩrĩra rĩĩtwa rĩake, Jehova.
English: Yahweh descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed Yahweh’s name.

Kikuyu: Agĩkĩhĩtũkĩra mbere ya Musa akĩanagĩrĩra akoiga atĩrĩ, “Jehova, Jehova, Ngai ũrĩa mũcaayanĩri na mũtugi, ũtahiũhaga kũrakara, ũiyũrĩtwo nĩ wendani na wĩhokeku,
English: Yahweh passed by before him, and proclaimed, “Yahweh! Yahweh, a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth,

Kikuyu: ũtũũragia wendani kũrĩ andũ ngiri na ngiri, na akohanagĩra waganu, na ũremi, o na mehia. No rĩrĩ, ndaagaga kũherithia arĩa mehĩtie; nĩaherithagia ciana na ciana ciacio nĩ ũndũ wa mehia ma maithe mao, nginya rũciaro rwa gatatũ na rwa kana.”
English: keeping loving kindness for thousands, forgiving iniquity and disobedience and sin; and who will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, and on the children’s children, on the third and on the fourth generation.”

Kikuyu: Musa agĩkĩinamĩrĩra thĩ o rĩmwe, akĩhooya.
English: Moses hurried and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshiped.

Kikuyu: Akiuga atĩrĩ, “Wee Mwathani, angĩkorwo nĩnjĩtĩkĩrĩkĩte maitho-inĩ maku, ndagũthaitha Mwathani twarana na ithuĩ. O na gũtuĩka aya nĩ andũ momĩtie ngingo-rĩ, tuohere waganu witũ o na mehia maitũ, na ũtũme tũtuĩke igai rĩaku.”
English: He said, “If now I have found favor in your sight, Lord, please let the Lord go among us, even though this is a stiff-necked people; pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for your inheritance.”

Kikuyu: Ningĩ Jehova akiuga atĩrĩ, “Nĩngũgĩa na kĩrĩkanĩro nawe. Nĩndĩrĩĩkaga morirũ matarĩ mekwo rũrĩrĩ-inĩ o na rũrĩkũ thĩinĩ wa thĩ yothe mbere ya andũ aya aku othe. Andũ arĩa mũtũũranagia nao nĩmakeyonera ũrĩa niĩ, Jehova, ngeeka ũndũ wa kũmakania nĩ ũndũ waku.
English: He said, “Behold, I make a covenant: before all your people I will do marvels, such as have not been worked in all the earth, nor in any nation; and all the people among whom you are shall see the work of Yahweh; for it is an awesome thing that I do with you.

Kikuyu: Athĩkĩra ũrĩa ngũgwatha ũmũthĩ. Nĩngarutũrũra Aamori, na Akaanani, na Ahiti, na Aperizi, na Ahivi na Ajebusi mbere yaku makweherere.
English: Observe that which I command you today. Behold, I will drive out before you the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

Kikuyu: Wĩmenyerere ndũkagĩe kĩrĩĩko na andũ arĩa matũũraga bũrũri-inĩ ũcio ũrathiĩ, matigatuĩke mũtego harĩwe.
English: Be careful, lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land where you are going, lest it be for a snare among you;

Kikuyu: Nĩmũkoinanga igongona ciao, na mũthethere mahiga mao maamũre, na mũtemange itugĩ ciao cia Ashera.
English: but you shall break down their altars, and dash in pieces their pillars, and you shall cut down their Asherah poles;

Kikuyu: Mũtikanahooe ngai ĩngĩ o na ĩrĩkũ, nĩgũkorwo Jehova, ũrĩa rĩĩtwa rĩake arĩ Mũigua Ũiru, nĩ Ngai ũrĩ ũiru.
English: for you shall worship no other god; for Yahweh, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God.

Kikuyu: “Mwĩmenyererei mũtikagĩe kĩrĩĩko na andũ arĩa matũũraga bũrũri-inĩ ũcio; nĩgũkorwo rĩrĩa maahũũra ũmaraya na ngai ciao na magacirutĩra iruta, nĩmarĩmwĩtaga, na inyuĩ nĩmũrĩrĩĩaga indo cia magongona macio mao.
English: “Don’t make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, lest they play the prostitute after their gods, and sacrifice to their gods, and one call you and you eat of his sacrifice;

Kikuyu: Na rĩrĩa mũngĩthuura airĩtu amwe ao matuĩke atumia a aanake anyu, nao airĩtu acio mahũũre ũmaraya na ngai ciao, nĩmakonereria ariũ anyu gwĩka ũguo.
English: and you take of their daughters to your sons, and their daughters play the prostitute after their gods, and make your sons play the prostitute after their gods.

Kikuyu: “Ndũkanathondeke mĩhianano ya gũtwekio.
English: “You shall make no cast idols for yourselves.

Kikuyu: “Kũngũyagĩra Gĩathĩ kĩa Mĩgate ĩtarĩ mĩĩkĩre ndawa ya kũimbia. Handũ-inĩ ha mĩthenya mũgwanja, rĩĩagai mĩgate ĩtarĩ mĩĩkĩre ndawa ya kũimbia, o ta ũrĩa ndaamwathire. Ĩkagai ũndũ ũyũ ihinda rĩaguo rĩakinya mweri-inĩ wa Abibu, nĩgũkorwo nĩguo mweri ũrĩa mwoimire bũrũri wa Misiri.
English: “You shall keep the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib; for in the month Abib you came out of Egypt.

Kikuyu: “Irigithathi rĩa nda o yothe nĩ rĩakwa, hamwe na marigithathi mothe ma njamba ma mahiũ manyu, marĩ ma kuuma ndũũru-inĩ cia ngʼombe kana cia mbũri.
English: “All that opens the womb is mine; and all your livestock that is male, the firstborn of cow and sheep.

Kikuyu: Irigithathi rĩa ndigiri ũrĩrĩkũũraga na gatũrũme, no ũngĩaga kũrĩkũũra, riune ngingo. Nao ariũ aku a marigithathi ũmakũũrage. “Gũtikanagĩe mũndũ o na ũmwe ũrĩũkaga mbere yakwa moko matheri.
English: You shall redeem the firstborn of a donkey with a lamb. If you will not redeem it, then you shall break its neck. You shall redeem all the firstborn of your sons. No one shall appear before me empty.

Kikuyu: “Rutaga wĩra mĩthenya ĩtandatũ, no mũthenya wa mũgwanja ũhurũkage; o na hĩndĩ ya icimba na ya magetha no nginya ũhurũke.
English: “Six days you shall work, but on the seventh day you shall rest: in plowing time and in harvest you shall rest.

Kikuyu: “Kũngũyagĩra Gĩathĩ-gĩa-Ciumia, na maciaro ma mbere ma magetha ma ngano, na Gĩathĩ- gĩa-Gũcookereria irio makũmbĩ-inĩ mũthia-inĩ wa mwaka.
English: “You shall observe the feast of weeks with the first fruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of harvest at the year’s end.

Kikuyu: Arũme anyu othe no nginya mokage mbere ya Mwathani Jehova, o we Ngai wa Isiraeli, maita matatũ o mwaka.
English: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord Yahweh, the God of Israel.

Kikuyu: Nĩngarutũrũra ndũrĩrĩ imweherere, na nĩnganenehia mĩhaka ya bũrũri wanyu na gũtirĩ mũndũ ũgaacumĩkĩra bũrũri wanyu rĩrĩa mũrĩkoragwo mũkĩambata maita matatũ o mwaka mbere ya Jehova Ngai wanyu.
English: For I will drive out nations before you and enlarge your borders; neither shall any man desire your land when you go up to appear before Yahweh, your God, three times in the year.

Kikuyu: “Ndũkanandutĩre thakame ya igongona ĩtukanĩte na kĩndũ gĩĩkĩre ndawa ya kũimbia, na mũtikanareke kĩndũ kĩa igongona rĩa Bathaka kĩraare nginya rũciinĩ.
English: “You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. The sacrifice of the feast of the Passover shall not be left to the morning.

Kikuyu: “Rehagai maciaro ma mbere marĩa mega mũno ma mĩgũnda yanyu, mũmarehage nyũmba ya Jehova Ngai wanyu. “Mũtikanaruge koori na iria rĩa nyina.”
English: “You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground to the house of Yahweh your God. “You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.”

Kikuyu: Ningĩ Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ, “Andĩka ciugo ici, nĩgũkorwo kũringana na ciugo ici, nĩndagĩa na kĩrĩkanĩro nawe o na Isiraeli.”
English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Write these words; for in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel.”

Kikuyu: Musa aikarire na Jehova hau matukũ mĩrongo ĩna, mũthenya na ũtukũ, atekũrĩa irio kana akanyua maaĩ. Na agĩkĩandĩka ihengere-inĩ icio ciugo cia kĩrĩkanĩro kĩu, na nĩcio Maathani marĩa Ikũmi.
English: He was there with Yahweh forty days and forty nights; he neither ate bread, nor drank water. He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.

Kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Musa aikũrũkire kuuma kĩrĩma gĩa Sinai arĩ na ihengere igĩrĩ cia Ũira moko-inĩ make, ndaamenyaga atĩ ũthiũ wake nĩwakengaga nĩ ũndũ nĩarĩtie na Jehova.
English: When Moses came down from Mount Sinai with the two tablets of the covenant in Moses’ hand, when he came down from the mountain, Moses didn’t know that the skin of his face shone by reason of his speaking with him.

Kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Harũni na andũ a Isiraeli othe moonire Musa, ũthiũ wake nĩwakengaga, nao magĩĩtigĩra kũmũkuhĩrĩria.
English: When Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come near him.

Kikuyu: No Musa akĩmeeta; nĩ ũndũ ũcio Harũni na atongoria othe a mũingĩ magĩcooka harĩ we, nake akĩmaarĩria.
English: Moses called to them, and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned to him; and Moses spoke to them.

Kikuyu: Thuutha ũcio andũ a Isiraeli othe makĩmũkuhĩrĩria, nake akĩmahe mawatho mothe marĩa Jehova amũheete kũu Kĩrĩma-inĩ gĩa Sinai.
English: Afterward all the children of Israel came near, and he gave them all the commandments that Yahweh had spoken with him on Mount Sinai.

Kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Musa aarĩkirie kũmaarĩria, akĩĩhumbĩra ũthiũ wake na taama wa kwĩhumbĩra ũthiũ.
English: When Moses was done speaking with them, he put a veil on his face.

Kikuyu: No rĩrĩa rĩothe aatoonyaga harĩ Jehova maranĩrie, nĩarutaga taama ũcio wa kwĩhumbĩra ũthiũ nginya oime ho. Na rĩrĩa oka kũrĩ andũ a Isiraeli na aameera ũrĩa aathĩtwo,
English: But when Moses went in before Yahweh to speak with him, he took the veil off, until he came out; and he came out, and spoke to the children of Israel that which he was commanded.

Kikuyu: makona ũthiũ wake o ũkengete. Nake Musa agacookia taama ũcio wa kwĩhumbĩra ũthiũ nginya rĩrĩa rĩngĩ agaathiĩ kwaria na Jehova.
English: The children of Israel saw Moses’ face, that the skin of Moses’ face shone; so Moses put the veil on his face again, until he went in to speak with him.

Kikuyu: Musa nĩonganirie mũingĩ wothe wa andũ a Isiraeli, akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Maya nĩmo maũndũ marĩa Jehova aamwathĩte mwĩkage:
English: Moses assembled all the congregation of the children of Israel, and said to them, “These are the words which Yahweh has commanded, that you should do them.

Kikuyu: Wĩra nĩũrutagwo mĩthenya ĩtandatũ, no mũthenya wa mũgwanja ũrĩkoragwo ũrĩ mũthenya wanyu mũtheru, Thabatũ ya Jehova ya kũhurũka. Ũrĩa ũkaaruta wĩra mũthenya ũcio no nginya ooragwo.
English: ‘Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be a holy day for you, a Sabbath of solemn rest to Yahweh: whoever does any work in it shall be put to death.

Kikuyu: Mũtigaakagie mwaki mũthenya ũcio wa Thabatũ kũrĩa guothe mũrĩtũũraga.”
English: You shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations on the Sabbath day.’ ”

Kikuyu: Musa akĩĩra mũingĩ wothe wa andũ a Isiraeli atĩrĩ, “Ũũ nĩguo Jehova aathanĩte:
English: Moses spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which Yahweh commanded, saying,

Kikuyu: Rutĩrai Jehova maruta kuuma indo-inĩ iria mũrĩ nacio. Mũndũ ũrĩa wothe ũkũigua akĩenda, nĩarehere Jehova iruta rĩa thahabu, na rĩa betha na rĩa gĩcango;
English: ‘Take from among you an offering to Yahweh. Whoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it as Yahweh’s offering: gold, silver, bronze,

Kikuyu: na rĩa ndigi cia rangi wa bururu, na cia rangi wa ndathi, na cia rangimũtune ta gakarakũ; o na gatani ĩrĩa njega; na guoya wa mbũri;
English: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,

Kikuyu: njũa cia ndũrũme itoboketio rangi-inĩ mũtune igatunĩha, na njũa cia pomboo; na mbaũ cia mũgaa;
English: rams’ skins dyed red, sea cow hides, acacia wood,

Kikuyu: na maguta ma mũtamaiyũ ma gwakia tawa; na mahuti manungi wega ma gwĩkĩrwo maguta-inĩ ma gũitanĩrĩrio, na ma ũbumba ũrĩa mũnungi wega;
English: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,

Kikuyu: na tũhiga twa onigithi na tũhiga tũngĩ twa goro twa gũtumĩrĩrwo nguo ya ebodi na gakuo ga gĩthũri.
English: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.

Kikuyu: “Arĩa othe marĩ na ũũgĩ wa ũbundi gatagatĩ-inĩ kanyu, nĩmoke mathondeke indo ciothe iria Jehova aathanĩte, nacio nĩ:
English: “ ‘Let every wise-hearted man among you come, and make all that Yahweh has commanded:

Kikuyu: Hema ĩrĩa nyamũre na hema yayo o na kĩndũ gĩa kũmĩhumbĩra, na ngathĩka cia kũnyiita, na mbaũ ciakĩo, na mĩgamba yakĩo, na itugĩ na itina ciayo;
English: the tabernacle, its outer covering, its roof, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets;

Kikuyu: na ithandũkũ rĩa kĩrĩkanĩro hamwe na mĩtĩ yarĩo, na gĩtĩ gĩa tha, hamwe na gĩtambaya gĩa gũcuurio kĩrĩa gĩa kũhakania;
English: the ark, and its poles, the mercy seat, the veil of the screen;

Kikuyu: metha na mĩtĩ yayo, na indo ciayo ciothe, hamwe na mĩgate ya kũigwo mbere ya Jehova,
English: the table with its poles and all its vessels, and the show bread;

Kikuyu: na mũtĩ wa kũigĩrĩrwo matawa ma kũmũrĩkaga, hamwe na indo ciaguo, na matawa hamwe na maguta ma kũmaakia;
English: the lamp stand also for the light, with its vessels, its lamps, and the oil for the light;

Kikuyu: na kĩgongona kĩa ũbumba na mĩtĩ yakĩo, na maguta ma gũitanĩrĩrio, na ũbumba mũnungi wega; na gĩtambaya gĩa gũcuurio mũrango-inĩ wa itoonyero-inĩ rĩa hema ĩyo nyamũre;
English: and the altar of incense with its poles, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door, at the door of the tabernacle;

Kikuyu: na kĩgongona kĩa iruta rĩa njino hamwe na gĩtara gĩakĩo gĩa gĩcango, na mĩtĩ yakĩo, na indo ciakĩo ciothe; na kĩraĩ gĩa gĩcango na kĩgũrũ gĩakĩo;
English: the altar of burnt offering, with its grating of bronze, its poles, and all its vessels, the basin and its base;

Kikuyu: na itambaya cia gũcuurio cia itoonyero rĩa nja hamwe na itugĩ na itina ciacio na gĩtambaya gĩa gũcuurio gĩa itoonyero rĩa kuuma nja ya hema
English: the hangings of the court, its pillars, their sockets, and the screen for the gate of the court;

Kikuyu: na higĩ cia hema ĩrĩa nyamũre, na cia nja yayo, na mĩkanda yayo;
English: the pins of the tabernacle, the pins of the court, and their cords;

Kikuyu: na nguo ndume cia kwĩhumbagwo mũndũ agĩtungata arĩ handũ-harĩa-haamũre; nĩcio nguo iria nyamũre cia Harũni ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai o na cia ariũ ake rĩrĩa megũtungata marĩ athĩnjĩri-Ngai.”
English: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place—the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons—to minister in the priest’s office.’ ”

Kikuyu: Naguo mũingĩ wothe wa andũ a Isiraeli ũkĩehera harĩ Musa,
English: All the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.

Kikuyu: na mũndũ o wothe ũrĩa weyendeire na ngoro yake yahĩĩahĩaga, nĩokire na akĩrehera Jehova kĩndũ gĩa kũmũrutĩra nĩ ũndũ wa wĩra wa hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo na mawĩra mayo mothe, o na nĩ ũndũ wa nguo iria nyamũre.
English: They came, everyone whose heart stirred him up, and everyone whom his spirit made willing, and brought Yahweh’s offering for the work of the Tent of Meeting, and for all of its service, and for the holy garments.

Kikuyu: Arĩa maiguire metĩkĩra ũhoro ũcio, arũme na andũ-a-nja o ũndũ ũmwe, nĩmookire na makĩrehe mathaga ma thahabu ma mĩthemba yothe: namo nĩ mbini ngʼemie cia gwĩkĩrwo nguo-inĩ, na icũhĩ cia matũ, na icũhĩ cia ciara na mathaga mangĩ. Othe nĩmarehire thahabu yao ĩtuĩke iruta rĩa gũthũngũthio harĩ Jehova.
English: They came, both men and women, as many as were willing-hearted, and brought brooches, earrings, signet rings, and armlets, all jewels of gold; even every man who offered an offering of gold to Yahweh.

Kikuyu: Ũrĩa wothe warĩ na ndigi cia rangi wa bururu, kana cia rangi wa ndathi, kana cia rangi mũtune ta gakarakũ, kana gatani ĩrĩa njega, kana guoya wa mbũri, kana njũa cia ndũrũme itoboketio rangi-inĩ mũtune igatunĩha, kana njũa cia pomboo, nĩacireehire.
English: Everyone with whom was found blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair, rams’ skins dyed red, and sea cow hides, brought them.

Kikuyu: Andũ arĩa maarehire iruta rĩa betha kana rĩa gĩcango, maarĩrehire rĩrĩ iruta harĩ Jehova, na ũrĩa wothe warĩ na mbaũ cia mũgaa nĩ ũndũ wa wĩra ũcio nĩacireehire.
English: Everyone who offered an offering of silver and bronze brought Yahweh’s offering; and everyone with whom was found acacia wood for any work of the service, brought it.

Kikuyu: Mũndũ-wa-nja o wothe warĩ mũũgĩ wĩra-inĩ wa kuogotha ndigi na moko make, akĩrehe kĩrĩa ogothete, ndigi cia rangi wa bururu, kana cia rangi wa ndathi, kana cia rangi mũtune ta gakarakũ, kana gatani ĩrĩa njega.
English: All the women who were wise-hearted spun with their hands, and brought that which they had spun: the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen.

Kikuyu: Nao andũ-a-nja othe arĩa meyendeire na nĩ maarĩ na ũũgĩ ũcio, nĩmoogothire ndigi cia guoya wa mbũri.
English: All the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun the goats’ hair.

Kikuyu: Atongoria marehire tũhiga twa onigithi na tũhiga tũngĩ twa goro tũtumĩrĩrwo nguo-inĩ ya ebodi na gakuo ga gĩthũri.
English: The rulers brought the onyx stones and the stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate;

Kikuyu: Nĩmacookire makĩrehe mahuti manungi wega, na maguta ma mĩtamaiyũ ma gwakia tawa, na maguta ma gũitanĩrĩrio o na ma gũthondeka ũbumba ũrĩa mũnungi wega.
English: with the spice and the oil for the light, for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.

Kikuyu: Andũ a Isiraeli othe, arũme na andũ-a-nja arĩa meyendeire, nĩmareheire Jehova maruta ma kwĩyendera nĩ ũndũ wa wĩra ũrĩa Jehova aamaathĩte na kanua ka Musa marute.
English: The children of Israel brought a free will offering to Yahweh; every man and woman whose heart made them willing to bring for all the work, which Yahweh had commanded to be made by Moses.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ Musa akĩĩra andũ a Isiraeli atĩrĩ, “Onei, Jehova nĩathuurĩte Bezaleli mũrũ wa Uri ũrĩa mũriũ wa Huri, wa mũhĩrĩga wa Juda,
English: Moses said to the children of Israel, “Behold, Yahweh has called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

Kikuyu: na nĩamũiyũrĩtie na Roho wa Ngai, na ũũgĩ, na ũhoti, na ũmenyo wa mawĩra mothe ma ũbundi
English: He has filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship;

Kikuyu: nĩgeetha athugunde mĩcoro ya ũũgĩ ya indo-inĩ cia thahabu, na betha, na gĩcango,
English: and to make skillful works, to work in gold, in silver, in bronze,

Kikuyu: na gwacũhia tũhiga twa goro twa gũthecererwo indo-inĩ, na kũruta wĩra wa gũkaaya mbaũ, na kũruta mawĩra ma mĩcoro ma mĩthemba yothe ya ũbundi.
English: in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of skillful workmanship.

Kikuyu: Na eerĩ, we marĩ na Oholiabu mũrũ wa Ahisamaku wa mũhĩrĩga wa Dani, nĩamaheete ũhoti wa kũruta andũ arĩa angĩ.
English: He has put in his heart that he may teach, both he and Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.

Kikuyu: Nĩamaiyũrĩtie na ũũgĩ wa kũruta mawĩra mothe, marĩ mabundi, na acori, na agemia na ndigi cia rangi wa bururu, na cia rangi wa ndathi, na cia rangi mũtune ta gakarakũ, na gatani ĩrĩa njega, o na atumi: othe marĩ mabundi moogĩ, na acori oogĩ.
English: He has filled them with wisdom of heart to work all kinds of workmanship, of the engraver, of the skillful workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of those who do any workmanship, and of those who make skillful works.

Kikuyu: “Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Bezaleli, na Oholiabu, na mũndũ o wothe warĩ mũũgĩ na wĩra, arĩa Jehova aheete ũũgĩ na ũhoti wa kũmenya kũruta wĩra ũcio wothe wa gwaka handũ-harĩa-haamũre, makĩruta wĩra ũcio o ta ũrĩa Mwathani aathanĩte ũrutwo.”
English: “Bezalel and Oholiab shall work with every wise-hearted man, in whom Yahweh has put wisdom and understanding to know how to do all the work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that Yahweh has commanded.”

Kikuyu: Ningĩ Musa agĩĩta Bezaleli na Oholiabu na mũndũ o wothe warĩ mũũgĩ, ũrĩa Jehova aheete ũhoti, na ũrĩa warĩ na wendo wa gũũka kũruta wĩra ũcio.
English: Moses called Bezalel and Oholiab, and every wise-hearted man, in whose heart Yahweh had put wisdom, even everyone whose heart stirred him up to come to the work to do it.

Kikuyu: Nao makĩamũkĩra kuuma kũrĩ Musa maruta mothe marĩa andũ a Isiraeli maarehete ma kũruta wĩra wa gwaka handũ-harĩa-haamũre. Nao andũ magĩthiĩ o na mbere kũrehe maruta ma kwĩyendera rũciinĩ o rũciinĩ.
English: They received from Moses all the offering which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, with which to make it. They kept bringing free will offerings to him every morning.

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio mabundi mothe marĩa maarĩ na ũũgĩ, arĩa maarutaga wĩra wothe wa gwaka handũ-harĩa-haamũre, makĩamba gũtiga wĩra wao,
English: All the wise men, who performed all the work of the sanctuary, each came from his work which he did.

Kikuyu: na makĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ, “Andũ nĩmararehe indo makĩria ya iria ibatarainie wĩra-inĩ ũrĩa Jehova aathanĩte ũrutwo.”
English: They spoke to Moses, saying, “The people have brought much more than enough for the service of the work which Yahweh commanded to make.”

Kikuyu: Nake Musa akĩruta watho, nao magĩtwara ũhoro ũcio kambĩ-inĩ guothe: “Gũtirĩ mũndũ mũrũme kana mũndũ-wa-nja ũgũcooka kũrehe iruta rĩngĩ nĩ ũndũ wa handũ-harĩa- haamũre.” Nĩ ũndũ ũcio andũ makĩrigĩrĩrio gũcooka kũrehe indo ingĩ,
English: Moses gave a commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, “Let neither man nor woman make anything else for the offering for the sanctuary.” So the people were restrained from bringing.

Kikuyu: tondũ indo iria maarĩ nacio ciarĩ nyingĩ makĩria ma iria ciabatarainie kũruta wĩra ũcio wothe.
English: For the stuff they had was sufficient to do all the work, and too much.

Kikuyu: Andũ othe arĩa maarĩ oogĩ thĩinĩ wa aruti a wĩra magĩthondeka hema nyamũre na itambaya ikũmi cia gũcuurio itumĩtwo na gatani yogothetwo wega na ndigi cia rangi wa bururu, na cia rangi wa ndathi, na cia rangi mũtune ta gakarakũ, na ikĩgemio na makerubi nĩ mũtumi mũũgĩ wa wĩra ũcio.
English: All the wise-hearted men among those who did the work made the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet. They made them with cherubim, the work of a skillful workman.

Kikuyu: Itambaya ciothe cia gũcuurio nĩciaiganaine, ciarĩ cia mĩkono mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na ĩnana* kũraiha, na mĩkono ĩna† kwarama.
English: The length of each curtain was twenty-eight cubits,† and the width of each curtain four cubits. All the curtains had one measure.

Kikuyu: Makĩnyiitithania itambaya ithano hamwe, na magĩĩka o ro ũguo na icio ingĩ ithano.
English: He coupled five curtains to one another, and the other five curtains he coupled to one another.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ magĩkundĩka ciana cia gĩtambaya kĩa rangi wa bururu mũthia-inĩ wa gĩtambaya gĩa gũcuurio kĩrĩa kĩrĩ mũico-inĩ wa mwena ũmwe, na magĩĩka o ro ũguo harĩ gĩtambaya gĩa gũcuurio kĩa mũico kĩa mwena ũcio ũngĩ.
English: He made loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling. Likewise he made in the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the second coupling.

Kikuyu: Magĩcooka magĩkundĩka ciana ingĩ mĩrongo ĩtano gĩtambaya-inĩ kĩmwe gĩa gũcuurio kĩa mwena ũmwe, na ingĩ mĩrongo ĩtano gĩtambaya-inĩ gĩa gũcuurio kĩa mũico kĩa mwena ũcio ũngĩ, o kĩana kĩringaine na kĩrĩa kĩngĩ.
English: He made fifty loops in the one curtain, and he made fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that was in the second coupling. The loops were opposite to one another.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ magĩthondeka ngathĩka mĩrongo ĩtano cia thahabu na magĩcihũthĩra kũohithania itambaya icio cia gũcuurio cia mĩena yeerĩ, nĩ ũndũ ũcio hema ĩyo nyamũre ĩgĩtuĩka kĩndũ kĩmwe.
English: He made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains to one another with the clasps: so the tabernacle was a unit.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ magĩtuma itambaya cia gũcuurio ikũmi na kĩmwe cia guoya wa mbũri igĩtuĩka cia kũhumbĩra hema ĩrĩa nyamũre.
English: He made curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. He made them eleven curtains.

Kikuyu: Itambaya icio ciothe cia gũcuurio ikũmi na kĩmwe nĩciaiganaine; ciarĩ cia mĩkono mĩrongo ĩtatũ‡ kũraiha, na mĩkono ĩna§ kwarama.
English: The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits the width of each curtain. The eleven curtains had one measure.

Kikuyu: Magĩtumithania itambaya ithano cia gũcuurio igĩtuĩka kĩndũ kĩmwe, na cio icio ingĩ ithathatũ igĩtumithanio hamwe.
English: He coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ magĩkundĩka ciana mĩrongo ĩtano mũthia-inĩ wa gĩtambaya gĩa gũcuurio kĩa mũico kĩa mwena ũmwe, na magĩĩka o ũguo mũthia-inĩ wa gĩtambaya gĩa gũcuurio kĩa mũico kĩa mwena ũrĩa ũngĩ.
English: He made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the coupling, and he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which was outermost in the second coupling.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ magĩthondeka ngathĩka mĩrongo ĩtano cia gĩcango cia kuohania hema ĩtuĩke kĩndũ kĩmwe.
English: He made fifty clasps of bronze to couple the tent together, that it might be a unit.

Kikuyu: Magĩcooka magĩthondekera hema kĩhumbĩri kĩa njũa cia ndũrũme itoboketio rangi-inĩ mũtune igatunĩha, na igũrũ wakĩo hakĩhumbĩrwo na njũa cia pomboo.
English: He made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ magĩthondeka buremu cia kũmĩrũgamia cia mbaũ cia mũtĩ wa mũgaa nĩ ũndũ wa hema ĩyo nyamũre.
English: He made the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing up.

Kikuyu: O buremu yarĩ ya mĩkono ikũmi* kũraiha, na mũkono ũmwe na nuthu† kwarama,
English: Ten cubits was the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the width of each board.

Kikuyu: natuo tũhocio tũgĩcomoka tũigananĩirie. Maathondekire buremu ciothe cia hema ĩyo nyamũre na njĩra ĩyo.
English: Each board had two tenons, joined to one another. He made all the boards of the tabernacle this way.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ magĩthondeka buremu mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ cia mwena wa gũthini wa hema ĩyo nyamũre,
English: He made the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side southward.

Kikuyu: na magĩthondeka itina mĩrongo ĩna cia betha cia gwĩkĩrwo rungu rwacio; o itina igĩrĩ ikanyiitĩrĩra buremu ĩmwe, rungu rwa kahocio kamwe.
English: He made forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards: two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.

Kikuyu: Cia mwena ũcio ũngĩ, mwena wa gathigathini wa hema ĩyo nyamũre, magĩthondeka buremu mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ
English: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, he made twenty boards

Kikuyu: na itina mĩrongo ĩna cia betha, o igĩrĩ igaikarĩrwo nĩ buremu ĩmwe.
English: and their forty sockets of silver: two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ magĩthondeka buremu ithathatũ cia mwena wa na thuutha, nĩguo mwena wa mũthia wa ithũĩro wa hema ĩyo nyamũre,
English: For the far part of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.

Kikuyu: na buremu igĩrĩ igĩthondekwo nĩ ũndũ wa tũkoine-inĩ twa hema ĩyo nyamũre cia mwena wa na thuutha.
English: He made two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far part.

Kikuyu: Koine-inĩ ici cierĩ, buremu ciarĩ igĩrĩ igĩrĩ, kuuma thĩ nginya igũrũ, ikoohanio na mũrĩnga ũmwe; nacio cierĩ igakorwo ihaanaine.
English: They were double beneath, and in the same way they were all the way to its top to one ring. He did this to both of them in the two corners.

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio haarĩ na buremu inyanya na itina ikũmi na ithathatũ cia betha; o igĩrĩ igaikarĩrwo nĩ buremu ĩmwe.
English: There were eight boards and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets—under every board two sockets.

Kikuyu: Magĩcooka magĩthondeka mĩgamba ya mbaũ cia mũgaa: ĩtano yayo nĩ ũndũ wa buremu cia mwena ũmwe wa hema ĩyo nyamũre,
English: He made bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

Kikuyu: na ĩtano nĩ ũndũ wa buremu cia mwena ũcio ũngĩ, na ĩtano nĩ ũndũ wa buremu cia mwena wa ithũĩro, mũthia-inĩ wa na thuutha wa hema ĩyo nyamũre.
English: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the hinder part westward.

Kikuyu: Maathondekire mũgamba wa gatagatĩ uumĩte mũthia ũmwe nginya ũrĩa ũngĩ hau gatagatĩ ga buremu icio.
English: He made the middle bar to pass through in the middle of the boards from the one end to the other.

Kikuyu: Nĩmagemirie buremu icio na thahabu, na magĩthondeka mĩrĩnga ya thahabu ya kũnyiitĩrĩra mĩgamba ĩyo. Magĩcooka makĩgemia mĩgamba ĩyo na thahabu.
English: He overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold as places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.

Kikuyu: Nĩmatumire gĩtambaya gĩa gũcuurio kĩa ndigi cia rangi wa bururu, na cia rangi wa ndathi, na cia rangi mũtune ta gakarakũ, na gatani ĩrĩa njogothe wega, na gĩkĩgemio na makerubi nĩ mũbundi mũũgĩ.
English: He made the veil of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. He made it the work of a skillful workman.

Kikuyu: Makĩmĩthondekera itugĩ inya cia mbaũ cia mĩgaa na magĩcigemia na thahabu. Magĩcooka magĩthondeka tũcuurio twa thahabu, na magĩtwekia itina inya ciacio cia betha.
English: He made four pillars of acacia for it, and overlaid them with gold. Their hooks were of gold. He cast four sockets of silver for them.

Kikuyu: Itoonyero-inĩ rĩa hema makĩrĩthondekera gĩtambaya gĩa gũcuurio kĩa ndigi cia rangi wa bururu, na cia rangi wa ndathi, na cia rangi mũtune ta gakarakũ, na gatani ĩrĩa njogothe wega, nakĩo kĩagemetio nĩ mũgemia mũũgĩ;
English: He made a screen for the door of the tent, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of an embroiderer;

Kikuyu: na magĩthondeka itugĩ ithano irĩ na tũcuurio twacio. Makĩgemia itugĩ icio na igũrũ na mĩcibi yacio na thahabu, na magĩcithondekera itina ithano cia gĩcango.
English: and the five pillars of it with their hooks. He overlaid their capitals and their fillets with gold, and their five sockets were of bronze.

Kikuyu: Bezaleli nĩathondekire ithandũkũ rĩa kĩrĩkanĩro rĩa mbaũ cia mũgaa, mũigana wa mĩkono ĩĩrĩ* kũraiha, na mũkono ũmwe na nuthu† kwarama, na mũkono ũmwe na nuthu kũraiha na igũrũ.
English: Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood. Its length was two and a half cubits,† and its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.

Kikuyu: Akĩrĩgemia na thahabu therie thĩinĩ na nja, na akĩrĩtiriha na mũcibi wa thahabu mĩena yothe.
English: He overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside, and made a molding of gold for it around it.

Kikuyu: Nĩarĩtwekeirie icũhĩ inya cia thahabu na agĩciohania na magũrũ marĩo mana, o icũhĩ igĩrĩ mwena ũmwe na icũhĩ igĩrĩ mwena ũrĩa ũngĩ.
English: He cast four rings of gold for it in its four feet—two rings on its one side, and two rings on its other side.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ agĩthondeka mĩtĩ mĩraaya ya mũgaa na akĩmĩgemia na thahabu.
English: He made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.

Kikuyu: Agĩcooka agĩtoonyia mĩtĩ ĩyo mĩraaya mĩrĩnga-inĩ ĩyo yarĩ mĩena-inĩ ya ithandũkũ ĩrĩ ya kũrĩkuua.
English: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.

Kikuyu: Nĩarĩthondekeire gĩtĩ gĩa tha gĩa thahabu, therie kĩa ũraihu wa mĩkono ĩrĩ na nuthu,‡ na wariĩ wa mũkono ũmwe na nuthu.§
English: He made a mercy seat of pure gold. Its length was two and a half cubits, and a cubit and a half its width.

Kikuyu: Agĩcooka agĩtura makerubi meerĩ ma thahabu akĩmekĩra mĩthia- inĩ ya gĩtĩ kĩu gĩa tha.
English: He made two cherubim of gold. He made them of beaten work, at the two ends of the mercy seat:

Kikuyu: Nĩathondekire ikerubi rĩmwe rĩikare mũthia-inĩ ũmwe na ikerubi rĩu rĩngĩ rĩikare mũthia-inĩ ũrĩa ũngĩ; mĩthia-inĩ ĩyo yeerĩ akĩmathondeka marĩ kĩndũ kĩmwe na gĩtĩ gĩa tha.
English: one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. He made the cherubim of one piece with the mercy seat at its two ends.

Kikuyu: Mathagu ma makerubi macio matambũrũkĩtio na igũrũ, magathiĩka gĩtĩ kĩu gĩa tha. Makerubi macio maathondeketwo maroranĩte, na marorete gĩtĩ kĩu gĩa tha.
English: The cherubim spread out their wings above, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim were toward the mercy seat.

Kikuyu: Nĩmathondekire metha ya mbaũ cia mũgaa, ũraihu wayo warĩ mĩkono ĩĩrĩ,* na wariĩ wayo warĩ mũkono ũmwe,† na kũraiha na igũrũ kwayo kwarĩ mũkono ũmwe na nuthu.‡
English: He made the table of acacia wood. Its length was two cubits, and its width was a cubit, and its height was a cubit and a half.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ makĩmĩgemia na thahabu therie, na makĩmĩtiriha na mũcibi wa thahabu.
English: He overlaid it with pure gold, and made a gold molding around it.

Kikuyu: Magĩcooka makĩmĩthondekera karũbaũ gaceke ka wariĩ wa rũhĩ,§ gagĩthiũrũrũkĩria metha ĩyo, na magĩgatiriha na mũcibi wa thahabu.
English: He made a border of a hand’s width around it, and made a golden molding on its border around it.

Kikuyu: Magĩtwekeria metha ĩyo mĩrĩnga ĩna ya thahabu, na makĩmĩoherera koine-inĩ inya ciayo, o harĩa magũrũ mayo mana maarĩ.
English: He cast four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that were on its four feet.

Kikuyu: Icũhĩ icio ciekĩrirwo hakuhĩ na mũcibi wa karũbaũ karĩa gaceke, nĩgeetha ĩnyiitagĩrĩre mĩtĩ ĩrĩa mĩraaya yahũthagĩrwo gũkuua metha ĩyo.
English: The rings were close by the border, the places for the poles to carry the table.

Kikuyu: Mĩtĩ ĩyo mĩraaya ya gũkuua metha yarĩ ya mbaũ cia mũgaa, na ĩkagemio na thahabu.
English: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold, to carry the table.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ magĩthondeka indo cia thahabu therie, cia kũigagĩrĩrwo metha, na nacio nĩ: thaani, na thaani nene, na mbakũri, na ndigithũ cia gũitaga iruta rĩa kũnyuuo.
English: He made the vessels which were on the table, its dishes, its spoons, its bowls, and its pitchers with which to pour out, of pure gold.

Kikuyu: Nĩmathondekire mũtĩ wa kũigĩrĩrwo matawa wa thahabu therie. Mũrũgamo waguo na gĩtina kĩaguo igĩturwo inyiitanĩte o hamwe na ikombe ciaguo na mahũa maguo, na tũkonyo twaguo; ciothe igĩkorwo irĩ kĩndũ kĩmwe naguo.
English: He made the lamp stand of pure gold. He made the lamp stand of beaten work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers were of one piece with it.

Kikuyu: Mũtĩ ũcio warĩ na honge ithathatũ ciumĩte mĩena-inĩ ya mũrũgamo wa mũtĩ ũcio wa kũigĩrĩrwo matawa; ithatũ mwena ũmwe, na ithatũ mwena ũrĩa ũngĩ.
English: There were six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side:

Kikuyu: Ikombe ithatũ ciaturĩtwo ihaana ta mahũa ma mũrothi, irĩ na tũkonyo na mahũa, igakorwo rũhonge-inĩ rũmwe, nacio ithatũ igakorwo rũhonge-inĩ rũu rũngĩ; honge icio ciothe ithathatũ ciahaanaga ũguo ciumĩte mũtĩ-inĩ ũcio wa kũigĩrĩrwo matawa.
English: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower, and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower; so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.

Kikuyu: Na mũtĩ-inĩ ũcio wa kũigĩrĩrwo matawa haarĩ na ikombe inya ciathondeketwo ihaana ta mahũa ma mũrothi, irĩ na tũkonyo na mahũa.
English: In the lamp stand were four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;

Kikuyu: Gakonyo kamwe kaarĩ rungu rwa honge igĩrĩ ciumĩte mũrũgamo-inĩ wa mũtĩ ũcio wa kũigĩrĩrwo matawa, nako gakonyo ga keerĩ kaarĩ rungu rwa honge cia keerĩ igĩrĩ, na gakonyo ga gatatũ kaarĩ rungu rwa honge cia gatatũ igĩrĩ; ciothe ciarĩ honge ithathatũ.
English: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of it.

Kikuyu: Tũkonyo na honge ciarĩ kĩndũ kĩmwe na mũtĩ ũcio wa kũigĩrĩrwo matawa, iturĩtwo kuuma thahabu therie.
English: Their buds and their branches were of one piece with it. The whole thing was one beaten work of pure gold.

Kikuyu: Nĩmathondekire matawa mũgwanja maguo, o ũndũ ũmwe na magathĩ ma gũtinia ndaambĩ, na thaani cia mũrarĩ wa ndaambĩ, cia thahabu therie.
English: He made its seven lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff dishes, of pure gold.

Kikuyu: Maahũthĩrire taranda ĩmwe* ya thahabu therie gũthondeka mũtĩ ũcio wa kũigĩrĩrwo matawa na indo ciaguo ciothe.
English: He made it of a talent‡ of pure gold, with all its vessels.

Kikuyu: Nĩmathondekire kĩgongona gĩa gũcinĩra ũbumba na mbaũ cia mũgaa. Kĩaiganaine mĩena yothe, mũigana wa mũkono ũmwe† kũraiha, na mũkono ũmwe kwarama, na mĩkono ĩĩrĩ‡ kũraiha na igũrũ. Hĩa ciakĩo ciarĩ kĩndũ kĩmwe na kĩgongona.
English: He made the altar of incense of acacia wood. It was square: its length was a cubit, and its width a cubit. Its height was two cubits. Its horns were of one piece with it.

Kikuyu: Magĩkĩgemia igũrũ na mĩena yothe o na hĩa ciakĩo na thahabu therie na magĩgĩtiriha na mũcibi wa thahabu ũgĩgĩthiũrũrũkĩria.
English: He overlaid it with pure gold: its top, its sides around it, and its horns. He made a gold molding around it.

Kikuyu: Magĩthondeka mĩrĩnga ĩĩrĩ ya thahabu mũhuro wa mũcibi ũcio, ĩĩrĩ mwena ũmwe na ĩĩrĩ mwena ũrĩa ũngĩ. Mĩrĩnga ĩyo nĩyo yatoonyagio mĩtĩ ĩrĩa mĩraihu yatũmagĩrwo gũgĩkuua.
English: He made two golden rings for it under its molding crown, on its two ribs, on its two sides, for places for poles with which to carry it.

Kikuyu: Magĩcooka magĩthondeka mĩtĩ ĩngĩ mĩraaya ya mũgaa na makĩmĩgemia na thahabu.
English: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold.

Kikuyu: O na ningĩ magĩthondeka maguta matheru ma gũitanĩrĩrio na ũbumba mũnungi wega ũrĩa mũtherie, wĩra wa mũthondeki mũũgĩ wa maguta.
English: He made the holy anointing oil and the pure incense of sweet spices, after the art of the perfumer.

Kikuyu: Nĩmakire kĩgongona kĩa iruta rĩa njino kĩa mbaũ cia mũgaa, kĩa mĩkono ĩtatũ* kũraiha na igũrũ; kĩaiganaine mĩena yothe; mĩkono ĩtano† kũraiha na mĩkono ĩtano kwarama.
English: He made the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood. It was square. Its length was five cubits,† its width was five cubits, and its height was three cubits.

Kikuyu: Nĩmathondekire hĩa inya, o rũmwe koine-inĩ ĩmwe ya kĩgongona, nĩ ũndũ ũcio hĩa icio na kĩgongona igĩtuĩka kĩndũ kĩmwe, na makĩgemia kĩgongona kĩu na gĩcango.
English: He made its horns on its four corners. Its horns were of one piece with it, and he overlaid it with bronze.

Kikuyu: Nĩmathondekire indo ciakĩo ciothe irĩ cia gĩcango; na nĩcio nyũngũ, na icakũri, na mbakũri cia wĩra wa kũminjaminjĩria, na njibe cia nyama, na ngĩo cia mwaki.
English: He made all the vessels of the altar: the pots, the shovels, the basins, the forks, and the fire pans. He made all its vessels of bronze.

Kikuyu: Nĩmathondekire kĩrũtara gĩa kĩgongona gĩa gĩcango, gĩa kũigwo rungu rwa muoho wakĩo, rũkinye nuthu ya ũraihu wa kĩgongona.
