English: He made for the altar a grating of a network of bronze, under the ledge around it beneath, reaching halfway up.

Kikuyu: Magĩtwekia mĩrĩnga ya gĩcango ya kũnyiitĩrĩra mĩtĩ ĩrĩa mĩraaya ya koine inya cia kĩrũtara gĩa gĩcango.
English: He cast four rings for the four corners of bronze grating, to be places for the poles.

Kikuyu: Magĩthondeka mĩtĩ mĩraaya ya mbaũ cia mũgaa na magĩcigemia na gĩcango.
English: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with bronze.

Kikuyu: Magĩtoonyia itugĩ icio mĩrĩnga-inĩ nĩguo ikoragwo mĩena-inĩ ya kĩgongona nĩ ũndũ wa gũgĩkuua. Maagĩthondekire na mbaũ, kĩrĩ na ihoro thĩinĩ.
English: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar, with which to carry it. He made it hollow with planks.

Kikuyu: Nĩmathondekire kĩraĩ gĩa gwĩthambĩra gĩa gĩcango na kĩgũrũ gĩakĩo gĩa gĩcango kuuma icicio-inĩ cia andũ-a-nja arĩa maarutaga wĩra itoonyero-inĩ rĩa Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo.
English: He made the basin of bronze, and its base of bronze, out of the mirrors of the ministering women who ministered at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

Kikuyu: Thuutha ũcio magĩthondeka nja ya hema ĩyo nyamũre. Mwena wa gũthini ũgĩĩkĩrwo ũrĩ wa mĩkono igana‡ kũraiha, na warĩ na itambaya cia gũcuurio cia gatani yogothetwo wega.
English: He made the court: for the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, one hundred cubits;

Kikuyu: Itambaya icio ciarĩ na itugĩ mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ, na itina ciacio mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ cia gĩcango, na tũcuurio na tũmĩkwa twa betha, twĩkĩrĩtwo itugĩ-inĩ icio.
English: their pillars were twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.

Kikuyu: Mwena wa gathigathini o naguo warĩ wa mĩkono igana kũraiha, na warĩ na itugĩ mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na itina ciacio mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ cia gĩcango, na warĩ na tũcuurio na tũmĩkwa twa betha twĩkĩrĩtwo itugĩ-inĩ.
English: For the north side one hundred cubits, their pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

Kikuyu: Mwena wa ithũĩro wa nja ĩyo warĩ wa mĩkono mĩrongo ĩtano§ kwarama na warĩ na itambaya cia gũcuurio, na itugĩ ikũmi na itina ikũmi na warĩ na tũcuurio na tũmĩkwa twa betha twĩkĩrĩtwo itugĩ-inĩ.
English: For the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

Kikuyu: Mwena wa irathĩro o naguo warĩ wa mĩkono mĩrongo ĩtano kwarama.
English: For the east side eastward fifty cubits,

Kikuyu: Itambaya cia gũcuurio ciarĩ cia ũraihu wa mĩkono ikũmi na ĩtano,* na ciarĩ mwena ũmwe wa itoonyero rĩa nja ĩyo, irĩ na itugĩ ithatũ na itina ithatũ;
English: the hangings for the one side were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three;

Kikuyu: na itambaya cia gũcuurio ciarĩ cia ũraihu wa mĩkono ikũmi na ĩtano na ciarĩ mwena ũcio ũngĩ wa itoonyero, irĩ na itugĩ ithatũ na itina ithatũ.
English: and so for the other side: on this hand and that hand by the gate of the court were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

Kikuyu: Itambaya ciothe cia gũcuurio iria ciathiũrũrũkĩirie nja ciarĩ cia gatani yogothetwo wega.
English: All the hangings around the court were of fine twined linen.

Kikuyu: Itina cia itugĩ icio ciarĩ cia gĩcango. Tũcuurio na tũmĩkwa tũrĩa twekĩrĩtwo itugĩ-inĩ twarĩ twa betha na igũrũ wacio ciagemetio na betha; Nĩ ũndũ ũcio itugĩ ciothe cia nja ĩyo ciarĩ na tũmĩkwa twa betha.
English: The sockets for the pillars were of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver. Their capitals were overlaid with silver. All the pillars of the court had silver bands.

Kikuyu: Itambaya cia gũcuurio cia itoonyero rĩa nja ĩyo ciarĩ cia ndigi cia rangi wa bururu, na cia rangi wa ndathi, na cia rangi mũtune ta gakarakũ, na gatani ĩrĩa njogothe wega; wĩra wa mũgemia mũũgĩ. Yarĩ ya mĩkono mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ† kũraiha, na mĩkono ĩtano‡ kũraiha na igũrũ, o ta ũrĩa itambaya cia gũcuurio cia nja ĩyo ciatariĩ.
English: The screen for the gate of the court was the work of the embroiderer, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen. Twenty cubits was the length, and the height along the width was five cubits, like the hangings of the court.

Kikuyu: na ĩgĩkorwo na itugĩ inya na itina inya cia gĩcango. Tũcuurio na tũmĩkwa twacio twarĩ twa betha, na igũrũ wacio ciagemetio na betha.
English: Their pillars were four, and their sockets four, of bronze; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their capitals, and their fillets, of silver.

Kikuyu: Higĩ ciothe cia hema ĩyo nyamũre na cia nja ĩrĩa yamĩthiũrũrũkĩirie ciarĩ cia gĩcango.
English: All the pins of the tabernacle, and around the court, were of bronze.

Kikuyu: Ũyũ nĩguo mũigana wa indo iria ciahũthĩrirwo gwaka hema ĩyo nyamũre, Hema-ĩrĩa-ya-Ũira, iria ciandĩkirwo nĩ Alawii o ta ũrĩa Musa aathanĩte matongoretio nĩ Ithamaru mũrũ wa Harũni ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai.
English: These are the amounts of materials used for the tabernacle, even the Tabernacle of the Testimony, as they were counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.

Kikuyu: (Bezaleli mũrũ wa Uri, ũrĩa warĩ mũrũ wa Huri, wa mũhĩrĩga wa Juda, nĩathondekire kĩrĩa gĩothe Jehova aathĩte Musa;
English: Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that Yahweh commanded Moses.

Kikuyu: nake aarĩ hamwe na Oholiabu mũrũ wa Ahisamaku, wa mũhĩrĩga wa Dani, ũrĩa warĩ mũbundi na mũcori mũũgĩ, na wamenyete kũgemia na ndigi cia rangi wa bururu, na cia rangi wa ndathi, na cia rangi mũtune ta gakarakũ, na gatani ĩrĩa njega.)
English: With him was Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a skillful workman, and an embroiderer in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen.

Kikuyu: Mũigana wa thahabu yothe ĩrĩa yarutirwo kuuma kũrĩ iruta rĩa gũthũngũthio ĩrĩa yahũthĩrirwo kũruta wĩra wothe wa handũ-harĩa-haamũre, yarĩ taranda 29 na cekeri 730,§ kũringana na cekeri ya handũ-harĩa- haamũre.
English: All the gold that was used for the work in all the work of the sanctuary, even the gold of the offering, was twenty-nine talents‡ and seven hundred thirty shekels, according to the shekel§ of the sanctuary.

Kikuyu: Betha ĩrĩa yarehirwo nĩ mũingĩ ũrĩa watarirwo hĩndĩ ya itarana yarĩ taranda 100 na cekeri 1,775,* kũringana na cekeri ya handũ-harĩa-haamũre,
English: The silver of those who were counted of the congregation was one hundred talents† and one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels,‡ according to the shekel of the sanctuary:

Kikuyu: o mũndũ aarutĩte beka ĩmwe,† nayo nĩ ũndũ ũmwe na nuthu ya cekeri, kũringana na cekeri ya handũ-harĩa-haamũre, nayo yarutirwo nĩ mũndũ o wothe wakĩraga agathiĩ harĩ arĩa maatarĩtwo, arĩa maarĩ na ũkũrũ wa mĩaka mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na makĩria, nao othe maarĩ arũme 603,550.
English: a beka§ a head, that is, half a shekel, according to the shekel† of the sanctuary, for everyone who passed over to those who were counted, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty men.

Kikuyu: Taranda icio 100 cia betha‡ ciahũthĩrirwo gũtwekia itina cia handũ- harĩa-haamũre na itina cia itambaya cia gũcuurio; taranda 100 igĩaka itina 100, ũguo nĩ ta kuuga taranda ĩmwe ĩgaaka gĩtina kĩmwe.
English: The one hundred talents‡ of silver were for casting the sockets of the sanctuary and the sockets of the veil: one hundred sockets for the one hundred talents, one talent per socket.

Kikuyu: Nĩmahũthĩrire cekeri icio 1,775§ gũthondeka tũcuurio twa itugĩ, na kũgemia itugĩ na igũrũ, na gũthondeka tũmĩkwa twacio.
English: From the one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels§ he made hooks for the pillars, overlaid their capitals, and made fillets for them.

Kikuyu: Gĩcango kĩrĩa kĩarutĩtwo kuuma iruta rĩa gũthũngũthio kĩarĩ gĩa taranda 70 na cekeri 2,400.*
English: The bronze of the offering was seventy talents† and two thousand four hundred shekels.‡

Kikuyu: Maahũthĩrire gĩcango kĩu na gũthondeka itina cia itoonyero rĩa Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo, na gwaka kĩgongona gĩa gĩcango hamwe na kĩrũtara gĩakĩo gĩa gĩcango na indo ciakĩo ciothe,
English: With this he made the sockets to the door of the Tent of Meeting, the bronze altar, the bronze grating for it, all the vessels of the altar,

Kikuyu: na gwaka itina cia nja ĩrĩa yamĩthiũrũrũkĩirie na itina iria cia itoonyero rĩayo, na higĩ ciothe cia hema ĩyo nyamũre, na higĩ cia nja ĩrĩa yamĩthiũrũrũkĩirie. 39
English: the sockets around the court, the sockets of the gate of the court, all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins around the court.

Kikuyu: Nĩmatumire nguo na ndigi cia rangi wa bururu, na cia rangi wa ndathi, na cia rangi mũtune ta gakarakũ, cia kũrutaga wĩra nacio handũ-harĩa-haamũre. Magĩcooka magĩtumĩra Harũni nguo theru, o ta ũrĩa Jehova aathĩte Musa.
English: Of the blue, purple, and scarlet, they made finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

Kikuyu: Nĩmatumire ebodi na ndigi cia rangi wa thahabu, na ndigi cia rangi wa bururu, na cia rangi wa ndathi na cia rangi mũtune ta gakarakũ, na cia gatani ĩrĩa yogothetwo wega.
English: He made the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.

Kikuyu: Nĩmahũũrire thahabu makĩmĩtua tũbaati tũhũthu, magĩtũtinangia nguucio cia gũtumanio na ndigi cia rangi wa bururu, na cia rangi wa ndathi, na cia rangi mũtune ta gakarakũ, na gatani ĩrĩa njega, wĩra wa mũbundi mũũgĩ.
English: They beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in with the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen, the work of the skillful workman.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ nĩmatumire ndaamĩ cia ciande cia ebodi, nacio ikĩohererwo koine-inĩ igĩrĩ ciayo, nĩguo inyiitithanio nayo.
English: They made shoulder straps for it, joined together. It was joined together at the two ends.

Kikuyu: Naguo mũcibi wayo wa njohero watumĩtwo wega ũkahaanana nayo, na warĩ o gĩcunjĩ kĩmwe na ebodi, na ũgathondekwo na ndigi cia rangi wa thahabu, na ndigi cia rangi wa bururu, na cia rangi wa ndathi, na cia rangi mũtune ta gakarakũ, na gatani ĩrĩa yogothetwo wega, o ta ũrĩa Jehova aathĩte Musa.
English: The skillfully woven band that was on it, with which to fasten it on, was of the same piece, like its work: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

Kikuyu: Nao magĩtumĩrĩra tũhiga twa onigithi tũkonyo-inĩ twa thahabu, na magĩtũkurura marĩĩtwa ma ariũ a Isiraeli, o ta ũrĩa mũndũ akururaga kahengere ka mũhũũri.
English: They worked the onyx stones, enclosed in settings of gold, engraved with the engravings of a signet, according to the names of the children of Israel.

Kikuyu: Magĩcooka magĩtuoherera ndaamĩ-inĩ cia ciande cia ebodi tũrĩ twa kĩririkania kĩa ariũ a Isiraeli, o ta ũrĩa Jehova aathĩte Musa.
English: He put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

Kikuyu: Magĩthondeka gakuo ga gwĩkĩrwo ga gĩthũri; karĩ wĩra wa mũbundi mũũgĩ. Magĩgathondeka o ta ebodi ĩyo: karĩ ga thahabu, na ka ndigi cia rangi wa bururu, na cia rangi wa ndathi, na cia rangi mũtune ta gakarakũ, na gatani ĩrĩa yogothetwo wega.
English: He made the breastplate, the work of a skillful workman, like the work of the ephod: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.

Kikuyu: Gakuo kau kaiganaine mĩena yothe ĩna, karĩ ka inji kenda* kũraiha na inji kenda kwarama, na gakoinanĩrwo maita meerĩ.
English: It was square. They made the breastplate double. Its length was a span,† and its width a span, being double.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ magĩgatumĩrĩra mĩhari ĩna ya tũhiga twa goro. Mũhari wa mbere magĩtumĩrĩra kahiga ka wakiki ũrĩa mũtune, na ka yakuti ĩrĩa ĩhaana ngoikoni, na ka baregethu;
English: They set in it four rows of stones. A row of ruby, topaz, and beryl was the first row;

Kikuyu: mũhari wa keerĩ magĩtumĩrĩra kahiga ga thumarati, na ka yakuti ĩrĩa ya rangi wa bururu, na ka arimathi;
English: and the second row, a turquoise, a sapphire,‡ and an emerald;

Kikuyu: mũhari wa gatatũ magĩtumĩrĩra kahiga ka wakiki ũrĩa wa bururu, na ka yacimu, na ka amethuthito;
English: and the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

Kikuyu: mũhari wa kana magĩtumĩrĩra kahiga ga thumarati ĩrĩa theru, na ka onigithi, na ka njathibi. Natuo tũgĩtumĩrĩrwo tũkonyo-inĩ tũgemie twa thahabu.
English: and the fourth row, a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They were enclosed in gold settings.

Kikuyu: Tũgĩkorwo tũrĩ tũhiga ikũmi na twĩrĩ, o kamwe gakarũgamĩrĩra rĩmwe rĩa marĩĩtwa ma ariũ a Isiraeli, o kamwe gagakururwo rĩĩtwa rĩa mũhĩrĩga ũmwe wa ĩrĩa ikũmi na ĩĩrĩ ya Isiraeli, o ta ũrĩa kahengere ka mũhũũri gakururagwo.
English: The stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, for the twelve tribes.

Kikuyu: Nĩmathondekeire gakuo kau ga gĩthũri mĩgathĩ ya thahabu therie, ĩhaana ta mũkanda.
English: They made on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ magĩthondeka tũkonyo twĩrĩ tũgemie twa thahabu, na mĩrĩnga ĩĩrĩ ya thahabu, na makĩoherera mĩrĩnga ĩyo koine-inĩ igĩrĩ cia gakuo kau ga gĩthũri.
English: They made two settings of gold, and two gold rings, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

Kikuyu: Makĩnyiitithania mĩgathĩ ĩyo ĩĩrĩ ya thahabu na mĩrĩnga ĩrĩa yarĩ koine-inĩ cia gakuo kau ga gĩthũri,
English: They put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.

Kikuyu: na mĩthia ĩrĩa ĩngĩ ya mĩgathĩ makĩmĩnyiitithania na tũkonyo tũu twĩrĩ twarĩ tũgemie twa thahabu, magĩtuohania na ndaamĩ cia kĩande kĩa ebodi mwena wa mbere.
English: The other two ends of the two braided chains they put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, in its front.

Kikuyu: Magĩthondeka mĩrĩnga ĩĩrĩ ya thahabu na makĩmĩnyiitithania na koine igĩrĩ cia gakuo ga gĩthũri mũico-inĩ wa na thĩinĩ, kũrigania na ebodi.
English: They made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which was toward the side of the ephod inward.

Kikuyu: Magĩcooka magĩthondeka mĩrĩnga ĩngĩ ĩĩrĩ ya thahabu na makĩmĩnyiitithania na mwena wa magũrũ-inĩ ma ndaamĩ cia kĩande mwena-inĩ wa mbere wa ebodi, hakuhĩ na rũtumo, igũrũ hanini wa mũcibi wa ebodi.
English: They made two more rings of gold, and put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its front, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

Kikuyu: Makĩohania mĩrĩnga ya gakuo ga gĩthũri kũrĩ mĩrĩnga ya ebodi na rũrigi rwa rangi wa bururu, magĩcinyiitithania na mũcibi wa njohero nĩgeetha gakuo ga gĩthũri gatikarekanie na ebodi, o ta ũrĩa Jehova aathĩte Musa.
English: They bound the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not come loose from the ephod, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

Kikuyu: Nĩmatumire nguo ndaaya ya ebodi ya taama wa bururu mũtheri, nayo yatumĩtwo nĩ mũtumi mũũgĩ.
English: He made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.

Kikuyu: Yarĩ na harũkĩrio ya gũtoonyeria mũtwe gatagatĩ kayo, ningĩ ĩgĩtirihwo mĩthia-inĩ ta kara, nĩgeetha ndĩgatarũke.
English: The opening of the robe in the middle of it was like the opening of a coat of mail, with a binding around its opening, that it should not be torn.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ magĩthondeka tũcunjuura tũtariĩ ta matunda ma makomamanga, twa ndigi cia rangi wa bururu, na twa ndigi cia rangi wa ndathi, na twa rangi mũtune ta gakarakũ, na gatani ĩrĩa yogothetwo wega, tũgĩthiũrũrũka rũtumo rwa magũrũ-inĩ ma nguo ĩyo ndaaya.
English: They made on the skirts of the robe pomegranates of blue, purple, scarlet, and twined linen.

Kikuyu: Magĩcooka magĩthondeka ngengere cia thahabu therie magĩcitumĩrĩra rũtumo-inĩ rũu gatagatĩ ga tũcunjuura tũu tũhaana matunda ma makomamanga.
English: They made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates around the skirts of the robe, between the pomegranates;

Kikuyu: Ngengere na tũcunjuura tũu tũhaana matunda ma makomamanga igĩthiĩ ihakanĩtio gũthiũrũrũka rũtumo rwa nguo ĩyo ndaaya; ya kwĩhumbwo nĩ mũndũ agĩtungata, o ta ũrĩa Jehova aathĩte Musa.
English: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, around the skirts of the robe, to minister in, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

Kikuyu: Nĩmatumĩire Harũni na ariũ ake kanjũ cia gatani njega, itumĩtwo nĩ mũtumi mũũgĩ.
English: They made the tunics of fine linen of woven work for Aaron and for his sons,

Kikuyu: Makĩmatumĩra iremba cia gatani njega, na tũkũbia twa gatani, na thuruarĩ cia thĩinĩ cia gatani ĩrĩa yogothetwo wega.
English: the turban of fine linen, the linen headbands of fine linen, the linen trousers of fine twined linen,

Kikuyu: Mũcibi warĩ wa gatani ĩrĩa njogothe wega na ndigi cia rangi wa bururu, na cia rangi wa ndathi, na cia rangi mũtune ta gakarakũ, wĩra wa mũgemia mũũgĩ, o ta ũrĩa Jehova aathĩte Musa.
English: the sash of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet, the work of the embroiderer, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

Kikuyu: Magĩthondeka gatanji kaamũre ga thahabu therie, na igũrũ rĩako magĩkurura, o ta ũrĩa mũhũũri ũkururagwo, ciugo ici: MŨTHERU MWAMŨRĨRE JEHOVA.
English: They made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote on it an inscription, like the engravings of a signet: “HOLY TO YAHWEH”.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ makĩoherera gatanji kau na rũrigi rwa rangi wa bururu, magĩkanyiitithania na kĩremba, o ta ũrĩa Jehova aathĩte Musa.
English: They tied to it a lace of blue, to fasten it on the turban above, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio wĩra wothe wa gwaka hema ĩyo nyamũre na Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo ũkĩrĩka. Andũ a Isiraeli magĩĩka maũndũ mothe o ta ũrĩa Jehova aathĩte Musa.
English: Thus all the work of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting was finished. The children of Israel did according to all that Yahweh commanded Moses; so they did.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ makĩrehe hema ĩyo nyamũre kũrĩ Musa: hema na indo ciayo ciothe na ngathĩka ciayo, na buremu, na mĩgamba, na itugĩ na itina ciayo;
English: They brought the tabernacle to Moses: the tent, with all its furniture, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,

Kikuyu: na kĩhumbĩri kĩa njũa cia ndũrũme itoboketio rangi-inĩ mũtune, igatunĩha, na kĩhumbĩri kĩa njũa cia pomboo, na gĩtambaya gĩa gũcuurio gĩa kũhakania;
English: the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, the covering of sea cow hides, the veil of the screen,

Kikuyu: ithandũkũ rĩa Ũira na mĩtĩ mĩraaya yarĩo, hamwe na gĩtĩ gĩa tha;
English: the ark of the covenant with its poles, the mercy seat,

Kikuyu: metha na indo ciayo ciothe, na mĩgate ya kũigwo Mbere ya Jehova;
English: the table, all its vessels, the show bread,

Kikuyu: mũtĩ wa thahabu therie wa kũigĩrĩrwo matawa, hamwe na mĩhari ya matawa na indo ciaguo ciothe, o na maguta ma kũmaakia;
English: the pure lamp stand, its lamps, even the lamps to be set in order, all its vessels, the oil for the light,

Kikuyu: kĩgongona gĩa thahabu, na maguta ma gũitanĩrĩrio, na ũbumba mũnungi wega, na gĩtambaya gĩa gũcuurio gĩa itoonyero-inĩ rĩa hema;
English: the golden altar, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door of the Tent,

Kikuyu: kĩgongona gĩa gĩcango hamwe na kĩrũtara gĩakĩo gĩa gĩcango na itugĩ ciakĩo na indo ciakĩo ciothe; na kĩraĩ gĩa gwĩthambĩra na kĩgũrũ gĩakĩo;
English: the bronze altar, its grating of bronze, its poles, all of its vessels, the basin and its base,

Kikuyu: itambaya cia gũcuurio cia nja, na itugĩ ciacio, na itina ciacio, na gĩtambaya gĩa gũcuurio gĩa itoonyero rĩa kuuma nja wa hema; na mĩkanda na higĩ cia nja; na indo ciothe cia hema ĩrĩa nyamũre, na Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo;
English: the hangings of the court, its pillars, its sockets, the screen for the gate of the court, its cords, its pins, and all the instruments of the service of the tabernacle, for the Tent of Meeting,

Kikuyu: na nguo ndume cia kwĩhumbwo nĩ mũndũ agĩtungata thĩinĩ wa handũ- harĩa-haamũre, nguo iria theru cia Harũni ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai, o na cia ariũ ake cia kwĩhumba rĩrĩa mekũruta wĩra wa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai.
English: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office.

Kikuyu: Andũ a Isiraeli maarutire wĩra wothe o ta ũrĩa Jehova aathĩte Musa.
English: According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.

Kikuyu: Musa akĩona wĩra ũrĩa warutĩtwo nake akĩona atĩ nĩmaũrutĩte o ta ũrĩa Jehova aathanĩte. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Musa akĩmarathima.
English: Moses saw all the work, and behold, they had done it as Yahweh had commanded. They had done so; and Moses blessed them.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ:
English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

Kikuyu: “Ũgaaka hema ĩyo nyamũre, nĩo Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo, mũthenya wa mbere wa mweri wa mbere.
English: “On the first day of the first month you shall raise up the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.

Kikuyu: Nĩũkaiga ithandũkũ rĩa Ũira thĩinĩ wayo, na ũhakanie ithandũkũ rĩu na gĩtambaya gĩa gũcuurio.
English: You shall put the ark of the covenant in it, and you shall screen the ark with the veil.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ nĩũgatoonyia metha na ũmĩigĩrĩre indo ciayo, na ũcibange wega. Ningĩ ũtoonyie mũtĩ wa tawa, na ũũigĩrĩre matawa maguo.
English: You shall bring in the table, and set in order the things that are on it. You shall bring in the lamp stand, and light its lamps.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ ũige kĩgongona gĩa thahabu gĩa gũcinĩrwo ũbumba mbere ya Ithandũkũ rĩu rĩa Ũira, na wĩkĩre gĩtambaya gĩa gũcuurio itoonyero-inĩ rĩa hema ĩyo nyamũre.
English: You shall set the golden altar for incense before the ark of the covenant, and put the screen of the door to the tabernacle.

Kikuyu: “Iga kĩgongona kĩa maruta ma njino mbere ya itoonyero rĩa hema ĩyo nyamũre, na nĩyo Hema- ya-Gũtũnganwo;
English: “You shall set the altar of burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.

Kikuyu: ũige kĩraĩ gĩa gwĩthambĩrwo gatagatĩ ka Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo na kĩgongona, na ũgĩĩkĩre maaĩ.
English: You shall set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and shall put water therein.

Kikuyu: Aka nja ĩmĩthiũrũrũkĩrie, na wĩkĩre gĩtambaya gĩa gũcuurio itoonyero-inĩ rĩa nja ĩyo.
English: You shall set up the court around it, and hang up the screen of the gate of the court.

Kikuyu: “Oya maguta ma gũitanĩrĩrio, na ũitĩrĩrie hema ĩyo nyamũre na kĩrĩa gĩothe kĩrĩ thĩinĩ wayo; mĩamũre na indo ciayo ciothe, na nĩĩgatuĩka theru.
English: “You shall take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle and all that is in it, and shall make it holy, and all its furniture, and it will be holy.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ ũitĩrĩrie maguta kĩgongona kĩa maruta ma njino na indo ciakĩo ciothe; wamũre kĩgongona kĩu, nakĩo nĩgĩgatuĩka gĩtheru mũno.
English: You shall anoint the altar of burnt offering, with all its vessels, and sanctify the altar, and the altar will be most holy.

Kikuyu: Itĩrĩria kĩraĩ gĩa gwĩthambĩrwo na kĩgũrũ gĩakĩo maguta, ũciamũre.
English: You shall anoint the basin and its base, and sanctify it.

Kikuyu: “Rehe Harũni na ariũ ake itoonyero-inĩ rĩa Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo, na ũmathambie na maaĩ.
English: “You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ ũhumbe Harũni nguo iria theru, ũmũitĩrĩrie maguta, na ũmwamũre nĩguo andungatĩre arĩ mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai.
English: You shall put on Aaron the holy garments; and you shall anoint him, and sanctify him, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.

Kikuyu: Rehe ariũ ake, ũmahumbe kanjũ.
English: You shall bring his sons, and put tunics on them.

Kikuyu: Maitĩrĩrie maguta o ta ũrĩa ũitĩrĩirie ithe wao, nĩguo mandungatĩre marĩ athĩnjĩri-Ngai. Gũitĩrĩrio maguta kwao nĩkũmatoonyia ũtungata-inĩ wa ũthĩnjĩri-Ngai ũrĩa ũgũtũũra njiarwa-inĩ ciothe iria igooka.”
English: You shall anoint them, as you anointed their father, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office. Their anointing shall be to them for an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.”

Kikuyu: Nake Musa agĩĩka maũndũ mothe o ta ũrĩa Jehova aamwathĩte.
English: Moses did so. According to all that Yahweh commanded him, so he did.

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio hema ĩyo nyamũre ĩgĩakwo mũthenya wa mbere wa mweri wa mbere, mwaka-inĩ wa keerĩ.
English: In the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, the tabernacle was raised up.

Kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Musa aakire hema ĩyo nyamũre, nĩaigire itina handũ ha cio, na akĩrũgamia buremu, agĩtoonyia mĩgamba na akĩrũgamia itugĩ.
English: Moses raised up the tabernacle, and laid its sockets, and set up its boards, and put in its bars, and raised up its pillars.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ agĩtambũrũkia hema igũrũ rĩa hema ĩyo nyamũre na akĩigĩrĩra kĩhumbĩri igũrũ rĩa hema o ta ũrĩa Jehova aamwathĩte.
English: He spread the covering over the tent, and put the roof of the tabernacle above on it, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

Kikuyu: Agĩcooka akĩoya ihengere cia Ũira, na agĩciiga thĩinĩ wa ithandũkũ rĩa kĩrĩkanĩro. Akĩnyiitithania mĩtĩ ĩrĩa mĩraaya na ithandũkũ, na akĩiga gĩtĩ gĩa tha igũrũ rĩa ithandũkũ rĩu.
English: He took and put the covenant into the ark, and set the poles on the ark, and put the mercy seat above on the ark.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ akĩrehe ithandũkũ rĩa kĩrĩkanĩro thĩinĩ wa hema ĩyo nyamũre, na agĩĩkĩra gĩtambaya gĩa kũhakania na akĩhakania ithandũkũ rĩa Ũira o ta ũrĩa Jehova aamwathĩte.
English: He brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the veil of the screen, and screened the ark of the covenant, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

Kikuyu: Musa akĩiga metha thĩinĩ wa Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo mwena wa gathigathini wa hema ĩyo nyamũre, nja ya gĩtambaya gĩa gũcuurio
English: He put the table in the Tent of Meeting, on the north side of the tabernacle, outside of the veil.

Kikuyu: na akĩigĩrĩra mĩgate igũrũ rĩayo o hau mbere ya Jehova, o ta ũrĩa Jehova aamwathĩte.
English: He set the bread in order on it before Yahweh, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

Kikuyu: Akĩiga mũtĩ wa kũigĩrĩrwo matawa thĩinĩ wa Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo ũngʼetheire metha mwena wa gũthini wa hema ĩyo nyamũre,
English: He put the lamp stand in the Tent of Meeting, opposite the table, on the south side of the tabernacle.

Kikuyu: na agĩakia matawa macio mbere ya Jehova, o ta ũrĩa Jehova aamwathĩte.
English: He lit the lamps before Yahweh, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

Kikuyu: Musa agĩtoonyia kĩgongona gĩa thahabu thĩinĩ wa Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo hau mbere ya gĩtam- baya gĩa gũcuurio,
English: He put the golden altar in the Tent of Meeting before the veil;

Kikuyu: na agĩcinĩra ũbumba ũrĩa mũnungi wega ho o ta ũrĩa Jehova aamwathĩte.
English: and he burned incense of sweet spices on it, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ agĩcuuria gĩtambaya itoonyero-inĩ rĩa hema ĩyo nyamũre.
English: He put up the screen of the door to the tabernacle.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ akĩiga kĩgongona kĩa maruta ma njino hakuhĩ na itoonyero rĩa hema ĩyo nyamũre, nĩyo Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo, na akĩrutĩra magongona ma njino igũrũ rĩakĩo o na magongona ma ngano, o ta ũrĩa Jehova aamwathĩte.
English: He set the altar of burnt offering at the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting, and offered on it the burnt offering and the meal offering, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

Kikuyu: Nĩaigire kĩraĩ gĩa gwĩthambĩrwo gatagatĩ ka Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo na kĩgongona na agĩgĩĩkĩra maaĩ ma gwĩthamba,
English: He set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water therein, with which to wash.

Kikuyu: nake Musa na Harũni na ariũ ake magĩtũmĩra maaĩ macio gwĩthamba moko na magũrũ.
English: Moses, Aaron, and his sons washed their hands and their feet there.

Kikuyu: Nĩmethambaga hĩndĩ ciothe magĩtoonya Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo kana magĩkuhĩrĩria kĩgongona o ta ũrĩa Jehova aathĩte Musa.
English: When they went into the Tent of Meeting, and when they came near to the altar, they washed, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

Kikuyu: Ningĩ Musa agĩaka nja gũthiũrũrũka hema ĩyo nyamũre na kĩgongona na agĩĩkĩra gĩtambaya gĩa gũcuurio itoonyero rĩa nja ĩyo. Na nĩ ũndũ ũcio Musa akĩrĩkia wĩra ũcio.
English: He raised up the court around the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the screen of the gate of the court. So Moses finished the work.

Kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo itu rĩkĩhumbĩra Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo, naguo riiri wa Jehova ũkĩiyũra hema ĩyo nyamũre.
English: Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and Yahweh’s glory filled the tabernacle.

Kikuyu: Musa ndangĩahotire gũtoonya Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo tondũ itu rĩaikarĩte igũrũ rĩayo, naguo riiri wa Jehova ũkaiyũra hema ĩyo nyamũre.
English: Moses wasn’t able to enter into the Tent of Meeting, because the cloud stayed on it, and Yahweh’s glory filled the tabernacle.

Kikuyu: Ngʼendo-inĩ ciothe cia andũ a Isiraeli-rĩ, hĩndĩ ĩrĩa yothe itu rĩoyagwo na igũrũ kuuma hema ĩyo nyamũre, nĩguo moimagaraga;
English: When the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward, throughout all their journeys;

Kikuyu: no itu rĩĩaga kuoywo na igũrũ, nao makaaga kuumagara, nginya mũthenya ũrĩa rĩkoywo na igũrũ.
English: but if the cloud wasn’t taken up, then they didn’t travel until the day that it was taken up.

Kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio itu rĩa Jehova rĩaikaraga igũrũ wa hema ĩyo nyamũre mũthenya, naguo mwaki wakoragwo itu-inĩ rĩu ũtukũ, rĩgakĩonagwo nĩ nyũmba yothe ya Isiraeli mahinda mothe ngʼendo-inĩ ciao ciothe.
English: For the cloud of Yahweh was on the tabernacle by day, and there was fire in the cloud by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.
